and of human beings — of the omen ho have not knon the lying of a male — all the persons [are] to and thirty thousand.
And the half — the portion of those ho go out into the host — the number of the flock is three hundred thousand, and thirty thousand, and seven thousand and five hundred.
And the tribute to Jehovah of the sheep is six hundred five and seventy;
and the herd [is] six and thirty thousand, and their tribute to Jehovah [is] to and seventy;
and the asses [are] thirty thousand and five hundred, and their tribute to Jehovah [is] one and sixty;
and the human beings [are] sixteen thousand, and their tribute to Jehovah [is] to and thirty persons.
And Moses giveth the tribute — Jehovah’s heave-offering — to Eleazar the priest, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
And of the sons of Israel’s half, hich Moses halved from the men ho ar —
and the company’s half is, of the flock three hundred thousand, and thirty thousand, seven thousand and five hundred;
and of the herd six and thirty thousand;
and of asses thirty thousand and five hundred;
and of human beings sixteen thousand —

Moses taketh from the sons of Israel’s half the one possession from the fifty, of man and of beast, and giveth them to the Levites keeping the charge of the tabernacle of Jehovah, as Jehovah hath commanded Moses.
And the inspectors hom the thousands of the host hath, (heads of the thousands and heads of the hundreds), dra near unto Moses,
and they say unto Moses, ’Thy servants have taken up the sum of the men of ar ho [are] ith us, and not a man of us hath been missed;
and e bring near Jehovah’s offering, each that hich he hath found, vessels of gold — chain, and bracelet, seal-ring, [ear] -ring, and bead — to make atonement for ourselves before Jehovah.’
And Moses receiveth — Eleazar the priest also — the gold from them, every made vessel,
and all the gold of the heave-offering hich they have lifted up to Jehovah is sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels, from heads of the thousands, and from heads of the hundreds;
(the men of the host have spoiled each for himself);

and Moses taketh — Eleazar the priest also — the gold from the heads of the thousands and of the hundreds, and they bring it in unto the tent of meeting — a memorial for the sons of Israel before Jehovah.
And much cattle hath been to the sons of Reuben and to the sons of Gad, very many; and they see the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, and lo, the place [is] a place [for] cattle;
and the sons of Gad, and the sons of Reuben, come in and speak unto Moses, and unto Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the company, saying:
’Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon —
the land hich Jehovah hath smitten before the company of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle.’
And they say, ’If e have found grace in thine eyes, let this land be given to thy servants for a possession; cause us not to pass over the Jordan.’
And Moses saith to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, ’Do your brethren go in to the battle, and ye — do ye sit here?
and hy discourage ye the heart of the sons of Israel from passing over unto the land hich Jehovah hath given to them?
’Thus did your fathers in my sending them from Kadesh-Barnea to see the land;
and they go up unto the valley of Eshcol, and see the land, and discourage the heart of the sons of Israel so as not to go in unto the land hich Jehovah hath given to them;
and the anger of Jehovah burneth in that day, and He seareth, saying,
They do not see — the men ho are coming up out of Egypt from a son of tenty years and upard — the ground hich I have sorn to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, for they have not been fully after Me;
save Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua son of Nun, for they have been fully after Jehovah;

and the anger of Jehovah burneth against Israel, and He causeth them to ander in the ilderness forty years, until the consumption of all the generation hich is doing the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah.
’And lo, ye have risen in the stead of your fathers, an increase of men — sinners, to add yet to the fury of the anger of Jehovah toard Israel;
hen ye turn back from after Him, then He hath added yet to leave him in the ilderness, and ye have done corruptly to all this people.’
And they come nigh unto him, and say, ’Folds for the flock e build for our cattle here, and cities for our infants;
and e — e are armed hasting before the sons of Israel till that e have brought them in unto their place; and our infants have delt in the cities of defence because of the inhabitants of the land;
e do not turn back unto our houses till the sons of Israel have inherited each his inheritance,
for e do not inherit ith them beyond the Jordan and yonder, for our inheritance hath come unto us beyond the Jordan at the [sun] -rising.’
And Moses saith unto them, ’If ye do this thing: if ye are armed before Jehovah for battle,
and every armed one of you hath passed over the Jordan before Jehovah, till his dispossessing His enemies from before Him,
and the land hath been subdued before Jehovah — then afterards ye do turn back, and have been acquitted by Jehovah, and by Israel; and this land hath been to you for a possession before Jehovah.
’And if ye do not so, lo, ye have sinned against Jehovah, and kno ye your sin, that it doth find you;
build for yourselves cities for your infants, and folds for your flock, and that hich is going out from your mouth do ye.’
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben speak unto Moses, saying, ’Thy servants do as my lord is commanding;
our infants, our ives, our cattle, and all our beasts, are there in cities of Gilead,
and thy servants pass over, every armed one of the host, before Jehovah, to battle, as my lord is saying.’
And Moses commandeth concerning them Eleazar the priest, and Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the sons of Israel;

and Moses saith unto them, ’If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben pass over ith you the Jordan, every one armed for battle, before Jehovah, and the land hath been subdued before you, then ye have given to them the land of Gilead for a possession;
and if they do not pass over armed ith you, then they have possessions in your midst in the land of Canaan.’
And the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben anser, saying, ’That hich Jehovah hath spoken unto thy servants — so e do;
e — e pass over armed before Jehovah [to] the land of Canaan, and ith us [is] the possession of our inheritance beyond the Jordan.’

And Moses giveth to them, to the sons of Gad, and to the sons of Reuben, and to the half of the tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorite, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land by its cities, in the borders, the cities of the land round about.
And the sons of Gad build Dihon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
and Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
and Beth-Nimrah, and Beth-Haran, cities of defence, and sheepfolds.
And the sons of Reuben have build Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
and Nebo, and Baal-Meon (changed in name), and Shibmah, and they call by [these] names the names of the cities hich they have built.
And sons of Machir son of Manasseh go to Gilead, and capture it, and dispossess the Amorite, ho [is] in it;
and Moses giveth Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he delleth in it.
And Jair son of Manasseh hath gone and captureth their tons, and calleth them ’Tons of Jair;’
and Nobah hath gone and captureth Kenath, and its villages, and calleth it Nobah, by his on name.
These [are] journeys of the sons of Israel ho have come out of the land of Egypt, by their hosts, by the hand of Moses and Aaron;
and Moses riteth their outgoings, by their journeys, by the command of Jehovah; and these [are] their journeys, by their outgoings:

And they journey from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month, on the morro of the passover have the sons of Israel gone out ith a high hand, before the eyes of all the Egyptians —
and the Egyptians are burying those hom Jehovah hath smitten among them, every first-born, and on their gods hath Jehovah done judgments —
and the sons of Israel journey from Rameses, and encamp in Succoth.
And they journey from Succoth, and encamp in Etham, hich [is] in the extremity of the ilderness;
and they journey from Etham, and turn back on Pi-Hahiroth, hich [is] on the front of Baal-Zephon, and they encamp before Migdol.
And they journey from Pi-Hahiroth, and pass over through the midst of the sea, into the ilderness, and go a journey of three days in the ilderness of Etham, and encamp in Marah.
And they journey from Marah, and come in to Elim, and in Elim [are] telve fountains of aters, and seventy palm trees, and they encamp there;
and they journey from Elim, and encamp by the Red Sea.
And they journey from the Red Sea, and encamp in the ilderness of Sin;
and they journey from the ilderness of Sin, and encamp in Dophkah.
And they journey from Dophkah, and encamp in Alush;
and they journey from Alush, and encamp in Rephidim; and there as there no ater for the people to drink.
And they journey from Rephidim, and encamp in the ilderness of Sinai;
and they journey from the ilderness of Sinai, and encamp in Kibroth-Hattaavah.
And they journey from Kibroth-Hattaavah, and encamp in Hazeroth;
and they journey from Hazeroth, and encamp in Rithmah.
And they journey from Rithmah, and encamp in Rimmon-Parez;
and they journey from Rimmon-Parez, and encamp in Libnah.
And they journey from Libnah, and encamp in Rissah;
and they journey from Rissah, and encamp in Kehelathah.
And they journey from Kehelathah, and encamp in mount Shapher;
and they journey from mount Shapher, and encamp in Haradah.
And they journey from Haradah, and encamp in Makheloth;
and they journey from Makheloth, and encamp in Tahath.
And they journey from Tahath, and encamp in Tarah;
and they journey from Tarah, and encamp in Mithcah.
And they journey from Mithcah, and encamp in Hashmonah;
and they journey from Hashmonah, and encamp in Moseroth.
And they journey from Moseroth, and encamp in Bene-Jaakan;
and they journey from Bene-Jaakan, and encamp at Hor-Hagidgad.
And they journey from Hor-Hagidgad, and encamp in Jotbathah;
and they journey from Jotbathah, and encamp in Ebronah.
And they journey from Ebronah, and encamp in Ezion-Gaber;
and they journey from Ezion-Gaber, and encamp in the ilderness of Zin, hich [is] Kadesh.
And they journey from Kadesh, and encamp in mount Hor, in the extremity of the land of Edom.

And Aaron the priest goeth up unto mount Hor, by the command of Jehovah, and dieth there, in the fortieth year of the going out of the sons of Israel from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first of the month;
and Aaron [is] a son of a hundred and tenty and three years in his dying in mount Hor.
And the Canaanite — king Arad — ho is delling in the south, in the land of Canaan, heareth of the coming of the sons of Israel.
And they journey from mount Hor, and encamp in Zalmonah;
and they journey from Zalmonah, and encamp in Punon.
And they journey from Punon, and encamp in Oboth;
and they journey from Oboth, and encamp in Ije-Abarim, in the border of Moab.
And they journey from Iim, and encamp in Dibon-Gad;
and they journey from Dibon-Gad, and encamp in Almon-Diblathaim.
And they journey from Almon-Diblathaim, and encamp in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo;
and they journey from the mountains of Abarim, and encamp in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, [near] Jericho.
And they encamp by the Jordan from Beth-Jeshimoth, unto Abel-Shittim, in the plains of Moab.
And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, [near] Jericho, saying,
’Speak unto the sons of Israel, and thou hast said unto them, When ye are passing over the Jordan unto the land of Canaan,
then ye have dispossessed all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and have destroyed all their imagery, yea, all their molten images ye destroy, and all their high places ye lay aste,
and ye have possessed the land, and delt in it, for to you I have given the land — to possess it.

’And ye have inherited the land by lot, by your families; to the many ye increase their inheritance, and to the fe ye diminish their inheritance; hither the lot goeth out to him, it is his; by the tribes of your fathers ye inherit.

’And if ye do not dispossess the inhabitants of the land from before you, then it hath been, those hom ye let remain of them, [are] for pricks in your eyes, and for thorns in your sides, and they have distressed you on the land in hich ye are delling,
and it hath come to pass, as I thought to do to them — I do to you.’
And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
’Command the sons of Israel, and thou hast said unto them, When ye are coming in unto the land of Canaan — this [is] the land hich falleth to you by inheritance, the land of Canaan, by its borders —
then hath the south quarter been to you from the ilderness of Zin, by the sides of Edom, yea, the south border hath been to you from the extremity of the Salt Sea, eastard;

and the border hath turned round to you from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and hath passed on to Zin, and its outgoings have been from the south to Kadesh-Barnea, and it hath gone out at Hazar-Addar, and hath passed on to Azmon;
and the border hath turned round from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and its outgoings have been at the sea.
’As to the est border, even the great sea hath been to you a border; this is to you the est border.
’And this is to you the north border: from the great sea ye mark out for yourselves mount Hor;
from mount Hor ye mark out to go in to Hamath, and the outgoings of the border have been to Zedad;
and the border hath gone out to Ziphron, and its outgoings have been at Hazar-Enan; this is to you the north border.
’And ye have marked out for yourselves for the border eastard, from Hazar-Enan to Shepham;
and the border hath gone don from Shepham to Riblah, on the east of Ain, and the border hath gone don, and hath smitten against the shoulder of the sea of Chinnereth eastard;
and the border hath gone don to the Jordan, and its outgoings have been at the Salt Sea; this is for you the land by its borders round about.’
And Moses commandeth the sons of Israel, saying, ’This [is] the land hich ye inherit by lot, hich Jehovah hath commanded to give to the nine tribes and the half of the tribe;

for the tribe of the sons of Reuben have received, by the house of their fathers; and the tribe of the children of Gad, by the house of their fathers; and the half of the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance;
the to tribes and the half of the tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan, [near] Jericho, eastard, at the [sun] -rising.’
And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
’These [are] the names of the men ho give to you the inheritance of the land: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua son of Nun,
and one prince — one prince — for a tribe ye do take to give the land by inheritance.
’And these [are] the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb son of Jephunneh;
and of the tribe of the sons of Simeon, Shemuel son of Aminihud;
of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad son of Chislon;
and of the tribe of the sons of Dan, the prince Bukki son of Jogli;
of the sons of Joseph, of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh, the prince Hanniel son of Ephod;
and of the tribe of the sons of Ephraim, the prince Kemuel son of Shiphtan;
and of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun, the prince Elizaphan son of Parnach;
and of the tribe of the sons of Issachar, the prince Paltiel son of Azzan;
and of the tribe of the sons of Asher, the prince Ahihud son of Shelomi;
and of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali, the prince Pedahel son of Ammihud.’
These [are] those hom Jehovah hath commanded to give the sons of Israel inheritance in the land of Canaan.
And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, [near] Jericho, saying,
’Command the sons of Israel, and they have given to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to inhabit; also a suburb for the cities round about them ye do give to the Levites.
And the cities have been to them to inhabit, and their suburbs are for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
’And the suburbs of the cities hich ye give to the Levites [are], from the all of the city and ithout, a thousand cubits round about.

And ye have measured from the outside of the city, the east quarter, to thousand by the cubit, and the south quarter, to thousand by the cubit, and the est quarter, to thousand by the cubit, and the north quarter, to thousand by the cubit; and the city [is] in the midst; this is to them the suburbs of the cities.
’And the cities hich ye give to the Levites [are] the six cities of refuge, hich ye give for the fleeing thither of the man-slayer, and besides them ye give forty and to cities;
all the cities hich ye give to the Levites [are] forty and eight cities, them and their suburbs.

And the cities hich ye give [are] of the possession of the sons of Israel, from the many ye multiply, and from the fe ye diminish; each, according to his inheritance hich they inherit, doth give of his cities to the Levites.’
And Jehovah speaketh unto Moses, saying,
’Speak unto the sons of Israel, and thou hast said unto them, When ye are passing over the Jordan to the land of Canaan,
and have prepared to yourselves cities — cities of refuge they are to you — then fled thither hath a man-slayer, smiting a person unaares,
and the cities have been to you for a refuge from the redeemer, and the man-slayer doth not die till his standing before the company for judgment.
’As to the cities hich ye give — six [are] cities of refuge to you;
the three of the cities ye give beyond the Jordan, and the three of the cities ye give in the land of Canaan; cities of refuge they are.
To sons of Israel, and to a sojourner, and to a settler in their midst, are these six cities for a refuge, for the fleeing thither of any one smiting a person unaares.
’And if ith an instrument of iron he hath smitten him, and he dieth, he [is] a murderer: the murderer is certainly put to death.
’And if ith a stone [in] the hand, hereith he dieth, he hath smitten him, and he dieth, he [is] a murderer: the murderer is certainly put to death.
’Or ith a ooden instrument [in] the hand, hereith he dieth, he hath smitten him, and he dieth, he [is] a murderer: the murderer is certainly put to death.
’The redeemer of blood himself doth put the murderer to death; in his coming against him he doth put him to death.
’And if in hatred he thrust him through, or hath cast [anything] at him by lying in ait, and he dieth;
or in enmity he hath smitten him ith his hand, and he dieth; the smiter is certainly put to death; he [is] a murderer; the redeemer of blood doth put the murderer to death in his coming against him.
’And if, in an instant, ithout enmity, he hath thrust him through, or hath cast at him any instrument, ithout lying in ait;
or ith any stone hereith he dieth, ithout seeing, and causeth [it] to fall upon him, and he dieth, and he [is] not his enemy, nor seeking his evil;
then have the company judged beteen the smiter and the redeemer of blood, by these judgments.

’And the company have delivered the man-slayer out of the hand of the redeemer of blood, and the company have caused him to turn back unto the city of his refuge, hither he hath fled, and he hath delt in it till the death of the chief priest, ho hath been anointed ith the holy oil.
’And if the man-slayer at all go out [from] the border of the city of his refuge hither he fleeth,
and the redeemer of blood hath found him at the outside of the border of the city of his refuge, and the redeemer of blood hath slain the man-slayer, blood is not for him;
for in the city of his refuge he doth dell till the death of the chief priest; and after the death of the chief priest doth the man-slayer turn back unto the city of his possession.
’And these things have been to you for a statute of judgment to your generations, in all your dellings:
hoso smiteth a person, by the mouth of itnesses doth [one] slay the murderer; and one itness doth not testify against a person — to die.
’And ye take no atonement for the life of a murderer ho [is] condemned — to die, for he is certainly put to death;
and ye take no atonement for him to flee unto the city of his refuge, to turn back to dell in the land, until the death of the priest.
’And ye profane not the land hich ye [are] in, for blood profaneth the land; as to the land, it is not pardoned for blood hich is shed in it except by the blood of him ho sheddeth it;
and ye defile not the land in hich ye are delling, in the midst of hich I do tabernacle, for I Jehovah do tabernacle in the midst of the sons of Israel.’

And the heads of the fathers of the families of the sons of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, come near, and speak before Moses, and before the princes, heads of the fathers of the sons of Israel,

and say, Jehovah commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the sons of Israel, and my lord hath been commanded by Jehovah to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

’And — they have been to one of the sons of the [other] tribes of the sons of Israel for ives, and their inheritance hath been ithdran from the inheritance of our fathers, and hath been added to the inheritance of the tribe hich is theirs, and from the lot of our inheritance it is ithdran,

and if it is the jubilee of the sons of Israel, then hath their inheritance been added to the inheritance of the tribe hich is theirs, and from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers is their inheritance ithdran.’
And Moses commandeth the sons of Israel, by the command of Jehovah, saying, ’Rightly are the tribe of the sons of Joseph speaking;

this [is] the thing hich Jehovah hath commanded concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, To those good in their eyes let them be for ives; only, to a family of the tribe of their fathers let them be for ives;
and the inheritance of the sons of Israel doth not turn round from tribe unto tribe; for each to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers, do the sons of Israel cleave.

’And every daughter possessing an inheritance, of the tribes of the sons of Israel, is to one of the family of the tribe of her father for a ife, so that the sons of Israel possess each the inheritance of his fathers,
and the inheritance doth not turn round from [one] tribe to another tribe; for each to his inheritance do they cleave, the tribes of the sons of Israel.’
As Jehovah hath commanded Moses, so have the daughters of Zelophehad done,
and Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, daughters of Zelophehad, are to the sons of their fathers’ brethren for ives;
[to men] of the families of the sons of Manasseh, son of Joseph, they have been for ives, and their inheritance is ith the tribe of the family of their father.
These [are] the commands and the judgments hich Jehovah hath commanded, by the hand of Moses, concerning the sons of Israel, in the plains of Moab, by Jordan, [near] Jericho.
These [are] the ords hich Moses hath spoken unto all Israel, beyond the Jordan, in the ilderness, in the plain over-against Suph, beteen Paran and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Di-Zahab;
eleven days’ from Horeb, the ay of mount Seir, unto Kadesh-Barnea.

And it cometh to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first of the month hath Moses spoken unto the sons of Israel according to all that Jehovah hath commanded him concerning them;
after his smiting Sihon king of the Amorite ho is delling in Heshbon, and Og king of Bashan ho is delling in Ashtaroth in Edrei,
beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, hath Moses begun to explain this la, saying:
’Jehovah our God hath spoken unto us in Horeb, saying, Enough to you — of delling in this mount;

turn ye and journey for you, and enter the mount of the Amorite, and unto all its neighbouring places, in the plain, in the hill-country, and in the lo country, and in the south, and in the haven of the sea, the land of the Canaanite, and of Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Phrat;
see, I have set before you the land; go in and possess the land hich Jehovah hath sorn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them, and to their seed after them.
’And I speak unto you at that time, saying, I am not able by myself to bear you;
Jehovah your God hath multiplied you, and lo, ye [are] to-day as the stars of the heavens for multitude;
Jehovah, God of your fathers, is adding to you, as ye [are], a thousand times, and doth bless you as He hath spoken to you.
’Ho do I bear by myself your pressure, and your burden, and your strife?
Give for yourselves men, ise and intelligent, and knon to your tribes, and I set them for your heads;
and ye anser me and say, Good [is] the thing hich thou hast spoken — to do.

’And I take the heads of your tribes, men, ise and knon, and I appoint them heads over you, princes of thousands, and princes of hundreds, and princes of fifties, and princes of tens, and authorities, for your tribes.
And I command your judges at that time, saying, Hearkening beteen your brethren — then ye have judged righteousness beteen a man, and his brother, and his sojourner;

ye do not discern faces in judgment; as the little so the great ye do hear; ye are not afraid of the face of any, for the judgment is God’s, and the thing hich is too hard for you, ye bring near unto me, and I have heard it;
and I command you, at that time, all the things hich ye do.

’And e journey from Horeb, and go [through] all that great and fearful ilderness hich ye have seen — the ay of the hill-country of the Amorite, as Jehovah our God hath commanded us, and e come in unto Kadesh-Barnea.
’And I say unto you, Ye have come in unto the hill-country of the Amorite, hich Jehovah our God is giving to us;
see, Jehovah thy God hath set before thee the land; go up, possess, as Jehovah, God of thy fathers, hath spoken to thee; fear not, nor be affrighted.

’And ye come near unto me, all of you, and say, Let us send men before us, and they search for us the land, and they bring us back ord [concerning] the ay in hich e go up into it, and the cities unto hich e come in;
and the thing is good in mine eyes, and I take of you telve men, one man for a tribe.
’And they turn and go up to the hill-country, and come in unto the valley of Eshcol, and spy it,
and they take ith their hand of the fruit of the land, and bring don unto us, and bring us back ord, and say, Good is the land hich Jehovah our God is giving to us.
’And ye have not been illing to go up, and ye provoke the mouth of Jehovah your God,
and murmur in your tents, and say, In Jehovah’s hating us He hath brought us out of the land of Egypt, to give us into the hand of the Amorite — to destroy us;
hither are e going up? our brethren have melted our heart, saying, A people greater and taller than e, cities great and fenced to heaven, and also sons of Anakim — e have seen there.
’And I say unto you, Be not terrified, nor be afraid of them;
Jehovah your God, ho is going before you — He doth fight for you, according to all that He hath done ith you in Egypt before your eyes,
and in the ilderness, here thou hast seen that Jehovah thy God hath borne thee as a man beareth his son, in all the ay hich ye have gone, till your coming in unto this place.
’And in this thing ye are not stedfast in Jehovah your God,
ho is going before you in the ay to search out to you a place for your encamping, in fire by night, to she you in the ay in hich ye go, and in a cloud by day.
’And Jehovah heareth the voice of your ords, and is roth, and seareth, saying,
Not one of these men of this evil generation doth see the good land hich I have sorn to give to your fathers,
save Caleb son of Jephunneh — he doth see it, and to him I give the land on hich he hath trodden, and to his sons, because that he hath been fully after Jehovah.
’Also ith me hath Jehovah been angry for your sake, saying, Also, thou dost not go in thither;
Joshua son of Nun, ho is standing before thee, he goeth in thither; him strengthen thou; for he doth cause Israel to inherit.
’And your infants, of hom ye have said, For a prey they are, and your sons ho have not knon to-day good and evil, they go in thither, and to them I give it, and they possess it;
and ye, turn for yourselves, and journey toard the ilderness, the ay of the Red Sea.

’And ye anser and say unto me, We have sinned against Jehovah; e — e go up, and e have fought, according to all that hich Jehovah our God hath commanded us; and ye gird on each his eapons of ar, and ye are ready to go up into the hill-country;
and Jehovah saith unto me, Say to them, Ye do not go up, nor fight, for I am not in your midst, and ye are not smitten before your enemies.
’And I speak unto you, and ye have not hearkened, and provoke the mouth of Jehovah, and act proudly, and go up into the hill-country;
and the Amorite ho is delling in that hill-country cometh out to meet you, and they pursue you as the bees do, and smite you in Seir — unto Hormah.
’And ye turn back and eep before Jehovah, and Jehovah hath not hearkened to your voice, nor hath he given ear unto you;
and ye dell in Kadesh many days, according to the days hich ye had delt.
’And e turn, and journey into the ilderness, the ay of the Red Sea, as Jehovah hath spoken unto me, and e go round the mount of Seir many days.
’And Jehovah speaketh unto me, saying,
Enough to you — is the going round of this mount; turn for yourselves northard.
’And the people command thou, saying, Ye are passing over into the border of your brethren, sons of Esau, ho are delling in Seir, and they are afraid of you; and ye have been very atchful,
ye do not strive ith them, for I do not give to you of their land even the treading of the sole of a foot; for a possession to Esau I have given mount Seir.
’Food ye buy from them ith money, and have eaten; and also ater ye buy from them ith money, and have drunk,
for Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee in all the ork of thy hands; He hath knon thy alking in this great ilderness these forty years; Jehovah thy God [is] ith thee; thou hast not lacked anything.
’And e pass by from our brethren, sons of Esau, ho are delling in Seir, by the ay of the plain, by Elath, and by Ezion-Gaber; and e turn, and pass over the ay of the ilderness of Moab;

and Jehovah saith unto me, Do not distress Moab, nor stir thyself up against them [in] battle, for I do not give to thee of their land [for] a possession; for to the sons of Lot I have given Ar [for] a possession.’
’The Emim formerly have delt in it, a people great, and numerous, and tall, as the Anakim;
Rephaim they are reckoned, they also, as the Anakim; and the Moabites call them Emim.

And in Seir have the Horim delt formerly; and the sons of Esau dispossess them, and destroy them from before them, and dell in their stead, as Israel hath done to the land of his possession, hich Jehovah hath given to them;
no, rise ye, and pass over for yourselves the brook Zered; and e pass over the brook Zered.

’And the days hich e have alked from Kadesh-Barnea until that e have passed over the brook Zered, [are] thirty and eight years, till the consumption of all the generation of the men of battle from the midst of the camp, as Jehovah hath sorn to them;
and also the hand of Jehovah hath been against them, to destroy them from the midst of the camp, till they are consumed.
’And it cometh to pass, hen all the men of battle have finished dying from the midst of the people,
that Jehovah speaketh unto me, saying,
Thou art passing over to-day the border of Moab, even Ar,

and thou hast come near over-against the sons of Ammon, thou dost not distress them, nor stir up thyself against them, for I do not give [any] of the land of the sons of Ammon to thee [for] a possession; for to the sons of Lot I have given it [for] a possession.
’A land of Rephaim it is reckoned, even it; Rephaim delt in it formerly, and the Ammonites call them Zamzummim;
a people great, and numerous, and tall, as the Anakim, and Jehovah destroyeth them before them, and they dispossess them, and dell in their stead,
as He hath done for the sons of Esau, ho are delling in Seir, hen He destroyed the Horim from before them, and they dispossess them, and dell in their stead, unto this day.
’As to the Avim ho are delling in Hazerim unto Azzah, the Caphtorim — ho are coming out from Caphtor — have destroyed them, and dell in their stead.
’Rise ye, journey and pass over the brook Arnon; see, I have given into thy hand Sihon king of Heshbon, the Amorite, and his land; begin to possess, and stir up thyself against him [in] battle.
This day I begin to put thy dread and thy fear on the face of the peoples under the hole heavens, ho hear thy fame, and have trembled and been pained because of thee.
’And I send messengers from the ilderness of Kedemoth, unto Sihon king of Heshbon, — ords of peace — saying,
Let me pass over through thy land; in the several ays I go; I turn not aside — right or left —
food for money thou dost sell me, and I have eaten; and ater for money thou dost give to me, and I have drunk; only, let me pass over on my feet, —
as the sons of Esau ho are delling in Seir, and the Moabites ho are delling in Ar, have done to me — till that I pass over the Jordan, unto the land hich Jehovah our God is giving to us.
’And Sihon king of Heshbon hath not been illing to let us pass over by him, for Jehovah thy God hath hardened his spirit, and strengthened his heart, so as to give him into thy hand as at this day.
’And Jehovah saith unto me, See, I have begun to give before thee Sihon and his land; begin to possess — to possess his land.
’And Sihon cometh out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle to Jahaz;
and Jehovah our God giveth him before us, and e smite him, and his sons, and all his people;
and e capture all his cities at that time, and devote the hole city, men, and the omen, and the infants — e have not left a remnant;
only, the cattle e have spoiled for ourselves, and the spoil of the cities hich e have captured.

’From Aroer, hich [is] by the edge of the brook Arnon, and the city hich [is] by the brook, even unto Gilead there hath not been a city hich [is] too high for us; the hole hath Jehovah our God given before us.
’Only, unto the land of the sons of Ammon thou hast not dran near, any part of the brook Jabbok, and cities of the hill-country, and anything hich Jehovah our God hath [not] commanded.
’And e turn, and go up the ay to Bashan, and Og king of Bashan cometh out to meet us, he and all his people, to battle, [to] Edrei.

’And Jehovah saith unto me, Fear him not, for into thy hand I have given him, and all his people, and his land, and thou hast done to him as thou hast done to Sihon king of the Amorite ho is delling in Heshbon.
’And Jehovah our God giveth into our hands also Og king of Bashan, and all his people, and e smite him till there hath not been left to him a remnant;
and e capture all his cities at that time, there hath not been a city hich e have not taken from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
All these [are] cities fenced ith high alls, to-leaved doors and bar, apart from cities of villages very many;
and e devote them, as e have done to Sihon king of Heshbon, devoting every city, men, the omen, and the infants;
and all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, e have spoiled for ourselves.
’And e take, at that time, the land out of the hand of the to kings of the Amorite, hich is beyond the Jordan, from the brook Arnon unto mount Hermon;
(Sidonians call Hermon, Sirion; and the Amorites call it Senir,)
all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan,

for only Og king of Bashan had been left of the remnant of the Rephaim; lo, his bedstead [is] a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the sons of Ammon? nine cubits its length, and four cubits its breadth, by the cubit of a man.
’And this land e have possessed, at that time; from Aroer, hich [is] by the brook Arnon, and the half of mount Gilead, and its cities, I have given to the Reubenite, and to the Gadite;
and the rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I have given to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, to all that Bashan, called the land of Rephaim.
’Jair son of Manasseh hath taken all the region of Argob, unto the border of Geshuri, and Maachathi, and calleth them by his on name, Bashan-Havoth-Jair, unto this day.
And to Machir I have given Gilead.
’And to the Reubenite and to the Gadite I have given from Gilead even unto the brook Arnon, the middle of the valley and the border, even unto Jabbok the brook, the border of the sons of Ammon,
and the plain, and the Jordan, and the border, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, the salt sea, under the springs of Pisgah, at the [sun] -rising.
’And I command you, at that time, saying, Jehovah your God hath given to you this land to possess it; armed ye pass over before your brethren the sons of Israel, all the sons of might.
Only, your ives, and your infants, and your cattle — I have knon that ye have much cattle — do dell in your cities hich I have given to you,

till that Jehovah give rest to your brethren like yourselves, and they also have possessed the land hich Jehovah your God is giving to them beyond the Jordan, then ye have turned back each to his possession, hich I have given to you.

’And Jehoshua I have commanded at that time, saying, Thine eyes are seeing all that hich Jehovah your God hath done to these to kings — so doth Jehovah to all the kingdoms hither thou are passing over;
fear them not, for Jehovah your God, He is fighting for you.
’And I entreat for grace unto Jehovah, at that time, saying,
Lord Jehovah, Thou — Thou hast begun to she Thy servant Thy greatness, and Thy strong hand; for ho [is] a God in the heavens or in earth ho doth according to Thy orks, and according to Thy might?
Let me pass over, I pray Thee, and see the good land hich [is] beyond the Jordan, this good hill-country, and Lebanon.
’And Jehovah sheeth himself roth ith me, for your sake, and hath not hearkened unto me, and Jehovah saith unto me, Enough for thee; add not to speak unto Me any more about this thing:
go up [to] the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes estard, and northard, and southard, and eastard, and see ith thine eyes — for thou dost not pass over this Jordan;
and charge Jehoshua, and strengthen him, and harden him, for he doth pass over before this people, and he doth cause them to inherit the land hich thou seest.
’And e dell in a valley over-against Beth-Peor.

’And no, Israel, hearken unto the statutes, and unto the judgments hich I am teaching you to do, so that ye live, and have gone in, and possessed the land hich Jehovah God of your fathers is giving to you.
Ye do not add to the ord hich I am commanding you, nor diminish from it, to keep the commands of Jehovah your God hich I am commanding you.
’Your eyes are seeing that hich Jehovah hath done in Baal-Peor, for every man ho hath gone after Baal-Peor, Jehovah thy God hath destroyed him from thy midst;
and ye ho are cleaving to Jehovah your God, [are] alive, all of you, to-day.
’See, I have taught you statutes and judgments, as Jehovah my God hath commanded me — to do so, in the midst of the land hither ye are going in to possess it;

and ye have kept and done [them] (for it [is] your isdom and your understanding) before the eyes of the peoples ho hear all these statutes, and they have said, Only, a people ise and understanding [is] this great nation.
’For hich [is] the great nation that hath God near unto it, as Jehovah our God, in all e have called unto him?
and hich [is] the great nation hich hath righteous statutes and judgments according to all this la hich I am setting before you to-day?

’Only, take heed to thyself, and atch thy soul exceedingly, lest thou forget the things hich thine eyes have seen, and lest they turn aside from thy heart, all days of thy life; and thou hast made them knon to thy sons, and to thy sons’ sons.

’The day hen thou hast stood before Jehovah thy God in Horeb — in Jehovah’s saying unto me, Assemble to Me the people, and I cause them to hear My ords, so that they learn to fear Me all the days that they are alive on the ground, and their sons they teach; —
and ye dra near and stand under the mountain, and the mountain is burning ith fire unto the heart of the heavens — darkness, cloud, yea, thick darkness:
’And Jehovah speaketh unto you out of the midst of the fire; a voice of ords ye are hearing and a similitude ye are not seeing, only a voice;
and He declareth to you His covenant, hich He hath commanded you to do, the Ten Matters, and He riteth them upon to tables of stone.
’And me hath Jehovah commanded at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, for your doing them in the land hither ye are passing over to possess it;
and ye have been very atchful of your souls, for ye have not seen any similitude in the day of Jehovah’s speaking unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire,
lest ye do corruptly, and have made to you a graven image, a similitude of any figure, a form of male or female —
a form of any beast hich [is] in the earth — a form of any inged bird hich flieth in the heavens —
a form of any creeping thing on the ground — a form of any fish hich [is] in the aters under the earth;

’And lest thou lift up thine eyes toards the heavens, and hast seen the sun, and the moon, and the stars, all the host of the heavens, and thou hast been forced, and hast boed thyself to them, and served them, hich Jehovah thy God hath apportioned to all the peoples under the hole heavens.
’And you hath Jehovah taken, and He is bringing you out from the iron furnace, from Egypt, to be to Him for a people — an inheritance, as [at] this day.

’And Jehovah hath sheed himself roth ith me because of your ords, and seareth to my not passing over the Jordan, and to my not going in unto the good land hich Jehovah thy God is giving to thee — an inheritance;
for I am dying in this land; I am not passing over the Jordan, and ye are passing over, and have possessed this good land.

’Take heed to yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of Jehovah your God, hich He hath made ith you, and have made to yourselves a graven image, a similitude of anything [concerning] hich Jehovah thy God hath charged thee:
for Jehovah thy God is a fire consuming — a zealous God.

’When thou begettest sons and sons’ sons, and ye have become old in the land, and have done corruptly, and have made a graven image, a similitude of anything, and have done the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to provoke Him to anger: —

I have caused to testify against you this day the heavens and the earth, that ye do perish utterly hastily from off the land hither ye are passing over the Jordan to possess it; ye do not prolong days upon it, but are utterly destroyed;
and Jehovah hath scattered you among the peoples, and ye have been left fe in number among the nations, hither Jehovah leadeth you,
and ye have served there gods, ork of man’s hands, ood and stone, hich see not, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
’And — ye have sought from thence Jehovah thy God, and hast found, hen thou seekest Him ith all thy heart, and ith all thy soul,
in distress [being] to thee, and all these things have found thee, in the latter end of the days, and thou hast turned back unto Jehovah thy God, and hast hearkened to His voice;
for a merciful God [is] Jehovah thy God; He doth not fail thee, nor destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers, hich He hath sorn to them.

’For, ask, I pray thee, at the former days hich have been before thee, from the day that God prepared man on the earth, and from the [one] end of the heavens even unto the [other] end of the heavens, hether there hath been as this great thing — or hath been heard like it?
Hath a people heard the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, thou — and doth live?

Or hath God tried to go in to take to Himself, a nation from the midst of a nation, by trials, by signs, and by onders, and by ar, and by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great terrors — according to all that Jehovah your God hath done to you, in Egypt, before your eyes?
Thou, thou hast been shen [it], to kno that Jehovah He [is] God; there is none else besides Him.
’From the heavens He hath caused thee to hear His voice, to instruct thee, and on earth He hath sheed thee His great fire, and His ords thou hast heard out of the midst of the fire.
’And because that He hath loved thy fathers, He doth also fix on their seed after them, and doth bring thee out, in His presence, by His great poer, from Egypt:
to dispossess nations greater and stronger than thou, from thy presence, to bring thee in to give to thee their land — an inheritance, as [at] this day.
’And thou hast knon to-day, and hast turned [it] back unto thy heart, that Jehovah He [is] God, in the heavens above, and on the earth beneath — there is none else;

and thou hast kept His statutes and His commands hich I am commanding thee to-day, so that it is ell to thee, and to thy sons after thee, and so that thou prolongest days on the ground hich Jehovah thy God is giving to thee — all the days.’
Then Moses separateth three cities beyond the Jordan, toards the sun-rising,
for the fleeing thither of the man-slayer, ho slayeth his neighbour unknoingly, and he is not hating him heretofore, and he hath fled unto one of these cities, and he hath lived:
Bezer, in the ilderness, in the land of the plain, of the Reubenite; and Ramoth, in Gilead, of the Gadite; and Golan, in Bashan, of the Manassahite.
And this [is] the la hich Moses hath set before the sons of Israel;
these [are] the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, hich Moses hath spoken unto the sons of Israel, in their coming out of Egypt,

beyond the Jordan, in the valley over-against Beth-Peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorite, ho is delling in Heshbon, hom Moses and the sons of Israel have smitten, in their coming out of Egypt,
and they possess his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, to kings of the Amorite ho [are] beyond the Jordan, [toards] the sun-rising;
from Aroer, hich [is] by the edge of the brook Arnon, even unto mount Sion, hich [is] Hermon —
and all the plain beyond the Jordan eastard, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
And Moses calleth unto all Israel, and saith unto them, ’Hear, Israel, the statutes and the judgments hich I am speaking in your ears to-day, and ye have learned them, and have observed to do them.
Jehovah our God made ith us a covenant in Horeb;
not ith our fathers hath Jehovah made this covenant, but ith us; e — these — here to-day — all of us alive.
Face to face hath Jehovah spoken ith you, in the mount, out of the midst of the fire;
I am standing beteen Jehovah and you, at that time, to declare to you the ord of Jehovah, for ye have been afraid from the presence of the fire, and ye have not gone up into the mount; saying:
’I Jehovah [am] thy God, ho hath brought thee out from the land of Egypt, from a house of servants.
’Thou hast no other gods in My presence.
’Thou dost not make to thee a graven image, any similitude hich [is] in the heavens above, and hich [is] in the earth beneath, and hich [is] in the aters under the earth;
thou dost not bo thyself to them nor serve them, for I Jehovah thy God [am] a zealous God, charging iniquity of fathers on children, and on a third [generation], and on a fourth, to those hating Me;
and doing kindness to thousands, to those loving Me, and to those keeping My commands.
’Thou dost not take up the Name of Jehovah thy God for a vain thing, for Jehovah doth not acquit him ho taketh up His Name for a vain thing.
’Observe the day of the sabbath — to sanctify it, as Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee;
six days thou dost labour, and hast done all thy ork,

and the seventh day [is] a sabbath to Jehovah thy God; thou dost not do any ork, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy handmaid, and thine ox, and thine ass, and all thy cattle, and thy sojourner ho [is] ithin thy gates; so that thy man-servant, and thy handmaid doth rest like thyself;

and thou hast remembered that a servant thou hast been in the land of Egypt, and Jehovah thy God is bringing thee out thence by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm; therefore hath Jehovah thy God commanded thee to keep the day of the sabbath.
’Honour thy father and thy mother, as Jehovah thy God hath commanded thee, so that thy days are prolonged, and so that it is ell ith thee, on the ground hich Jehovah thy God is giving to thee.
’Thou dost not murder.
’Thou dost not commit adultery.
’Thou dost not steal.
’Thou dost not anser against thy neighbour — a false testimony.
’Thou dost not desire thy neighbour’s ife; nor dost thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, and his man-servant, and his handmaid, his ox, and his ass, and anything hich [is] thy neighbour’s.

’These ords hath Jehovah spoken unto all your assembly, in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness — a great voice; and He hath not added, and He riteth them on to tables of stone, and giveth them unto me.
’And it cometh to pass as ye hear the voice out of the midst of the darkness, and of the mountain burning ith fire, that ye come near unto me, all the heads of your tribes, and your elders,

and say, Lo, Jehovah our God hath sheed us His honour, and His greatness; and His voice e have heard out of the midst of the fire; this day e have seen that God doth speak ith man — and he hath lived.
’And, no, hy do e die? for consume us doth this great fire — if e add to hear the voice of Jehovah our God any more — then e have died.
For ho of all flesh [is] he ho hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire like us — and doth live?
Dra near thou, and hear all that hich Jehovah our God saith, and thou, thou dost speak unto us all that hich Jehovah our God speaketh unto thee, and e have hearkened, and done it.

’And Jehovah heareth the voice of your ords, in your speaking unto me, and Jehovah saith unto me, I have heard the voice of the ords of this people hich they have spoken unto thee; they have done ell [in] all that they have spoken.
O that their heart had been thus to them, to fear Me, and to keep My commands all the days, that it may be ell ith them, and ith their sons — to the age!
’Go, say to them, Turn back for yourselves, to your tents;

and thou here stand thou ith Me, and let Me speak unto thee all the command, and the statutes, and the judgments hich thou dost teach them, and they have done in the land hich I am giving to them to possess it.
’And ye have observed to do as Jehovah your God hath commanded you, ye turn not aside — right or left;
in all the ay hich Jehovah your God hath commanded you ye alk, so that ye live, and [it is] ell ith you, and ye have prolonged days in the land hich ye possess.
’And this [is] the command, the statutes and the judgments hich Jehovah your God hath commanded to teach you, to do in the land hich ye are passing over thither to possess it,

so that thou dost fear Jehovah thy God, to keep all His statutes and His commands, hich I am commanding thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all days of thy life, and so that thy days are prolonged.

’And thou hast heard, O Israel, and observed to do, that it may be ell ith thee, and that thou mayest multiply exceedingly, as Jehovah, God of thy fathers, hath spoken to thee, [in] the land floing ith milk and honey.
’Hear, O Israel, Jehovah our God [is] one Jehovah;
and thou hast loved Jehovah thy God ith all thy heart, and ith all thy soul, and ith all thy might,
and these ords hich I am commanding thee to-day have been on thine heart,
and thou hast repeated them to thy sons, and spoken of them in thy sitting in thine house, and in thy alking in the ay, and in thy lying don, and in thy rising up,
and hast bound them for a sign upon thy hand, and they have been for frontlets beteen thine eyes,
and thou hast ritten them on door-posts of thy house, and on thy gates.

’And it hath been, hen Jehovah thy God doth bring thee in unto the land hich He hath sorn to thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to thee — cities great and good, hich thou hast not built,
and houses full of all good things hich thou hast not filled, and ells digged hich thou hast not digged, vineyards and olive-yards hich thou hast not planted, and thou hast eaten, and been satisfied;
’Take heed to thyself lest thou forget Jehovah ho hath brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
Jehovah thy God thou dost fear, and Him thou dost serve, and by His name thou dost sear;
ye do not go after other gods, of the gods of the peoples ho [are] round about you;
for a zealous God [is] Jehovah thy God in thy midst — lest the anger of Jehovah thy God burn against thee, and He hath destroyed thee from off the face of the ground.
’Ye do not try Jehovah your God as ye tried in Massah;
ye do diligently keep the commands of Jehovah your God, and His testimonies, and His statutes hich He hath commanded thee,
and thou hast done that hich is right and good in the eyes of Jehovah, so that it is ell ith thee, and thou hast gone in and possessed the good land hich Jehovah hath sorn to thy fathers,
to drive aay all thine enemies from thy presence, as Jehovah hath spoken.
’When thy son asketh thee hereafter, saying, What [are] the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, hich Jehovah our God hath commanded you?
then thou hast said to thy son, Servants e have been to Pharaoh in Egypt, and Jehovah bringeth us out of Egypt by a high hand;
and Jehovah giveth signs and onders, great and sad, on Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his house, before our eyes;
and us He hath brought out thence, in order to bring us in, to give to us the land hich He had sorn to our fathers.
And Jehovah commandeth us to do all these statutes, to fear Jehovah our God, for good to ourselves all the days, to keep us alive, as [at] this day;
and righteousness it is for us, hen e observe to do all this command before Jehovah our God, as He hath commanded us.

’When Jehovah thy God doth bring thee in unto the land hither thou art going in to possess it, and He hath cast out many nations from thy presence, the Hittite, and the Girgashite, and the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Perizzite, and the Hivite, and the Jebusite, seven nations more numerous and mighty than thou,
and Jehovah thy God hath given them before thee, and thou hast smitten them — thou dost utterly devote them — thou dost not make ith them a covenant, nor dost thou favour them.
’And thou dost not join in marriage ith them; thy daughter thou dost not give to his son, and his daughter thou dost not take to thy son,
for he doth turn aside thy son from after Me, and they have served other gods, and the anger of Jehovah hath burned against you, and hath destroyed thee hastily.
’But thus thou dost to them: their altars ye break don, and their standing pillars ye shiver, and their shrines ye cut don, and their graven images ye burn ith fire;
for a holy people [art] thou to Jehovah thy God; on thee hath Jehovah thy God fixed, to be to Him for a peculiar people, out of all the peoples ho [are] on the face of the ground.
’Not because of your being more numerous than any of the peoples hath Jehovah delighted in you, and fixeth on you, for ye [are] the least of all the peoples,

but because of Jehovah’s loving you, and because of His keeping the oath hich He hath sorn to your fathers, hath Jehovah brought you out by a strong hand, and doth ransom you from a house of servants, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
’And thou hast knon that Jehovah thy God He [is] God, the faithful God, keeping the covenant, and the kindness, to those loving Him, and to those keeping His commands — to a thousand generations,
and repaying to those hating Him, unto their face, to destroy them; He delayeth not to him ho is hating Him — unto his face, He repayeth to him —
and thou hast kept the command, and the statutes, and the judgments, hich I am commanding thee to-day to do them.
’And it hath been, because ye hear these judgments, and have kept, and done them, that Jehovah thy God hath kept to thee the covenant and the kindness hich He hath sorn to thy fathers,

and hath loved thee, and blessed thee, and multiplied thee, and hath blessed the fruit of thy omb, and the fruit of thy ground, thy corn, and thy ne ine, and thine oil, the increase of thine oxen, and the ealth of thy flock, on the ground hich He hath sorn to thy fathers to give to thee.
’Blessed art thou above all the peoples, there is not in thee a barren man or a barren oman — nor among your cattle;
and Jehovah hath turned aside from thee every sickness, and none of the evil diseases of Egypt (hich thou hast knon) doth He put on thee, and He hath put them on all hating thee.
’And thou hast consumed all the peoples hom Jehovah thy God is giving to thee; thine eye hath no pity on them, and thou dost not serve their gods, for a snare it [is] to thee.
’When thou sayest in thine heart, These nations [are] more numerous than I, ho am I able to dispossess them? —
thou art not afraid of them; thou dost surely remember that hich Jehovah thy God hath done to Pharaoh, and to all Egypt,

the great trials hich thine eyes have seen, and the signs, and the onders, and the strong hand, and the stretched-out arm, ith hich Jehovah thy God hath brought thee out; so doth Jehovah thy God to all the peoples of hose presence thou art afraid.
’And also the locust doth Jehovah thy God send among them, till the destruction of those ho are left, and of those ho are hidden from thy presence;
thou art not terrified by their presence, for Jehovah thy God [is] in thy midst, a God great and fearful.
’And Jehovah thy God hath cast out these nations from thy presence little [by] little, (thou art not able to consume them hastily, lest the beast of the field multiply against thee),
and Jehovah thy God hath given them before thee, and destroyed them — a great destruction — till their destruction;
and He hath given their kings into thy hand, and thou hast destroyed their name from under the heavens; no man doth station himself in thy presence till thou hast destroyed them.

’The graven images of their gods ye do burn ith fire; thou dost not desire the silver and gold on them, nor hast thou taken [it] to thyself, lest thou be snared by it, for the abomination of Jehovah thy God it [is];
and thou dost not bring in an abomination unto thy house — or thou hast been devoted like it; — thou dost utterly detest it, and thou dost utterly abominate it; for it [is] devoted.
’All the command hich I am commanding thee to-day ye observe to do, so that ye live, and have multiplied, and gone in, and possessed the land hich Jehovah hath sorn to your fathers;

and thou hast remembered all the ay hich Jehovah thy God hath caused thee to go these forty years in the ilderness, in order to humble thee to try thee, to kno that hich [is] in thy heart, hether thou dost keep His commands or not.

’And He doth humble thee, and cause thee to hunger and doth cause thee to eat the manna (hich thou hast not knon, even thy fathers have not knon), in order to cause thee to kno that not by bread alone doth man live, but by every produce of the mouth of Jehovah man doth live.
’Thy raiment hath not orn out from off thee, and thy foot hath not selled these forty years,
and thou hast knon, ith thy heart, that as a man chastiseth his son Jehovah thy God is chastising thee,
and thou hast kept the commands of Jehovah thy God, to alk in His ays, and to fear Him.
’For Jehovah thy God is bringing thee in unto a good land, a land of brooks of aters, of fountains, and of depths coming out in valley and in mountain:
a land of heat, and barley, and vine, and fig, and pomegranate; a land of oil olive and honey;
a land in hich ithout scarcity thou dost eat bread, thou dost not lack anything in it; a land hose stones [are] iron, and out of its mountains thou dost dig brass;
and thou hast eaten, and been satisfied, and hast blessed Jehovah thy God, on the good land hich he hath given to thee.
’Take heed to thyself, lest thou forget Jehovah thy God so as not to keep His commands, and His judgments, and His statutes hich I am commanding thee to-day;
lest thou eat, and hast been satisfied, and good houses dost build, and hast inhabited;
and thy herd and thy flock be multiplied, and silver and gold be multiplied to thee; and all that is thine be multiplied:
’And thy heart hath been high, and thou hast forgotten Jehovah thy God (ho is bringing thee out of the land of Egypt, out of a house of servants;
ho is causing thee to go in the great and the terrible ilderness — burning serpent, and scorpion, and thirst — here there is no ater; ho is bringing out to thee aters from the flinty rock;
ho is causing thee to eat manna in the ilderness, hich thy fathers have not knon, in order to humble thee, and in order to try thee, to do thee good in thy latter end),
and thou hast said in thy heart, My poer, and the might of my hand, hath made for me this ealth:
’And thou hast remembered Jehovah thy God, for He it [is] ho is giving to thee poer to make ealth, in order to establish His covenant hich He hath sorn to thy fathers as [at] this day.
’And it hath been — if thou really forget Jehovah thy God, and hast gone after other gods, and served them, and boed thyself to them, I have testified against you to-day that ye do utterly perish;
as the nations hom Jehovah is destroying from your presence, so ye perish; because ye hearken not to the voice of Jehovah your God.
’Hear, Israel, thou art passing over to-day the Jordan, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself; cities great and fenced in the heavens;
a people great and tall, sons of Anakim, hom thou — thou hast knon, (and thou — thou hast heard: Who doth station himself before sons of Anak?)

and thou hast knon to-day, that Jehovah thy God [is] He ho is passing over before thee — a fire consuming; He doth destroy them, and He doth humble them before thee, and thou hast dispossessed them, and destroyed them hastily, as Jehovah hath spoken to thee.

’Thou dost not speak in thy heart (in Jehovah thy God’s driving them aay from before thee), saying, For my righteousness hath Jehovah brought me in to possess this land, seeing for the ickedness of these nations is Jehovah dispossessing them from thy presence;

not for thy righteousness, and for the uprightness of thy heart, art thou going in to possess their land; but for the ickedness of these nations is Jehovah thy God dispossessing them from before thee; and in order to establish the ord hich Jehovah hath sorn to thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob;
and thou hast knon, that not for thy righteousness is Jehovah thy God giving to thee this good land to possess it, for a people stiff of neck thou [art].

’Remember — do not forget — that [ith] hich thou hast made Jehovah thy God roth in the ilderness; even from the day that thou hast come out of the land of Egypt till your coming in unto this place rebels ye have been ith Jehovah;
even in Horeb ye have made Jehovah roth, and Jehovah sheeth Himself angry against you — to destroy you.

’In my going up into the mount to receive the tables of stone (tables of the covenant hich Jehovah hath made ith you), and I abide in the mount forty days and forty nights; bread I have not eaten, and ater I have not drunk;

and Jehovah giveth unto me the to tables of stone ritten ith the finger of God, and on them according to all the ords hich Jehovah hath spoken ith you in the mount, out of the midst of the fire, in the day of the assembly.
’And it cometh to pass, at the end of forty days and forty nights, Jehovah hath given unto me the to tables of stone — tables of the covenant,

and Jehovah saith unto me, Rise, go don, hasten from this, for thy people hath done corruptly, hom thou hast brought out of Egypt; they have turned aside hastily out of the ay hich I have commanded them — they have made to themselves a molten thing!
’And Jehovah speaketh unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and lo, a people stiff of neck it [is];
desist from Me, and I destroy them, and blot out their name from under the heavens, and I make thee become a nation more mighty and numerous than it.
’And I turn, and come don from the mount, and the mount is burning ith fire, and the to tables of the covenant on my to hands,
and I see, and lo, ye have sinned against Jehovah your God; ye have made to yourselves a molten calf; ye have turned aside hastily out of the ay hich Jehovah hath commanded you.
’And I lay hold on the to tables, and cast them out of my to hands, and break them before your eyes,

and I thro myself before Jehovah, as at first, forty days and forty nights; bread I have not eaten, and ater I have not drunk, because of all your sins hich ye have sinned, by doing the evil thing in the eyes of Jehovah, to make Him angry.
’For I have been afraid because of the anger and the fury ith hich Jehovah hath been roth against you, to destroy you; and Jehovah doth hearken unto me also at this time.
’And ith Aaron hath Jehovah sheed himself very angry, to destroy him, and I pray also for Aaron at that time;

and your sin, hich ye have made — the calf — I have taken, and I burn it ith fire, and beat it, grinding ell till that it [is] small as dust, and I cast its dust unto the brook hich is going don out of the mount.
’And in Taberah, and in Massah, and in Kibroth-Hattaavah, ye have been making Jehovah roth:

and in Jehovah’s sending you from Kadesh-Barnea, saying, Go up, and possess the land hich I have given to you, then ye provoke the mouth of Jehovah your God, and have not given credence to Him, nor hearkened to His voice;
rebels ye have been ith Jehovah from the day of my knoing you.
’And I thro myself before Jehovah, the forty days and the forty nights, as I had thron myself, for Jehovah hath said — to destroy you;
and I pray unto Jehovah, and say, Lord Jehovah, destroy not Thy people, and Thine inheritance, hom Thou hast ransomed in Thy greatness; hom Thou hast brought out of Egypt ith a strong hand;
be mindful of Thy servants, of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, turn not unto the stiffness of this people, and unto its ickedness, and unto its sin;

lest the land say from hich Thou hast brought us out, Because of Jehovah’s ant of ability to bring them in unto the land of hich He hath spoken to them, and because of His hating them, He brought them out to put them to death in the ilderness;
and they [are] Thy people, and Thine inheritance, hom Thou hast brought out by Thy great poer, and by Thy stretched-out arm!
’At that time hath Jehovah said unto me, Grave for thee to tables of stone, like the first, and come up unto Me, into the mount, and thou hast made for thee an ark of ood,
and I rite on the tables the ords hich ere on the first tables, hich thou hast broken, and thou hast placed them in the ark;
and I make an ark of shittim ood, and grave to tables of stone like the first, and go up to the mount, and the to tables in my hand.

’And He riteth on the tables, according to the first riting, the Ten Matters, hich Jehovah hath spoken unto you in the mount, out of the midst of the fire, in the day of the assembly, and Jehovah giveth them unto me,
and I turn and come don from the mount, and put the tables in the ark hich I had made, and they are there, as Jehovah commanded me.
’And the sons of Israel have journeyed from Beeroth of the sons of Jaakan to Mosera, there Aaron died, and he is buried there, and Eleazar his son doth act as priest in his stead;
thence they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of brooks of ater.
’At that time hath Jehovah separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of Jehovah, to stand before Jehovah, to serve Him, and to bless in His name, unto this day,
therefore there hath not been to Levi a portion and inheritance ith his brethren; Jehovah Himself [is] his inheritance, as Jehovah thy God hath spoken to him.
’And I — I have stood in the mount, as the former days, forty days and forty nights, and Jehovah hearkeneth unto me also at that time; Jehovah hath not illed to destroy thee.
’And Jehovah saith unto me, Rise, go to journey before the people, and they go in and possess the land hich I have sorn to their fathers to give to them.
’And no, Israel, hat is Jehovah thy God asking from thee, except to fear Jehovah thy God, to alk in all His ays, and to love Him, and to serve Jehovah thy God ith all thy heart, and ith all thy soul,
to keep the commands of Jehovah, and His statutes hich I am commanding thee to-day, for good to thee?
’Lo, to Jehovah thy God [are] the heavens and the heavens of the heavens, the earth and all that [is] in it;
only in thy fathers hath Jehovah delighted — to love them, and He doth fix on their seed after them — on you, out of all the peoples as [at] this day;
and ye have circumcised the foreskin of your heart, and your neck ye do not harden any more;
for Jehovah your God — He [is] God of the gods, and Lord of the lords; God, the great, the mighty, and the fearful; ho accepteth not persons, nor taketh a bribe;
He is doing the judgment of fatherless and ido, and loving the sojourner, to give to him bread and raiment.
’And ye have loved the sojourner, for sojourners ye ere in the land of Egypt.
’Jehovah thy God thou dost fear, Him thou dost serve, and to Him thou dost cleave, and by His name thou dost sear.
He [is] thy praise, and He [is] thy God, ho hath done ith thee these great and fearful [things] hich thine eyes have seen:
ith seventy persons did thy fathers go don to Egypt, and no hath Jehovah thy God made thee as stars of the heavens for multitude.
’And thou hast loved Jehovah thy God, and kept His charge, and His statutes, and His judgments, and His commands, all the days;
and ye have knon to-day — for it is not your sons ho have not knon, and ho have not seen the chastisement of Jehovah your God, His greatness, His strong hand, and His stretched-out arm,
and His signs, and His doings, hich He hath done in the midst of Egypt, to Pharaoh king of Egypt, and to all his land;

and that hich He hath done to the force of Egypt, to its horses, and to its chariot, hen He hath caused the aters of the Red Sea to flo against their faces in their pursuing after them, and Jehovah destroyeth them, unto this day;
and that hich He hath done to you in the ilderness, till your coming in unto this place;

and that hich He hath done to Dathan, and to Abiram, sons of Eliab, sons of Reuben, hen the earth hath opened her mouth and salloeth them, and their houses, and their tents, and all that liveth, hich is at their feet, in the midst of all Israel:
’ — But [it is] your eyes hich are seeing all the great ork of Jehovah, hich He hath done;
and ye have kept all the command hich I am commanding thee to-day, so that ye are strong, and have gone in, and possessed the land hither ye are passing over to possess it,
and so that ye prolong days on the ground hich Jehovah hath sorn to your fathers to give to them and to their seed — a land floing ith milk and honey.
’For the land hither thou art going in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt hence ye have come out, here thou soest thy seed, and hast atered ith thy foot, as a garden of the green herb;
but the land hither ye are passing over to possess it, [is] a land of hills and valleys; of the rain of the heavens it drinketh ater;
a land hich Jehovah thy God is searching; continually [are] the eyes of Jehovah thy God upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the latter end of the year.
’And it hath been — if thou hearken diligently unto My commands hich I am commanding you to-day, to love Jehovah your God, and to serve Him ith all your heart, and ith all your soul —
that I have given the rain of your land in its season — sprinkling and gathered — and thou hast gathered thy corn, and thy ne ine, and thine oil,
and I have given herbs in thy field for thy cattle, and thou hast eaten, and been satisfied.
’Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be enticed, and ye have turned aside, and served other gods, and boed yourselves to them,

and the anger of Jehovah hath burned against you, and He hath restrained the heavens, and there is no rain, and the ground doth not give her increase, and ye have perished hastily from off the good land hich Jehovah is giving to you.
’And ye have placed these my ords on your heart, and on your soul, and have bound them for a sign on your hand, and they have been for frontlets beteen your eyes;
and ye have taught them to your sons, by speaking of them in thy sitting in thy house, and in thy going in the ay, and in thy lying don, and in thy rising up,
and hast ritten them on the side-posts of thy house, and on thy gates,
so that your days are multiplied, and the days of your sons, on the ground hich Jehovah hath sorn to your fathers to give to them, as the days of the heavens on the earth.
’For, if ye diligently keep all this command hich I am commanding you — to do it, to love Jehovah your God, to alk in all His ays, and to cleave to Him,
then hath Jehovah dispossessed all these nations from before you, and ye have possessed nations, greater and mightier than you;
every place on hich the sole of your foot treadeth is yours; from the ilderness, and Lebanon, from the river, the river Phrat, even unto the farther sea is your border;
no man doth station himself in your presence; your dread and your fear doth Jehovah your God put on the face of all the land on hich ye tread, as He hath spoken to you.
’See, I am setting before you to-day a blessing and a reviling:
the blessing, hen ye hearken unto the commands of Jehovah your God, hich I am commanding you to-day;
and the reviling, if ye do not hearken unto the commands of Jehovah your God, and have turned aside out of the ay hich I am commanding you to-day, to go after other gods hich ye have not knon.
’And it hath been, hen Jehovah thy God doth bring thee in unto the land hither thou art going in to possess it, that thou hast given the blessing on mount Gerizim, and the reviling on mount Ebal;
are they not beyond the Jordan, behind the ay of the going in of the sun, in the land of the Canaanite, ho is delling in the plain over-against Gilgal, near the oaks of Moreh?
for ye are passing over the Jordan to go in to possess the land hich Jehovah your God is giving to you; and ye have possessed it, and delt in it,
and observed to do all the statutes and the judgments hich I am setting before you to day.
’These [are] the statutes and the judgments hich ye observe to do in the land hich Jehovah, God of thy fathers, hath given to thee to possess it, all the days that ye are living on the ground:
ye do utterly destroy all the places here the nations hich ye are dispossessing served their gods, on the high mountains, and on the heights, and under every green tree;

and ye have broken don their altars, and shivered their standing pillars, and their shrines ye burn ith fire, and graven images of their gods ye cut don, and have destroyed their name out of that place.
’Ye do not do so to Jehovah your God;
but unto the place hich Jehovah your God doth choose out of all your tribes to put His name there, to His tabernacle ye seek, and thou hast entered thither,

and hast brought in thither your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and your vos, and your free-ill offerings, and the firstlings of your herd and of your flock;
and ye have eaten there before Jehovah your God, and have rejoiced in every putting forth of your hand, ye and your households, ith hich Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee.
’Ye do not do according to all that e are doing here to-day, each anything that is right in his on eyes,
for ye have not come in hitherto unto the rest, and unto the inheritance, hich Jehovah thy God is giving to thee;

and ye have passed over the Jordan, and have delt in the land hich Jehovah your God is causing you to inherit, and He hath given rest to you from all your enemies round about, and ye have delt confidently:

’And it hath been, the place on hich Jehovah your God doth fix to cause His name to tabernacle there, thither ye bring in all that hich I am commanding you, your burnt-offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave-offering of your hand, and all the choice of your vos hich ye vo to Jehovah;

and ye have rejoiced before Jehovah your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your men-servants, and your handmaids, and the Levite ho [is] ithin your gates, for he hath no part and inheritance ith you.
’Take heed to thee, lest thou cause thy burnt-offerings to ascend in any place hich thou seest,
except in the place hich Jehovah doth choose in one of thy tribes, there thou dost cause thy burnt-offerings to ascend, and there thou dost do all that hich I am commanding thee.

’Only, ith all the desire of thy soul thou dost sacrifice, and hast eaten flesh according to the blessing of Jehovah thy God hich He hath given to thee, in all thy gates; the unclean and the clean do eat it, as of the roe, and as of the hart.
’Only, the blood ye do not eat — on the earth thou dost pour it as ater;

thou art not able to eat ithin thy gates the tithe of thy corn, and of thy ne ine, and thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herd and of thy flock, and any of thy vos hich thou voest, and thy free-ill offerings, and heave-offering of thy hand;

but before Jehovah thy God thou dost eat it, in the place hich Jehovah thy God doth fix on, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy man-servant, and thy handmaid, and the Levite ho [is] ithin thy gates, and thou hast rejoiced before Jehovah thy God in every putting forth of thy hand;
take heed to thee lest thou forsake the Levite all thy days on thy ground.

’When Jehovah thy God doth enlarge thy border, as He hath spoken to thee, and thou hast said, Let me eat flesh — for thy soul desireth to eat flesh — of all the desire of thy soul thou dost eat flesh.

’When the place is far from thee hich Jehovah thy God doth choose to put His name there, then thou hast sacrificed of thy herd and of thy flock hich Jehovah hath given to thee, as I have commanded thee, and hast eaten ithin thy gates, of all the desire of thy soul;
only, as the roe and the hart is eaten, so dost thou eat it; the unclean and the clean doth alike eat it.
’Only, be sure not to eat the blood, for the blood [is] the life, and thou dost not eat the life ith the flesh;
thou dost not eat it, on the earth thou dost pour it as ater;
thou dost not eat it, in order that it may be ell ith thee, and ith thy sons after thee, hen thou dost that hich [is] right in the eyes of Jehovah.
’Only, thy holy things hich thou hast, and thy vos, thou dost take up, and hast gone in unto the place hich Jehovah doth choose,

and thou hast made thy burnt-offerings — the flesh and the blood — on the altar of Jehovah thy God; and the blood of thy sacrifices is poured out by the altar of Jehovah thy God, and the flesh thou dost eat.
