And there is none calling in Thy name, Stirring up himself to lay hold on Thee, For Thou hast hid Thy face from us, And thou meltest us aay by our iniquities.
And no, O Jehovah, thou [art] our Father, We [are] the clay, and Thou our Framer, And the ork of Thy hand — all of us.
Be not roth, O Jehovah, very sore, Nor for ever remember iniquity, Lo, look attentively, e beseech Thee, Thy people [are] e all.
Thy holy cities have been a ilderness, Zion a ilderness hath been, Jerusalem a desolation.
Our holy and our beautiful house, Where praise Thee did our fathers, Hath become burnt ith fire, And all our desirable things have become a aste.
For these dost Thou refrain Thyself, Jehovah? Thou art silent, and dost afflict us very sore!’
I have been inquired of by those ho asked not, I have been found by those ho sought Me not, I have said, ’Behold Me, behold Me,’ Unto a nation not calling in My name.
I have spread out My hands all the day Unto an apostate people, Who are going in the ay not good after their on thoughts.
The people ho are provoking Me to anger, To My face continually, Sacrificing in gardens, and making perfume on the bricks:
Who are delling among sepulchres, And lodge in reserved places, Who are eating flesh of the so, And a piece of abominable things — their vessels.
Who are saying, ’Keep to thyself, come not nigh to me, For I have declared thee unholy.’ These [are] a smoke in Mine anger, A fire burning all the day.
Lo, it is ritten before Me: ’I am not silent, but have recompensed; And I have recompensed into their bosom,

Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, said Jehovah, Who have made perfume on the mountains, And on the heights have reproached Me, And I have measured their former ork into their bosom.’
Thus said Jehovah: As the ne ine is found in the cluster, And one hath said, ’Destroy it not for a blessing [is] in it,’ So I do for My servants’ sake, not to destroy the hole.
And I have brought out from Jacob a seed, And from Judah a possessor of My mount, And possess it do My chosen ones, And My servants do dell there.
And Sharon hath been for the habitation of a flock, And the valley of Achor for the lying don of a herd, For My people ho have sought Me.
And ye [are] those forsaking Jehovah, Who are forgetting My holy mountain, Who are setting in array for Gad a table, And ho are filling for Meni a mixture.

And I have numbered you for the sord, And all of you for slaughter bo don, Because I called, and ye have not ansered, I have spoken, and ye have not hearkened, And ye do the evil thing in Mine eyes, And on that hich I desired not — fixed.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, My servants do eat, and ye do hunger, Lo, My servants do drink, and ye do thirst, Lo, My servants rejoice, and ye are ashamed,
Lo, My servants sing from joy of heart, And ye cry from pain of heart, And from breaking of spirit ye do hol.
And ye have left your name For an oath for My chosen ones, And the Lord Jehovah hath put thee to death, And to His servants He giveth another name.

So that he ho is blessing himself in the earth, Doth bless himself In the God of faithfulness, And he ho is searing in the earth, Doth sear by the God of faithfulness, Because the former distresses have been forgotten, And because they have been hid from Mine eyes.
For, lo, I am creating ne heavens, and a ne earth, And the former things are not remembered, Nor do they ascend on the heart.
But joy ye, and rejoice for ever, that I [am] Creator, For, lo, I am creating Jerusalem a rejoicing, And her people a joy.
And I have rejoiced in Jerusalem, And have joyed in My people, And not heard in her any more Is the voice of eeping, and the voice of crying.
There is not thence any more a suckling of days, And an aged man ho doth not complete his days, For the youth a hundred years old dieth, And the sinner, a hundred years old, is lightly esteemed.
And they have built houses, and inhabited, And planted vineyards, and eaten their fruit.
They do not build, and another inhabit, They do not plant, and another eat, For as the days of a tree [are] the days of My people, And the ork of their hands ear out do My chosen ones.
They labour not for a vain thing, Nor do they bring forth for trouble, For the seed of the blessed of Jehovah [are] they, And their offspring ith them.
And it hath come to pass, They do not yet call, and I anser, They are yet speaking, and I hear.
Wolf and lamb do feed as one, And a lion as an ox eateth stra, As to the serpent — dust [is] its food, They do no evil, nor destroy, In all My holy mountain, said Jehovah!
Thus said Jehovah: The heavens [are] My throne, And the earth My footstool, Where [is] this — the house that ye build for Me? And here [is] this — the place — My rest?
And all these My hand hath made, And all these things are, An affirmation of Jehovah! And unto this one I look attentively, Unto the humble and bruised in spirit, And ho is trembling at My ord.

Whoso slaughtereth the ox smiteth a man, Whoso sacrificeth the lamb beheadeth a dog, Whoso is bringing up a present — The blood of a so, Whoso is making mention of frankincense, Is blessing iniquity. Yea, they have fixed on their on ays, And in their abominations their soul hath delighted.

I also — I fix on their vexations, And their fears I bring in to them, Because I have called, and there is none ansering, I spake, and they have not hearkened, And they do the evil things in Mine eyes, And on that hich I desired not — fixed.

Hear a ord of Jehovah, Ye ho are trembling unto His ord, Said have your brethren ho are hating you, Who are driving you out, for My name’s sake: ’Honoured is Jehovah, and e look on your joy,’ But they are ashamed.
A voice of noise [is] from the city, a voice from the temple, The voice of Jehovah, giving recompence to His enemies.
Before she is pained she hath brought forth, Before a pang cometh to her, She hath delivered a male.
Who hath heard anything like this? Who hath seen anything like these? Is earth caused to bring forth in one day? Born is a nation at once? For she hath been pained, Zion also hath borne her sons.
’Do I bring to the birth, And not cause to bring forth?’ saith Jehovah, ’Am not I He ho is causing to beget? I have also restrained,’ said thy God.
Rejoice ye ith Jerusalem, And be glad in her, all ye loving her, Rejoice ye ith her for joy, All ye are mourning for her,
So that ye suck, and have been satisfied, From the breast of her consolations, So that ye ring out, and have delighted yourselves From the abundance of her honour.

For thus said Jehovah: ’Lo, I am stretching out to her peace as a river, And as an overfloing stream the honour of nations, And ye have sucked, on the side ye are carried, And on the knees ye are dandled.
As one hom his mother comforteth, so do I comfort you, Yea, in Jerusalem ye are comforted.
And ye have seen, and rejoiced hath your heart, And your bones as tender grass do flourish, And the hand of Jehovah hath been knon unto His servants, And He hath been indignant ith His enemies.
For, lo, Jehovah in fire cometh, And as a hurricane His chariots, To refresh in fury His anger, And His rebuke in flames of fire.
For by fire and by His sord, Doth Jehovah do judgment ith all flesh. And many have been Jehovah’s pierced ones.’
Those sanctifying and cleansing themselves at the gardens, After Ahad in the midst, Eating flesh of the so, And of the abomination, and of the mouse, Together are consumed, An affirmation of Jehovah.
And I — their orks and their thoughts, I come to gather all the nations and tongues, And they have come and seen My honour.

And I have set among them a sign, And have sent out of them those escaping unto the nations, (Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, draing bo, Tubal and Javan, the isles that are far off,) Who have not heard My fame, nor seen Mine honour, And they have declared Mine honour among nations.

And they have brought all your brethren out of all the nations, A present to Jehovah, On horses, and on chariot, and on litters, And on mules, and on dromedaries, Unto My holy mountain Jerusalem, said Jehovah, As the sons of Israel bring the present in a clean vessel, Into the house of Jehovah.
And also of them I take for priests, For Levites, said Jehovah.
For, as the ne heavens and the ne earth that I am making, Are standing before Me, An affirmation of Jehovah! So remain doth your seed and your name.
And it hath been from month to month, And from sabbath to sabbath, Come do all flesh to bo themselves before Me, Said Jehovah.

And they have gone forth, And looked on the carcases of the men Who are transgressing against me, For their orm dieth not, And their fire is not quenched, And they have been an abhorrence to all flesh!
Words of Jeremiah son of Hilkiah, of the priests ho [are] in Anathoth, in the land of Benjamin,
unto hom the ord of Jehovah hath been in the days of Josiah son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his reign,
and it is in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, till the completion of the eleventh year of Zedekiah son of Josiah, king of Judah, till the removal of Jerusalem in the fifth month.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Before I form thee in the belly, I have knon thee; and before thou comest forth from the omb I have separated thee, a prophet to nations I have made thee.’
And I say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah! lo, I have not knon — to speak, for I [am] a youth.’
And Jehovah saith unto me, ’Do not say, I [am] a youth, for to all to hom I send thee thou goest, and all that I command thee thou speakest.
Be not afraid of their faces, for ith thee [am] I to deliver thee, — an affirmation of Jehovah.’
And Jehovah putteth forth His hand, and striketh against my mouth, and Jehovah saith unto me, ’Lo, I have put my ords in thy mouth.
See, I have charged thee this day concerning the nations, and concerning the kingdoms, to pluck up, and to break don, and to destroy, and to thro don, to build, and to plant.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying, ’What art thou seeing, Jeremiah?’ And I say, ’A rod of an almond tree I am seeing.’
And Jehovah saith unto me, ’Thou hast ell seen: for I am atching over My ord to do it.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me a second time, saying, ’What art thou seeing?’ And I say, ’A blon pot I am seeing, and its face [is] from the north.’
And Jehovah saith unto me, ’From the north is the evil loosed against all inhabitants of the land.

For, lo, I am calling for all families of the kingdoms of the north, — an affirmation of Jehovah — and they have come, and put each his throne at the opening of the gates of Jerusalem, and by its alls round about, and by all cities of Judah.
And I have spoken My judgments ith them concerning all their evil, in that they have forsaken Me, and make perfume to other gods, and bo themselves to the orks of their on hands.
’And thou, thou dost gird up thy loins, and hast arisen, and spoken unto them all that I command thee: be not affrighted because of them, lest I affright thee before them.

And I, lo, I have given thee this day for a fenced city, and for an iron pillar, and for brazen alls over all the land, to the kings of Judah, to its heads, to its priests, and to the people of the land;
and they have fought against thee, and they prevail not against thee; for ith thee [am] I, — an affirmation of Jehovah — to deliver thee.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’Go, and thou hast called in the ears of Jerusalem, saying, Thus said Jehovah: I have remembered for thee The kindness of thy youth, the love of thine espousals, Thy going after Me in a ilderness, in a land not son.
Holy [is] Israel to Jehovah, The first-fruit of His increase, All consuming him are guilty, Evil cometh in unto them, an affirmation of Jehovah.
Hear a ord of Jehovah, O house of Jacob, And all ye families of the house of Israel.
Thus said Jehovah: What — have your fathers found in Me perversity, That they have gone far off from Me, And go after the vanity, and become vain,

And have not said, Where [is] Jehovah, Who bringeth us up out of the land of Egypt, Who leadeth us in a ilderness, In a land of deserts and pits, In a dry land, and of death-shade, In a land — none hath passed through it, Nor delt hath man there?’
Yea, I bring you in to a land of fruitful fields, To eat its fruit and its goodness, And ye come in and defile My land, And Mine inheritance have made an abomination.

The priests have not said, ’Where [is] Jehovah?’ And those handling the la have not knon Me. And the shepherds transgressed against Me, And the prophets have prophesied by Baal, And after those ho profit not have gone.
Therefore, yet I plead ith you, An affirmation of Jehovah, And ith your sons’ sons I plead.
For, pass to the isles of Chittim, and see, And to Kedar send, and consider ell, And see if there hath been like this:
Hath a nation changed gods? (And they [are] no gods!) And My people hath changed its honour For that hich doth not profit.
Be astonished, ye heavens, at this, Yea, be frightened, be greatly asted, An affirmation of Jehovah.
For to evils hath My people done, Me they have forsaken, a fountain of living aters, To he out for themselves ells — broken ells, That contain not the aters.
A servant [is] Israel? Is he a child of the house? Wherefore hath he been for a prey?
Against him roar do young lions, They have given forth their voice, And make his land become a desolation, His cities have been burnt ithout inhabitant.
Also sons of Noph and Tahapanes Consume thee — the cron of the head!
Dost thou not do this to thyself? [By] thy forsaking Jehovah thy God, At the time He is leading thee in the ay?
And no, hat — to thee in the ay of Egypt, To drink the aters of Sihor? And hat — to thee in the ay of Asshur, To drink the aters of the River?

Instruct thee doth thy ickedness, And thy backslidings reprove thee, Kno and see that an evil and a bitter thing [Is] thy forsaking Jehovah thy God, And My fear not being on thee, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah of Hosts.
For from of old thou hast broken thy yoke, Dran aay thy bands, and sayest, ’I do not serve,’ For, on every high height, and under every green tree, Thou art andering — a harlot.
And I planted thee a choice vine, holly a true seed, And ho hast thou been turned to Me, To the degenerate shoots of a strange vine?
But though thou dost ash ith nitre, And dost multiply to thyself soap, Marked is thine iniquity before Me, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
Ho sayest thou, ’I have not been defiled, After the Baalim I have not gone?’ See thy ay in a valley, kno hat thou hast done, A sift dromedary inding her ays,
A ild ass accustomed to a ilderness, In the desire of her soul she hath salloed up ind, Her meeting — ho doth turn her back? None seeking her do eary themselves, In her month they find her.
Withhold thy foot from being unshod, And thy throat from thirst, And thou sayest, ’It is incurable, No, for I have loved strangers, and after them I go.’
As the shame of a thief hen he is found, So put to shame have been the house of Israel, They, their kings, their heads, And their priests, and their prophets,

Saying to ood, ’My father [art] thou!’ And to a stone, ’Thou hast brought me forth,’ For they turned unto me the back and not the face, And in the time of their vexation, They say, ’Arise Thou, and save us.’
And here [are] thy gods, that thou hast made to thyself? Let them arise, if they may save thee, In the time of thy vexation, For — the number of thy cities have been thy gods, O Judah,
Why do ye strive ith Me? All of you have transgressed against Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
In vain I have smitten your sons, Instruction they have not accepted, Devoured hath your sord your prophets, As a destroying lion.
O generation, see ye the ord of Jehovah: A ilderness have I been to Israel? A land of thick darkness? Wherefore have My people said, ’We mourned, We come not in again unto Thee.’
Doth a virgin forget her ornaments? A bride her bands? And My people have forgotten Me days ithout number.
What — dost thou make pleasing thy ays to seek love? Therefore even the icked thou hast taught thy ays.
Also in thy skirts hath been found the blood of innocent needy souls, Not by digging have I found them, but upon all these.
And thou sayest, ’Because I have been innocent, Surely turned back hath His anger from me?’ Lo, I have been judged ith thee, Because of thy saying, ’I have not sinned.’
What? thou art very vile to repeat thy ay, Even of Egypt thou art ashamed, As thou hast been ashamed of Asshur,
Also from this thou goest out, And thy hands on thy head, For Jehovah hath kicked at thy confidences, And thou dost not give prosperity to them!

Saying, ’Lo, one sendeth aay his ife, And she hath gone from him, And she hath been to another man, Doth he turn back unto her again? Greatly defiled is not that land? And thou hast committed horedom ith many lovers, And turn again to Me, an affirmation of Jehovah.

Lift thine eyes to the high places, and see, Where hast thou not been lain ith? On the ays thou hast sat for them, As an Arab in a ilderness, And thou defilest the land, By thy fornications, and by thy ickedness.
And ithheld are shoers, and gathered rain hath not been. The forehead of a horish oman thou hast, Thou hast refused to be ashamed.
Hast thou not henceforth called to Me, ’My father, Thou [art] the leader of my youth?
Doth He keep to the age? atch for ever?’ Lo, these things thou hast spoken, And thou dost the evil things, and prevailest.

And Jehovah saith unto me, in the days of Josiah the king, ’Hast thou seen that hich backsliding Israel hath done? She is going on every high mountain, and unto the place of every green tree, and committeth fornication there.
And I say, after her doing all these, Unto Me thou dost turn back, and she hath not turned back, and see [it] doth her treacherous sister Judah.

And I see hen (for all the causes hereby backsliding Israel committed adultery) I have sent her aay, and I give the bill of her divorce unto her, that treacherous Judah her sister hath not feared, and goeth and committeth fornication — she also.
And it hath come to pass, from the vileness of her fornication, that the land is defiled, and she committeth fornication ith stone and ith ood.
And even in all this her treacherous sister Judah hath not turned back unto Me ith all her heart, but ith falsehood, an affirmation of Jehovah.’
And Jehovah saith unto me: ’Justified herself hath backsliding Israel, More than treacherous Judah.

Go, and thou hast proclaimed these ords toard the north, and hast said, Turn back, O backsliding Israel, An affirmation of Jehovah! I cause not Mine anger to fall upon you, For I [am] kind, an affirmation of Jehovah, I atch not to the age.

Only, kno thine iniquity, For against Jehovah thy God thou hast transgressed, And thou dost scatter thy ays to strangers, Under every green tree, And to My voice thou hast not hearkened, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Turn back, O backsliding sons, An affirmation of Jehovah. For I have ruled over you, And taken you one of a city, and to of a family, And have brought you to Zion,
And I have given to you shepherds According to Mine on heart, And they have fed you ith knoledge and understanding.

And it hath come to pass, hen ye are multiplied, And have been fruitful in the land, In those days — an affirmation of Jehovah, They say not any more, ’The ark of the covenant of Jehovah,’ Nor doth it go up on the heart, Nor do they remember concerning it, Nor do they inspect, nor is it made again.

At that time they cry to Jerusalem, ’O throne of Jehovah,’ And gathered unto her hath been all the nations, For the name of Jehovah, to Jerusalem, Nor do they go any more after the stubbornness of their evil heart.
In those days do the house of Judah Go unto the house of Israel, And they come together from the land of the south, unto the land That I caused your fathers to inherit.

And I have said, Ho do I put thee among the sons, And give to thee a desirable land, A beauteous inheritance of the hosts of nations, And I say, My father — ye do call to Me, And from after Me ye do not turn back.
But — a oman hath deceived her friend, So ye have dealt treacherously ith Me, O house of Israel, an affirmation of Jehovah.
A voice on high places is heard — eeping, Supplications of the sons of Israel, For they have made perverse their ay, They have forgotten Jehovah their God.
Turn back, O backsliding sons, I cause your backslidings to cease. — Behold us, e have come to Thee, For Thou [art] Jehovah our God.
Surely in vain from the heights, The multitude of mountains — Surely in Jehovah our God [is] the salvation of Israel.
And the shameful thing hath devoured The labour of our fathers from our youth, Their flock and their herd, Their sons and their daughters.

We have lain don in our shame, and cover us doth our confusion, For against Jehovah our God e have sinned, We, and our fathers, from our youth even unto this day, Nor have e hearkened to the voice of Jehovah our God!
If thou dost turn back, O Israel, An affirmation of Jehovah, unto Me turn back, And if thou dost turn aside Thine abominations from My face, Then thou dost not bemoan.
And thou hast sorn — Jehovah liveth, In truth, in judgment, and in righteousness, And blessed themselves in Him have nations, And in Him they boast themselves.
For thus said Jehovah, To the man of Judah, and to Jerusalem: Till for yourselves tillage, And do not so unto the thorns.

Be circumcised to Jehovah, And turn aside the foreskins of your heart, O man of Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem, Lest My fury go out as fire, and hath burned, And there is none quenching, Because of the evil of your doings.
Declare in Judah, and in Jerusalem sound, And say ye, ’Blo a trumpet in the land,’ Call ye fully, and say ye: ’Be gathered, and e go in to the fenced city.’
Lift up an ensign Zionard, Strengthen yourselves, stand not still, For evil I am bringing in from the north, And a great destruction.
Gone up hath a lion from his thicket, And a destroyer of nations hath journeyed, He hath come forth from his place To make thy land become a desolation, Thy cities are laid aste, ithout inhabitant.
For this, gird on sackcloth, lament and hol, For the fierce anger of Jehovah hath not turned back from us.
And it hath come to pass, in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah: ’Perish doth the heart of the king, And the heart of the princes, And astonished have been the priests, And the prophets do onder.’
And I say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah, Surely thou hast entirely forgotten this people and Jerusalem, saying, Peace is for you, And struck hath a sord unto the soul!’
At that time it is said of this people, And of Jerusalem: ’A dry ind of high places in the ilderness,’ The ay of the daughter of My people, (Not for innoing, nor for cleansing,)
A full ind from these doth come for Me, No, also, I speak judgments ith them.
Lo, as clouds he cometh up, And as a hurricane his chariots, Lighter than eagles have been his horses, Woe to us, for e have been spoiled.
Wash from evil thy heart, O Jerusalem, That thou mayest be saved, Till hen dost thou lodge in thy heart Thoughts of thy strength?
For a voice is declaring from Dan, And sounding sorro from mount Ephraim.
Make ye mention to the nations, Lo, sound ye to Jerusalem: ’Besiegers are coming from the land afar off, And they give forth against cities of Judah their voice.
As the keepers of a field They have been against her round about, For ith Me she hath been rebellious, An affirmation of Jehovah.’
Thy ay and thy doings have done these to thee, This [is] thy vexation, for [it is] bitter, For it hath struck unto thy heart.
My boels, my boels! I am pained [at] the alls of my heart, Make a noise for me doth My heart, I am not silent, For the voice of a trumpet I have heard, O my soul — a shout of battle!
Destruction on destruction is proclaimed, For spoiled hath been all the land, Suddenly spoiled have been my tents, In a moment — my curtains.
Till hen do I see an ensign? Do I hear the voice of a trumpet?
For my people [are] foolish, me they have not knon, Foolish sons [are] they, yea, they [are] not intelligent, Wise [are] they to do evil, And to do good they have not knon.
I looked [to] the land, and lo, aste and void, And unto the heavens, and their light is not.
I have looked [to] the mountains, And lo, they are trembling. And all the hills moved themselves lightly.
I have looked, and lo, man is not, And all fols of the heavens have fled.
I have looked, and lo, The fruitful place [is] a ilderness, And all its cities have been broken don, Because of Jehovah, Because of the fierceness of His anger.
For thus said Jehovah: All the land is a desolation, but a completion I make not.
For this doth the land mourn, And black have been the heavens above, because I have spoken — I have purposed, And I have not repented, Nor do I turn back from it.

From the voice of the horseman, And of him shooting ith the bo, all the city is fleeing, They have come into thickets, And on cliffs they have gone up, All the city is forsaken, And there is no one delling in them.

And thou, O spoiled one, hat dost thou? For thou puttest on scarlet, For thou adornest thyself [ith] ornaments of gold. For thou rendest ith pain thine eyes, In vain thou dost make thyself fair, Kicked against thee have doting ones, Thy life they do seek.

For a voice as of a sick oman I have heard, Distress, as of one bringing forth a first-born, The voice of the daughter of Zion, She beaileth herself, she spreadeth out her hands, ’Woe to me no, for eary is my soul of slayers!’

Go to and fro in streets of Jerusalem, And see, I pray you, and kno, And seek in her broad places, if ye find a man, If there be one doing judgment, seeking stedfastness — Then am I propitious to her.
And if they say, ’Jehovah liveth,’ Surely to a falsehood they sear.

Jehovah, Thine eyes, are they not on stedfastness? Thou hast smitten them, and they have not grieved, Thou hast consumed them, They have refused to receive instruction, They made their faces harder than a rock, They have refused to turn back.
And I — I said, ’Surely these [are] poor, They have been foolish, For they have not knon the ay of Jehovah, The judgment of their God.
I get me to the great, and I speak ith them, For they have knon the ay of Jehovah, The judgment of their God.’ Surely they together have broken the yoke, They have dran aay the bands.

Therefore smitten them hath a lion out of the forest, A olf of the deserts doth spoil them, A leopard is atching over their cities, Every one ho is going out of them is torn, For many have been their transgressions, Mighty have been their backslidings.

For this I am not propitious to thee, Thy sons have forsaken Me, And are satisfied by that hich is not god, I satisfy them, and they commit adultery, And at the house of a harlot They gather themselves together.
Fed horses — they have been early risers, Each to the ife of his neighbour they neigh.
For these do I not lay a charge? An affirmation of Jehovah, And on a nation such as this, Doth not My soul avenge itself?
Go ye up on her alls, and destroy, And a completion make not, Turn aside her branches, for they [are] not Jehovah’s,
For dealt treacherously against Me have the house of Israel, And the house of Judah, an affirmation of Jehovah.
They have lied against Jehovah, And they say, ’[It is] not He, Nor come in against us doth evil, Yea, sord and famine e do not see.
And the prophets become ind, And the ord is not in them,’ — thus it is done by them.
Therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Hosts, Because of your speaking this ord, Lo, I am making My ords in thy mouth become fire, And this people ood, and it hath devoured them.

Lo, I am bringing against you a nation from afar, O house of Israel, an affirmation of Jehovah, A nation — strong it [is], a nation — from of old it [is], A nation — thou knoest not its tongue, Nor understandest hat it speaketh.
Its quiver [is] as an open sepulchre, All of them — mighty ones.

And it hath consumed thy harvest and thy bread, They consume thy sons, and thy daughters, It consumeth thy flock, and thy herd, It consumeth thy vine, and thy fig-tree, It maketh poor thy fenced cities, In hich thou art trusting — by the sord.
And even in those days, an affirmation of Jehovah, I do not make you a completion.

And it hath come to pass, hen ye say, ’For hat hath Jehovah our God done to us all these?’ That thou hast said unto them, ’As ye have forsaken Me, And serve the gods of a foreigner in your land, So do ye serve strangers in a land not yours.
Declare ye this in the house of Jacob, And sound ye it in Judah, saying,
Hear ye, I pray you, this, O people, foolish and ithout heart, Eyes they have, and they see not, Ears they have, and they hear not.

Me do ye not fear, an affirmation of Jehovah? From My presence are ye not pained? Who hath made sand the border of the sea, A limit age-during, and it passeth not over it, They shake themselves, and they are not able, Yea, sounded have its billos, and they pass not over.
And this people hath an apostate and rebellious heart, They have turned aside, and they go on.
And they have not said in their heart, ’Let us fear, e pray you, Jehovah our God, ho is giving rain, The sprinkling and the gathered, in its season, The appointed eeks of harvest He keepeth for us.’
Your iniquities have turned these aay, And your sins have kept the good from you.
For the icked have been found among My people. It looketh about the covering of snares, They have set up a trap — men they capture.
As a cage full of fols, So their houses are full of deceit, Therefore they have been great, and are rich.

They have been fat, they have shone, Yea, they have overpassed the acts of the evil, Judgment they have not judged, The judgment of the fatherless — and they prosper, And the judgment of the needy they have not judged.
For these do not I inspect, an affirmation of Jehovah, On a nation such as this, Doth not My soul avenge itself?
An astonishing and horrible thing hath been in the land.
The prophets have prophesied falsely, And the priests bear rule by their means, And My people have loved [it] so, And hat do they at its latter end?

Strengthen yourselves, sons of Benjamin, From the midst of Jerusalem, And in Tekoa blo ye a trumpet, And over Beth-Haccerem lift ye up a flame, For evil hath been seen from the north, And great destruction.
The comely and the delicate one I have cut off, The daughter of Zion.
Unto her come do shepherds and their droves, They have stricken tents by her round about, They have fed each [in] his on station.
Sanctify ye against her the battle, Rise, and e go up at noon. Woe to us, for turned hath the day, For stretched out are the shades of evening,
’Rise, and e go up by night, And e destroy her palaces.’
For thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Cut don her ood, And pour out against Jerusalem a mount, She [is] the city to be inspected, Wholly — she is oppression in her midst.
As the digging of a ell, is [for] its aters, So she hath digged [for] her ickedness, Violence and spoil is heard in her, Before My face continually [are] sickness and smiting.
Be instructed, O Jerusalem, Lest My soul be alienated from thee, Lest I make thee a desolation, a land not inhabited.
Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: They surely glean, as a vine, the remnant of Israel, Put back thy hand, as a gatherer to the baskets.
To hom do I speak, and testify, and they hear? Lo, their ear [is] uncircumcised, And they are not able to attend. Lo, a ord of Jehovah hath been to them for a reproach, They delight not in it.

And ith the fury of Jehovah I have been filled, (I have been eary of containing,) To pour [it] on the suckling in the street, And on the assembly of youths together, For even husband ith ife are captured, An elder ith one full of days,
And their houses have been turned to others, Fields and ives together, For I stretch out My hand against the inhabitants of the land, An affirmation of Jehovah.
For from their least unto their greatest, Every one is gaining dishonest gain, And from prophet even unto priest, Every one is dealing falsely,
And they heal the breach of the daughter of my people slightly, Saying, ’Peace, peace!’ and there is no peace.

They ere ashamed hen they did abomination! Yea, they are not at all ashamed, Yea, blushing they have not knon, Therefore they do fall among those falling, In the time I have inspected them, They stumble, said Jehovah.
Thus said Jehovah: Stand ye by the ays and see, and ask for paths of old, Where [is] this — the good ay? and go ye in it, And find rest for yourselves. And they say, ’We do not go.’
And I have raised up for you atchmen, Attend ye to the voice of the trumpet. And they say, ’We do not attend.’
Therefore hear, O nations, and kno, O company, That hich [is] upon them.
Hear, O earth, lo, I am bringing evil on this people, The fruit of their devices, For to My ords they gave no attention, And My la — they kick against it.
Why [is] this to Me? frankincense from Sheba cometh, And the seet cane from a land afar off, Your burnt-offerings [are] not for acceptance, And your sacrifices have not been seet to Me.
Therefore thus said Jehovah: Lo, I do give to this people stumbling blocks, And stumbled against them have fathers and sons together, The neighbour and his friend do perish.
Thus said Jehovah: Lo, a people hath come from a north country, And a great nation is stirred up from the sides of the earth.
Bo and javelin they take hold of, Fierce it [is], and they have no mercy, Their voice as a sea doth sound, And on horses they ride, set in array as a man of ar, Against thee, O daughter of Zion.
’We have heard its sound, feeble have been our hands, Distress hath seized us, pain as of a travailing oman.
Go not forth to the field, And in the ay alk not, For a sord hath the enemy, fear [is] round about.
O daughter of My people, Gird on sackcloth, and roll thyself in ashes, The mourning of an only one make for thee, A lamentation most bitter, For suddenly come doth the spoiler against us.
A atch-toer I have given thee, Among My people a fortress, And thou knoest, and hast tried their ay.
All of them are turned aside by apostates, Walking slanderously — brass and iron, All of them are corrupters.
The bellos have been burnt, By fire hath the lead been consumed, In vain hath a refiner refined, And the icked have not been dran aay.
’Silver rejected,’ they have called to them, For Jehovah hath kicked against them!
The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
Stand in the gate of the house of Jehovah, and thou hast proclaimed there this ord, and hast said, Hear a ord of Jehovah, all ye of Judah, ho are coming in at these gates, to bo before Jehovah:
Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Amend your ays, and your doings, And I cause you to dell in this place.
Do not trust for yourselves Unto the ords of falsehood, saying, The temple of Jehovah, the temple of Jehovah, The temple of Jehovah [are] they!
For, if ye do thoroughly amend your ays and your doings, If ye do judgment thoroughly Beteen a man and his neighbour,
Sojourner, fatherless, and ido, ye oppress not, And innocent blood do not shed in this place, And after other gods do not alk, for evil to yourselves,
Then I have caused you to dell in this place, In the land that I gave to your fathers, From age even unto age.
Lo, ye are trusting for yourselves On the ords of falsehood, so as not to profit.
Stealing, murdering, and committing adultery, And searing to falsehood, and giving perfume to Baal, And going after other gods hom ye kne not.
And ye have come in and stood before Me, In this house on hich My name is called, And have said, ’We have been delivered,’ In order to do all these abominations.
A den of burglars hath this house, On hich My name is called, been in your eyes? Even I, lo, I have seen, an affirmation of Jehovah.
But go ye, I pray you, Unto My place that [is] in Shiloh, Where I caused My name to dell at first, And see that hich I have done to it, For the ickedness of My people Israel.
And no, because of your doing all these orks, An affirmation of Jehovah, And I speak unto you, rising early and speaking, And ye have not hearkened, And I call you, and ye have not ansered,
I also to the house on hich My name is called, In hich ye are trusting, And to the place that I gave to you, and to your fathers, Have done, as I have done to Shiloh.
And I have cast you from before My face, As I have cast out all your brethren, The hole seed of Ephraim.
And thou dost not pray for this people, Nor lift up for them crying and prayer, Nor intercede ith Me, for I hear thee not.
Art thou not seeing hat they are doing In cities of Judah, and in streets of Jerusalem?

The sons are gathering ood, And the fathers are causing the fire to burn, And the omen are kneading dough, To make cakes to the queen of the heavens, And to pour out libations to other gods, So as to provoke Me to anger.
Me are they provoking to anger? an affirmation of Jehovah, Is it not themselves, For the shame of their on faces?

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah, Lo, Mine anger and My fury is poured out on this place, On man, and beast, and on tree of the field, And on fruit of the ground, And it hath burned, and it is not quenched.
Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Your burnt-offerings add to your sacrifices, And eat ye flesh.
For I did not speak ith your fathers, Nor did I command them in the day of My bringing them out of the land of Egypt, Concerning the matters of burnt-offering and sacrifice,

But this thing I commanded them, saying: Hearken to My voice, And I have been to you for God, And ye — ye are to Me for a people, And have alked in all the ay that I command you, So that it is ell for you.
And they have not hearkened, nor inclined their ear, And they alk in the counsels, In the stubbornness, of their evil heart, And are for backard, and not for forard.
Even from the day hen your fathers Went out of the land of Egypt till this day, I send to you all my servants the prophets, Daily rising early and sending,
And they have not hearkened unto Me, Nor inclined their ear, and harden their neck, They have done evil above their fathers.
And thou hast spoken unto them all these ords, And they do not hearken to thee, And thou hast called unto them, And they do not anser thee.

And thou hast said unto them: This [is] the nation that hath not hearkened, To the voice of Jehovah its God, Nor have they accepted instruction, Perished hath stedfastness, Yea, it hath been cut off from their mouth.
Cut off thy cron, and cast [it] aay, And lift up on high places lamentation, For Jehovah hath rejected, And He leaveth the generation of His rath.
For the sons of Judah Have done the evil thing in Mine eyes, An affirmation of Jehovah, They have set their abominations in the house On hich My name is called — to defile it,
And have built the high places of Tophet, That [are] in the valley of the son of Hinnom, To burn their sons and their daughters ith fire, Which I did not command, Nor did it come up on My heart.

Therefore, lo, days are coming, An affirmation of Jehovah, And it is not said any more, ’The Tophet,’ And ’Valley of the son of Hinnom,’ But ’Valley of the slaughter,’ And they have buried in Tophet — ithout place.
And the carcase of this people hath been for food To a fol of the heavens, and to a beast of the earth, And there is none troubling.

And I have caused to cease from cities of Judah, And from streets of Jerusalem, The voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, Voice of bridegroom, and voice of bride, For the land doth become a desolation!

At that time, an affirmation of Jehovah, They bring the bones of the kings of Judah, And the bones of its princes, And the bones of the priests, And the bones of the prophets, And the bones of inhabitants of Jerusalem, Out of their graves,

And have spread them to sun, and to moon, And to all the host of the heavens, that they have loved, And that they have served, And that they have alked after, And that they have sought, And to hich they have boed themselves, They are not gathered, nor buried, They are for dung on the face of the ground.
And chosen is death rather than life By all the remnant ho are left of this evil family, In all the remaining places, hither I have driven them, An affirmation of Jehovah of Hosts.
And thou hast said unto them: Thus said Jehovah, Do they fall, and not rise? Doth he turn back, and not return?
Wherefore hath this people of Jerusalem Turned back — a perpetual backsliding? They have kept hold on deceit, They have refused to turn back.

I have given attention, yea, I hearken, They do not speak right, No man hath repented of his ickedness, Saying, What have I done? Every one hath turned to his courses, As a horse is rushing into battle.
Even a stork in the heavens hath knon her seasons, And turtle, and sallo, and crane, Have atched the time of their coming, And — My people have not knon the judgment of Jehovah.
Ho do ye say, We [are] ise, And the la of Jehovah [is] ith us? Surely, lo, falsely it hath rought, The false pen of scribes.
Ashamed have been the ise, They have been affrighted, and are captured, Lo, against a ord of Jehovah they kicked, And the isdom of hat — have they?

Therefore, I give their ives to others, Their fields to dispossessors, For from the least even unto the greatest, Every one is gaining dishonest gain, From prophet even unto priest, every one is dealing falsely.
And they heal the breach of the daughter of my people slightly, Saying, Peace, peace! and there is no peace.

They ere ashamed hen they did abomination! Yea, they are not at all ashamed, And blushing they have not knon, Therefore, they do fall among falling ones, In the time of their inspection they stumble, said Jehovah.
I utterly consume them, an affirmation of Jehovah, There are no grapes in the vine, Yea, there are no figs in the fig-tree, And the leaf hath faded, And the strength they have passeth from them.

Wherefore are e sitting still? Be gathered, and e go in to the fenced cities, And e are silent there, For Jehovah our God hath made us silent, Yea, He causeth us to drink ater of gall, For e have sinned against Jehovah.
Looking for peace — and there is no good, For a time of healing, and lo, terror.

From Dan hath been heard the snorting of his horses, From the voice of the neighings of his mighty ones, Trembled hath all the land, And they come in and consume the land and its fulness, The city and the inhabitants in it.
For, lo, I am sending among you serpents, Vipers that have no charmer, And they have bitten you, an affirmation of Jehovah.
My refreshing for me [is] sorro, For me my heart [is] sick.

Lo, the voice of a cry of the daughter of my people from a land afar off, Is Jehovah not in Zion? is her king not in her? Wherefore have they provoked Me ith their graven images, With the vanities of a foreigner?
Harvest hath passed, summer hath ended, And e — e have not been saved.
For a breach of the daughter of my people have I been broken, I have been black, astonishment hath seized me.
Is there no balm in Gilead? Is there no physician there? For herefore hath not the health of the daughter of my people gone up?
Who doth make my head aters, And mine eye a fountain of tears? And I eep by day and by night, For the ounded of the daughter of my people.
Who doth give me in a ilderness A lodging-place of travellers? And I leave my people, and go from them, For all of them [are] adulterers, An assembly of treacherous ones.

And they bend their tongue, their bo [is] a lie, And not for stedfastness have they been mighty in the land, For from evil unto evil they have gone forth, And Me they have not knon, An affirmation of Jehovah!
Each of his friend — beare ye, And on any brother, do not trust, For every brother doth utterly supplant, For every friend slanderously doth alk,
And each at his friend they mock, And truth they do not speak, They taught their tongue to speak falsehood, To commit iniquity they have laboured.
thy delling [is] in the midst of deceit, Through deceit they refused to kno Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Lo, I am refining them, and have tried them, For ho do I do because of the daughter of My people?
A slaughtering arro [is] their tongue, Deceit it hath spoken in its mouth, Peace ith its neighbour it speaketh, And in its heart it layeth its ambush,
For these things do not I see after them? An affirmation of Jehovah, Against a nation such as this doth not My soul avenge itself?

For the mountains I lift up eeping and ailing, And for the habitations of the ilderness a lamentation, For they have been burnt up ithout any passing over, Nor have they heard the voice of cattle, From the fol of the heavens unto the beast they have fled, they have gone.
And I make Jerusalem become heaps, A habitation of dragons, And the cities of Judah I make a desolation, Without inhabitant.

Who [is] the ise man? and he understandeth this, And he to hom the mouth of Jehovah spake? And he doth declare it, For hat hath the land perished? It hath been burnt up as a ilderness, Without any passing through.
And Jehovah saith: Because of their forsaking My la that I set before them, And they have not hearkened to My voice nor alked in it,
And they alk after the stubbornness of their heart, And after the Baalim, that their fathers taught them,
Therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel: Lo, I am causing them — this people — to eat ormood, And I have caused them to drink ater of gall,
And I have scattered them among nations Which they kne not, they and their fathers, And have sent after them the sord, Till I have consumed them.
Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Consider ye, and call for mourning omen, And they come, And to the ise omen send, and they come,
And they hasten, and lift up for us a ailing. And run don our eyes do tears, And from our eyelids do aters flo.
For — a voice of ailing is heard from Zion: Ho have e been spoiled! We have been greatly ashamed, Because e have forsaken the land, Because they have cast don our tabernacles.
But hear, ye omen, a ord of Jehovah, And your ear receiveth a ord of His mouth, And teach ye your daughters ailing, and each her neighbour lamentation.
For death hath come up into our indos, It hath come into our palaces, To cut off the suckling from ithout, Young men from the broad places.
Speak thus — an affirmation of Jehovah, And fallen hath the carcase of man, As dung on the face of the field, And as a handful after the reaper, And there is none gathering.
Thus said Jehovah: Let not the ise boast himself in his isdom, Nor let the mighty boast himself in his might, Let not the rich boast himself in his riches,

But — in this let the boaster boast himself, In understanding and knoing Me, For I [am] Jehovah, doing kindness, Judgment, and righteousness, in the earth, For in these I have delighted, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Lo, days are coming — an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have laid a charge on all circumcised in the foreskin,

On Egypt, and on Judah, and on Edom, And on the sons of Ammon, and on Moab, And on all cutting the corner [of the beard], Who are delling in the ilderness, For all the nations [are] uncircumcised, And all the house of Israel [are] uncircumcised in heart!
Hear ye the ord, O house of Israel, That Jehovah hath spoken for you.
Thus said Jehovah: Unto the ay of the nations accustom not yourselves, And by the signs of the heavens be not affrighted, For the nations are affrighted by them.
For the statutes of the peoples are vanity, For a tree from a forest hath one cut, Work of the hands of an artificer, ith an axe,
With silver and ith gold they beautify it, With nails and ith hammers they fix it, And it doth not stumble.
As a palm they [are] stiff, and they speak not, They are surely borne, for they step not, Be not afraid of them, for they do no evil, Yea, also to do good is not in them.
Because there is none like Thee, O Jehovah, Great [art] Thou, and great Thy name in might.
Who doth not fear Thee, king of the nations? For to Thee it is becoming, For among all the ise of the nations, And in all their kingdom there is none like Thee.
And in one they are brutish and foolish, An instruction of vanities [is] the tree itself.
Spread-out silver from Tarshish is brought, And gold from Uphaz, Work of an artisan, and of the hands of a refiner, Blue and purple [is] their clothing, Work of the skilful — all of them.
And Jehovah [is] a God of truth, He [is] a living God, and a king age-during, From His rath shake doth the earth, And nations endure not His indignation.
Thus do ye say to them, The gods Who the heavens and earth have not made, They do perish from the earth, And from under these heavens.
The maker of the earth by His poer, The establisher of the orld by His isdom, Who, by His understanding, stretched forth the heavens,

At the voice He giveth forth, A multitude of aters [is] in the heavens, And He causeth vapours to come up from the end of the earth, Lightnings for rain He hath made, And bringeth out ind from His treasures.
Brutish is every man by knoledge, Put to shame is every refiner by a graven image, For false [is] his molten image. And there is no breath in them.
Vanity [are] they, ork of erring ones, In the time of their inspection they perish.
Not like these [is] the Portion of Jacob, For framer of all things [is] He, And Israel [is] the rod of His inheritance, Jehovah of Hosts [is] His name.
Gather from the land thy merchandise, O deller in the bulark,
For thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am slinging out the inhabitants of the land at this time, And have been an adversary to them, So that they are found out.
Woe to me for my breaking, Grievious hath been my smiting, And I said, Only, this [is] my sickness, and I bear it.
My tent hath been spoiled, And all my cords have been broken, My sons have gone out from me, and they are not, There is none stretching out any more my tent, And raising up my curtains.
For the shepherds have become brutish, And Jehovah they have not sought, Therefore they have not acted isely, And all their flock is scattered.
A voice of a report, lo, it hath come, Even a great shaking from the north country, To make the cities of Judah a desolation, A habitation of dragons.
I have knon, O Jehovah, that not of man [is] his ay, Not of man the going and establishing of his step.
Chastise me, O Jehovah, only in judgment, Not in Thine anger, lest Thou make me small.

Pour out Thy fury on the nations that have not knon Thee, And on the families that have not called in Thy name, For they have eaten up Jacob, Yea, they have eaten him up, yea, they consume him, And his habitation they have made desolate!
The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:
’Hear ye the ords of this covenant, and ye have spoken unto the men of Judah, and unto the inhabitants of Jerusalem,
and thou hast said unto them, Thus said Jehovah God of Israel: Cursed [is] the man ho doth not obey the ords of this covenant,

That I commanded your fathers, In the day of My bringing them out from the land of Egypt, Out of the iron furnace, saying, Hearken to My voice, and ye have done them, According to all that I command you, And ye have been to Me for a people, And I am to you for God,
In order to establish the oath that I have sorn to your fathers, To give to them a land floing ith milk and honey, as this day. And I anser and say, ’Amen, O Jehovah.’
And Jehovah saith unto me, ’Proclaim all these ords in the cities of Judah, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying: Hear ye the ords of this covenant, And ye have done them.
For I certainly testified against your fathers, In the day of My bringing them up out of the land of Egypt — till this day, Rising early and testifying, saying, Hearken to My voice,

And they have not hearkened nor inclined their ear, And they alk each in the stubbornness of their evil heart, And I bring on them all the ords of this covenant, That I commanded to do, and they did not.’
And Jehovah saith unto me: ’A conspiracy is found in the men of Judah, And in the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

They have turned back to the iniquities of their first fathers, Who refused to hear My ords, And they have gone after other gods to serve them, The house of Israel, and the house of Judah, Have made void My covenant, that I made ith their fathers.
Therefore thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am bringing in unto them evil, That they are not able to go out from, And they have cried unto Me, And I do not hearken unto them.

And the cities of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem have gone, And they have cried unto the gods, To hom they are making perfume, And they give no deliverance at all to them, In the time of their vexation.
For — the number of thy cities have been thy gods, O Judah, And — the number of the streets of Jerusalem Ye have placed altars to a shameful thing, Altars to make perfume to Baal.
And thou, thou dost not pray for this people, Nor dost thou lift up for them cry and prayer, For I do not hearken in the time of their calling unto Me for their vexation.
What — to My beloved in My house, Her doing ickedness ith many, And the holy flesh do pass over from thee? When thou dost evil, then thou exultest.
’An olive, green, fair, of goodly fruit,’ Hath Jehovah called thy name, At the noise of a great tumult He hath kindled fire against it, And broken have been its thin branches.

And Jehovah of Hosts, ho is planting thee, Hath spoken evil concerning thee, For the evil of the house of Israel, and of the house of Judah, That they have done to themselves, To provoke Me to anger, to make perfume to Baal.
And, O Jehovah, cause me to kno, and I kno, Then Thou hast shoed me their doings.

And I [am] as a trained lamb brought to slaughter, And I have not knon That against me they have devised devices: We destroy the tree ith its food, and cut him off From the land of the living, And his name is not remembered again.
And O Jehovah of Hosts, judging righteousness, Trying reins and heart, I do see Thy vengeance against them, For unto Thee I have revealed my cause.’
Therefore, thus said Jehovah concerning the men of Anathoth, ho are seeking thy life, saying: Do not prophesy in the name of Jehovah, And thou dost not die by our hands.
Therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts: ’Lo, I am seeing after them, The chosen ones die by sord, Their sons and their daughters die by famine,
And they have no remnant, For I bring evil unto the men of Anathoth, The year of their inspection!’
Righteous [art] Thou, O Jehovah, When I plead toards thee, Only, judgments do I speak ith Thee, Wherefore did the ay of the icked prosper? At rest have been all treacherous dealers.
Thou hast planted them, yea, they have taken root, They go on, yea, they have made fruit, Near [art] Thou in their mouth, And far off from their reins.
And Thou, O Jehovah, Thou hast knon me, Thou seest me, and hast tried my heart ith Thee, Dra them aay as sheep to slaughter, And separate them for a day of slaughter.
Till hen doth the earth mourn, And the herb of the hole field ither? For the ickedness of those delling in it, Consumed have been beast and fol, Because they said, ’He doth not see our latter end.’
For — ith footmen thou hast run, And they eary thee, And ho dost thou fret thyself ith horses! Even in the land of peace, [In hich] thou art confident — And ho dost thou in the rising of Jordan!
For even thy brethren and the house of thy father, Even they dealt treacherously against thee, Even they — they called after thee fully, Trust not in them, hen they speak to thee good things.
I have forsaken My house, I have left Mine inheritance, I have given the beloved of My soul Into the hand of her enemies.
Mine inheritance hath been to Me as a lion in a forest, She gave forth against Me ith her voice, Therefore I have hated her.
A speckled fol [is] Mine inheritance to Me? Is the fol round about against her? Come, assemble, every beast of the field, Come ye for food.
Many shepherds did destroy My vineyard, They have trodden don My portion, They have made My desirable portion Become a ilderness — a desolation.
He hath made it become a desolation, The desolation hath mourned unto Me, Desolated hath been all the land, But there is no one laying it to heart.
On all high places in the plain have spoilers come in, For the sord of Jehovah is consuming, From the end of the land even unto the end of the land, There is no peace to any flesh.
They soed heat, and have thorns reaped, They have become sick — they profit not, And they have been ashamed of your increases, Because of the fierceness of the anger of Jehovah.

Thus said Jehovah concerning all my evil neighbours, ho are striking against the inheritance that I caused my people — Israel — to inherit: ’Lo, I am plucking them from off their ground, And the house of Judah I pluck out of their midst.
And it hath been, after My plucking them out, I turn back, and have pitied them, And I have brought them back, Each to his inheritance, and each to his land.

And it hath come to pass, If they learn ell the ays of My people, To sear by My name, ’Jehovah liveth,’ As they taught My people to sear by Baal, Then they have been built up in the midst of My people.
And if they do not hearken, Then I have plucked up that nation, Plucking up and destroying, An affirmation of Jehovah!’
Thus said Jehovah unto me, ’Go, and thou hast got for thee a girdle of linen, and hast placed it on thy loins, and into ater thou dost not cause it to enter:’
and I get the girdle, according to the ord of Jehovah, and I place [it] on my loins.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me a second time, saying,
’Take the girdle that thou hast got, that [is] on thy loins, and rise, go to Phrat, and hide it there in a hole of the rock;
and I go and hide it by Phrat, as Jehovah commanded me.
And it cometh to pass, at the end of many days, that Jehovah saith unto me, ’Rise, go to Phrat, and take thence the girdle, that I commanded thee to hide there;’
and I go to Phrat, and dig, and take the girdle from the place here I had hid it; and lo, the girdle hath been marred, it is not profitable for anything.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying, ’Thus said Jehovah:
Thus do I mar the excellency of Judah, And the great excellency of Jerusalem.

This evil people, ho refuse to hear My ords, Who alk in the stubbornness of their heart, And go after other gods to serve them, And to bo themselves to them, Yea it is — as this girdle, that is not profitable for anything.

For, as the girdle cleaveth unto the loins of a man, So I caused to cleave unto Me The hole house of Israel, And the hole house of Judah, an affirmation of Jehovah, To be to Me for a people, and for a name, And for praise, and for beauty, And they have not hearkened.
And thou hast said unto them this ord, Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, ’Every bottle is full of ine,’ And they have said unto thee: ’Do e not certainly kno that every bottle is full of ine?’

And thou hast said unto them, ’Thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am filling all the inhabitants of this land, And the kings ho sit for David on his throne, And the priests, and the prophets, And all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, [With] drunkenness,
And have dashed them one against another, And the fathers and the sons together, An affirmation of Jehovah, I do not pity, nor spare, nor have I mercy, So as not to destroy them.
Hear, and give ear — be not haughty, For Jehovah hath spoken.

Give ye to Jehovah your God honour, Before He doth cause darkness, And before your feet stumble on dark mountains, And ye have aited for light, And He hath made it for death-shade, And hath appointed [it] for thick darkness.
And if ye do not hear it, In secret places doth my soul eep, because of pride, Yea, it eepeth sore, And the tear cometh don mine eyes, For the flock of Jehovah hath been taken captive.
Say to the king and to the mistress: Make yourselves lo — sit still, For come don have your principalities, The cron of your beauty.
The cities of the south have been shut up, And there is none opening, Judah hath been removed — all of her, She hath been removed completely —
Lift up your eyes, and see those coming in from the north, Where [is] the drove given to thee, thy beautiful flock?
What dost thou say, hen He looketh after thee? And thou — thou hast taught them [to be] over thee — leaders for head? Do not pangs seize thee as a travailing oman?
And hen thou dost say in thy heart, ’Wherefore have these met me?’ For the abundance of thine iniquity Have thy skirts been uncovered, Have thy heels suffered violence.
Doth a Cushite change his skin? and a leopard his spots? Ye also are able to do good, ho are accustomed to do evil.
And I scatter them as stubble, Passing aay, by a ind of the ilderness.
This [is] thy lot, the portion of thy measures from Me — an affirmation of Jehovah, Because thou hast forgotten me, And dost trust in falsehood.
I also have made bare thy skirts before thy face, And thy shame hath been seen.
Thine adulteries, and thy neighings, The ickedness of thy horedom, on heights in a field, I have seen thine abominations. Woe to thee, O Jerusalem, Thou art not cleansed, after hen [is it] again?
That hich hath been the ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah concerning the matters of the dearths:
Mourned hath Judah, and her gates have languished, They have mourned to the earth, And the cry of Jerusalem hath gone up.

And their honourable ones have sent their little ones to the ater, They have come unto ditches, They have not found ater, They have turned back — their vessels empty! They have been ashamed, And have blushed and covered their head.
Because the ground hath been broken, For there hath been no rain in the land, Ashamed have been husbandmen, They have covered their head.
For even the hind in the field hath brought forth — to forsake [it!] For there hath been no grass.
And ild asses have stood on high places, They have salloed up ind like dragons, Consumed have been their eyes, for there is no herb.
Surely our iniquities have testified against us, O Jehovah, ork for Thy name’s sake, For many have been our backslidings, Against Thee e have sinned.
O Hope of Israel — its saviour in time of trouble, Why art Thou as a sojourner in the land? And as a traveller turned aside to lodge?
Why art Thou as one dumb? As a mighty one not able to save? And Thou [art] in our midst, O Jehovah, And Thy name over us is called, leave us not.

Thus said Jehovah concerning this people: Well they have loved to ander, Their feet they have not restrained, And Jehovah hath not accepted them, No doth He remember their iniquity, And inspect their sin.
And Jehovah saith unto me: Thou dost not pray for this people for good,
When they fast, I hearken not unto their cry, And hen they cause to ascend burnt-offering and present, I accept them not, For by sord, and by famine, And by pestilence, I am consuming them.
And I say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah, Lo, the prophets are saying to them: Ye do not see a sord, yea, famine is not to you, For true peace I give to you in this place.’

And Jehovah saith unto me: Falsehood the prophets are prophesying in My name, I did not send them, nor command them, Nor have I spoken unto them: A false vision, and divination, and vanity, And the deceit of their on heart, they are prophesying to you.

Therefore, thus said Jehovah concerning the prophets ho are prophesying in My name, and I have not sent them, and they are saying, Sord and famine is not in this land: By sord and by famine are these prophets consumed.

And the people to hom they are prophesying, Are cast into out-places of Jerusalem, Because of the famine, and of the sord, And they have none burying them, Them, their ives, and their sons, and their daughters, And I have poured out upon them this evil.

And thou hast said unto them this ord: Tears come don mine eyes night and day, And they do not cease, For, [ith] a great breach, Broken hath been the virgin daughter of my people, A very grievous stroke.

If I have gone forth to the field, Then, lo, the pierced of the sord! And if I have entered the city, Then, lo, the diseased of famine! For both prophet and priest have gone up and don Unto a land that they kne not.

Hast Thou utterly rejected Judah? Zion hath Thy soul loathed? Wherefore hast Thou smitten us, And there is no healing to us? Looking for peace, and there is no good, And for a time of healing, and lo, terror.
We have knon, O Jehovah, our ickedness, The iniquity of our fathers, For e have sinned against Thee.
Do not despise, for Thy name’s sake, Dishonour not the throne of Thine honour, Remember, break not Thy covenant ith us.
Are there among the vanities of the nations any causing rain? And do the heavens give shoers? Art not Thou He, O Jehovah our God? And e ait for thee, for Thou — Thou hast done all these!
And Jehovah saith unto me: Though Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My soul is not toard this people, Send from before My face, and they go out.

And it hath come to pass, hen they say to thee, Whither do e go out? that thou hast said unto them, Thus said Jehovah: Those ho [are] for death — to death, And those ho are for the sord, to the sord, And those ho are for famine, to famine, And those ho are for captivity, to captivity.
And I have appointed over them four kinds, an affirmation of Jehovah, The sord to slay, and the dogs to drag, And the fol of the heavens, And the beast of the earth, to consume and to devour.
And I have given them for a trembling To all kingdoms of the earth, Because of Manasseh son of Hezekiah king of Judah, For that hich he did in Jerusalem.
For ho hath pity on thee, O Jerusalem? And ho doth bemoan for thee? And ho turneth aside to ask of thy elfare?
Thou — thou hast left Me — an affirmation of Jehovah, Backard thou goest, And I stretch out My hand against thee, And I destroy thee, I have been eary of repenting,
And I scatter them ith a fan, in the gates the land, I bereaved, I have destroyed My people, From their ays they turned not back.
Its idos have been more to Me than the sand of the seas, I brought in to them — against the mother — A young man — a spoiler — at noon. I caused to fall upon her suddenly, rath and trouble.

Languished hath the bearer of seven, She hath breathed out her spirit, Gone in hath her sun hile yet day, It hath been ashamed and confounded, And their residue to the sord I give up before their enemies, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Woe to me, my mother, For thou hast borne me a man of strife, And a man of contention to all the land, I have not lent on usury, Nor have they lent on usury to me — All of them are reviling me.
Jehovah said, Did I not direct thee for good? Did not I intercede for thee in a time of evil, And in a time of adversity, ith the enemy?
Doth one break iron — northern iron, and brass?
Thy strength and thy treasures For a prey I do give — not for price, Even for all thy sins, and in all thy borders.
And I have caused thine enemies To pass over into the land — Thou hast not knon, For a fire hath been kindled in Mine anger, Against you it doth burn.
Thou, Thou hast knon, O Jehovah, Remember me, and inspect me, And take vengeance for me of my pursuers, In Thy long-suffering take me not aay, Kno — I have borne for Thee reproach.
Thy ords have been found, and I eat them, And Thy ord is to me for a joy, And for the rejoicing of my heart, For Thy name is called on me, O Jehovah, God of Hosts.
I have not sat in an assembly of deriders, Nor do I exult, because of thy hand, — Alone I have sat, For [ith] indignation Thou hast filled me.
Why hath my pain been perpetual? And my ound incurable? It hath refused to be healed, Thou art surely to me as a failing stream, Waters not stedfast.

Therefore, thus said Jehovah: If thou turnest back, then I bring thee back, Before Me thou dost stand, And if thou bringest out the precious from the vile, As My mouth thou art! They — they turn back unto thee, And thou dost not turn back unto them.

And I have made thee to this people For a all — brazen — fenced, And they have fought against thee, And they do not prevail against thee, For ith thee [am] I to save thee, And to deliver thee — an affirmation of Jehovah,
And I have delivered thee from the hand of evil doers, And I have ransomed thee From the hand of the terrible!
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
Thou dost not take to thee a ife, Nor hast thou sons and daughters in this place.
For thus said Jehovah, Of the sons and of the daughters ho are born in this place, And of their mothers — those bearing them, And of their fathers — those begetting them in this land:

Of painful deaths they die, They are not lamented, nor are they buried, For dung on the face of the ground they are, And by sord and by famine are consumed, And their carcase hath been for food To the fol of the heavens, And to the beast of the earth.

For thus said Jehovah: Do not enter the house of a mourning-feast, Nor go to lament nor bemoan for them, For I have removed My peace from this people, An affirmation of Jehovah, The kindness and the mercies.
And died have great and small in this land, They are not buried, and none lament for them, Nor doth any cut himself, nor become bald for them.
Nor do they deal out to them for mourning, To comfort him concerning the dead, Nor cause them to drink a cup of consolations For his father and for his mother.
A house of banqueting thou dost not enter, To sit ith them, to eat and to drink,

For thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel: Lo, I am causing to cease from this place, Before your eyes, and in your days, The voice of joy, and the voice of rejoicing, The voice of bridegroom and voice of bride.

And it hath come to pass hen thou declarest to this people all these ords, and they have said unto thee, ’For hat hath Jehovah spoken against us all this great evil? yea, hat [is] our iniquity, and hat our sin, that e have sinned against Jehovah our God?’

Then thou hast said unto them: Because that your fathers have forsaken Me, An affirmation of Jehovah, And go after other gods, and serve them, And they bo themselves to them, And Me have forsaken, and My la not kept,
Ye also have done evil above your fathers, And lo, ye are alking each after the stubbornness of his evil heart, So as not to hearken unto Me.
And I have cast you from off this land, On to a land that ye have not knon, Ye and your fathers, And ye have served there other gods by day and by night, Where I do not give to you grace.
Therefore, lo, days are coming, An affirmation of Jehovah, And it is not said any more: ’Jehovah liveth, ho brought up The sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,’

But, ’Jehovah liveth, ho brought up The sons of Israel out of the land of the north, And out of all the lands hither He drove them,’ And I have brought them back to their land, That I gave to their fathers.

Lo, I am sending for many fishers, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they have fished them, And after this I send for many hunters, And they have hunted them from off every mountain, And from off every hill, and from holes of the rocks.
For Mine eyes [are] upon all their ays, They have not been hidden from My face, Nor hath their iniquity been concealed from before Mine eyes.

And I have recompensed a first — A second time — their iniquity and their sin, Because of their polluting My land, With the carcase of their detestable things, Yea, their abominable things have filled Mine inheritance.

O Jehovah, my strength, and my fortress, And my refuge in a day of adversity, Unto Thee nations do come from the ends of earth, And say, Only falsehood did our fathers inherit, Vanity, and none among them is profitable.
Doth man make for himself gods, And they — no gods?
Therefore, lo, I am causing them to kno at this time, I cause them to kno My hand and My might, And they have knon that My name [is] Jehovah!
The sin of Judah is ritten ith a pen of iron, With the point of a diamond, Graven on the tablet of their heart, And on the horns of your altars,
As their sons remember their altars and their shrines, By the green tree, by the high hills.
O My mountain in the field — thy strength, All thy treasures — for a prey I give, Thy high places for sin in all thy borders.

And thou hast let go — even through thyself, Of thine inheritance that I gave to thee, And I have caused thee to serve thine enemies, In a land that thou hast not knon, For a fire ye have kindled in Mine anger, Unto the age it doth burn.
Thus said Jehovah: Cursed [is] the man ho doth trust in man, And hath made flesh his arm, And from Jehovah hose heart turneth.
And he hath been as a naked thing in a desert, And doth not see hen good cometh, And hath inhabited parched places in a ilderness, A salt land, and not inhabited.
Blessed [is] the man ho trusteth in Jehovah, And hose confidence hath been Jehovah.

And hath been as a tree planted by aters, And by a rivulet he sendeth forth his roots, And he doth not see hen heat cometh, And his leaf hath been green, And in a year of dearth he is not sorroful, Nor doth he cease from making fruit.
Crooked [is] the heart above all things, And it [is] incurable — ho doth kno it?
I Jehovah do search the heart, try the reins, Even to give to each according to his ay, According to the fruit of his doings.
A partridge hatching, and not bringing forth, [Is] one making ealth, and not by right, In the midst of his days he doth forsake it, And in his latter end — he is a fool.
A throne of honour on high from the beginning, The place of our sanctuary,
The hope of Israel [is] Jehovah, All forsaking Thee are ashamed, And ’My apostates’ in the earth are ritten, For they have forsaken Jehovah, A fountain of living aters.
Heal me, O Jehovah, and I am healed, Save me, and I am saved, for my praise [art] Thou.
Lo, they are saying unto me: ’Where [is] the ord of Jehovah? pray, let it come.’
And I hastened not from feeding after Thee, And the desperate day I have not desired, Thou — Thou hast knon, The produce of my lips, before Thy face it hath been,
Be not Thou to me for a terror, My hope [art] Thou in a day of evil.

Let my pursuers be ashamed, and let not me be ashamed — me! Let them be affrighted, and let not me be affrighted — me! Bring in on them a day of evil, And a second time [ith] destruction destroy them.
Thus said Jehovah unto me: ’Go, and thou hast stood in the gate of the sons of the people, by hich kings of Judah come in, and by hich they go out, and in all gates of Jerusalem,
and thou hast said unto them: Hear a ord of Jehovah, ye kings of Judah, and all Judah, and all inhabitants of Jerusalem, ho are coming in by these gates,
Thus said Jehovah, Take ye heed to yourselves, And ye bear not a burden on the day of rest, Nor have ye brought [it] in by the gates of Jerusalem.
Nor do ye take out a burden from your houses on the day of rest, Yea, any ork ye do not do, And ye have sanctified the day of rest, As I have commanded your fathers.
And they have not hearkened nor inclined their ear, And they stiffen their neck not to hear, And not to receive instruction.

And it hath been, if ye certainly hearken unto Me, An affirmation of Jehovah, So as not to bring in a burden By the gates of this city on the day of rest, And to sanctify the day of rest, So as not to do in it any ork —

Then entered by the gates of this city have kings and princes, Sitting on the throne of David, Riding in a chariot, and on horses, They, and their princes, the man of Judah, And inhabitants of Jerusalem, And this city hath remained to the age.

And they have come in from cities of Judah, And from suburbs of Jerusalem, And from the land of Benjamin, And from the lo country, And from the hill-country, and from the south, Bringing in burnt-offering, and sacrifice, And present, and frankincense, And bringing praise [to] the house of Jehovah.

And if ye do not hearken unto me to sanctify the day of rest, And so as not to bear a burden, And to come in at the gates of Jerusalem on the day of rest, Then I have kindled a fire in its gates, And it hath consumed the high places of Jerusalem, And it is not quenched!’
The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
Rise, and thou hast gone don [to] the potter’s house, and there I cause thee to hear My ords;
and I go don [to] the potter’s house, and lo, he is doing a ork on the stones,
and marred is the vessel that he is making, as clay in the hand of the potter, and he hath turned and he maketh it another vessel, as it as right in the eyes of the potter to make.
And there is a ord of Jehovah to me, saying:
As this potter am I not able to do to you? O house of Israel, an affirmation of Jehovah. Lo, as clay in the hand of the potter, So [are] ye in My hand, O house of Israel.
The moment I speak concerning a nation, And concerning a kingdom, To pluck up and to break don, and to destroy,
And that nation hath turned from its evil, Because I have spoken against it, Then I have repented of the evil that I thought to do to it.
And the moment I speak concerning a nation, And concerning a kingdom, to build, and to plant,
And it hath done the evil thing in Mine eyes, So as not to hearken to My voice, Then I have repented of the good That I have spoken of doing to it.

And no, speak, I pray thee, unto men of Judah, And against inhabitants of Jerusalem, Saying: Thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am framing against you evil, And devising against you a device, Turn back, I pray you, each from his evil ay And amen your ays and your doings.
And they have said, It is incurable, For after our on devices e do go, And each the stubbornness of his evil heart e do.
Therefore, thus said Jehovah: Ask, I pray you, among the nations, Who hath heard like these? A very horrible thing hath the virgin of Israel done.
Doth sno of Lebanon Cease from the rock of the field? Failed are the cold strange aters that flo?
But My people have forgotten Me, to a vain thing they make perfume, And they cause them to stumble in their ays — paths of old, To alk in paths — a ay not raised up,
To make their land become a desolation, A hissing age-during, Every passer by it is astonished, And bemoaneth ith his head.
As an east ind I scatter them before an enemy, The neck, and not the face, I she them, In the day of their calamity.’

And they say, Come, And e devise against Jeremiah devices, For la doth not perish from the priest, Nor counsel from the ise, Nor the ord from the prophet, Come, and e smite him ith the tongue, And e do not attend to any of his ords.
Give attention, O Jehovah, unto me, And hearken to the voice of those contending ith me.
Is evil recompensed instead of good, That they have dug a pit for my soul? Remember my standing before Thee to speak good of them, To turn back Thy rath from them.

Therefore, give up their sons to famine, And cause them to run on the sides of the sord, And their ives are bereaved and idos, And their men are slain by death, Their young men smitten by sord in battle,
A cry is heard from their houses, For Thou bringest against them suddenly a troop, For they dug a pit to capture me, And snares they have hidden for my feet.

And Thou, O Jehovah, Thou hast knon, All their counsel against me [is] for death, Thou dost not cover over their iniquity, Nor their sin from before Thee blottest out, And they are made to stumble before Thee, In the time of Thine anger ork against them!
Thus said Jehovah, ’Go, and thou hast got a potter’s earthen vessel, and of the elders of the people, and of the elders of the priests,
and thou hast gone forth unto the valley of the son of Hinnom, that [is] at the opening of the gate of the pottery, and hast proclaimed there the ords that I speak unto thee,
