and hast said, Hear a ord of Jehovah, ye kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem, Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel: ’Lo, I am bringing in evil on this place, at hich the ears of every one ho is hearing it do tingle,

because that they have forsaken Me, and make knon this place, and make perfume in it to other gods, that they kne not, they and their fathers, and the kings of Judah, and they have filled this place [ith] innocent blood,
and have built the high places of Baal to burn their sons ith fire, burnt-offerings to Baal, that I commanded not, nor spake of, nor did it come up on My heart.
’Therefore, lo, days are coming — an affirmation of Jehovah — and this place is not called any more, Tophet, and Valley of the son of Hinnom, but, Valley of slaughter.

And I have made void the counsel of Judah and Jerusalem in this place, and have caused them to fall by the sord before their enemies, and by the hand of those seeking their life, and I have given their carcase for food to the fol of the heavens, and to the beast of the earth,
and I have made this city for a desolation, and for a hissing, every passer by it is astonished, and doth hiss for all its plagues.

And I have caused them to eat the flesh of their sons, and the flesh of their daughters, and each the flesh of his friend they do eat, in the siege and in the straitness ith hich straiten them do their enemies, and those seeking their life.
’And thou hast broken the bottle before the eyes of the men ho are going ith thee,

and hast said unto them: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, Thus do I break this people and this city, as one breaketh the potter’s vessel, that is not able to be repaired again, and in Tophet they bury — ithout place to bury;
so I do to this place — an affirmation of Jehovah — and to its inhabitants, so as to make this city as Tophet;

and the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, have been — as the place of Tophet — defiled, even all the houses on hose roofs they have made perfume to all the host of the heavens, so as to pour out oblations to other gods.’
And Jeremiah cometh in from Tophet, hither Jehovah had sent him to prophesy, and he standeth in the court of the house of Jehovah, and he saith unto all the people:

’Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel: Lo, I am bringing in unto this city, and on all its cities, all the evil that I have spoken against it, for they have hardened their neck — not to hear My ords!’
And Pashhur son of Immer the priest — ho also [is] overseer, leader in the house of Jehovah — heareth Jeremiah prophesying these things,
and Pashhur smiteth Jeremiah the prophet, and putteth him unto the stocks, that [are] by the high gate of Benjamin, that [is] by the house of Jehovah.
and it cometh to pass on the morro, that Pashhur bringeth out Jeremiah from the stocks, and Jeremiah saith unto him, ’Not Pashhur hath Jehovah called thy name, but — Magor-Missabib.

For thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am making thee for a fear to thyself, And to all loving thee, And they have fallen by the sord of their enemies, and thine eyes are beholding, And all Judah I give into the hand of the king of Babylon, And he hath removed them to Babylon, And he hath smitten them ith the sord.

And I have given all the strength of this city, And all its labour, and all its precious things, Yea, all the treasures of the kings of Judah I do give into the hand of their enemies, And they have spoiled them, and taken them, And have brought them into Babylon.

And thou, Pashhur, and all delling in thy house, Do go into captivity. and Babylon thou dost enter, And there thou diest, and there thou art buried, Thou and all loving thee, To hom thou hast prophesied falsely.’
Thou hast persuaded me, O Jehovah, and I am persuaded; Thou hast hardened me, and dost prevail, I have been for a laughter all the day, Every one is mocking at me,
Because from the time I speak I cry out, ’Violence and destruction,’ I cry, For the ord of Jehovah hath been to me For reproach and for derision all the day.
And I said, ’I do not mention Him, Nor do I speak any more in His name,’ And it hath been in my heart As a burning fire shut up in my bones, And I have been eary of containing, And I am not able.

For I have heard the evil report of many, Fear [is] round about: ’Declare, and e declare it,’ All mine allies are atching [for] my halting, ’Perhaps he is enticed, and e prevail over him, And e take our vengeance out of him.’

And Jehovah [is] ith me, as a terrible mighty one, Therefore my persecutors stumble and prevail not, They have been exceedingly ashamed, For they have not acted isely, Confusion age-during is not forgotten.
And, O Jehovah of Hosts, trier of the righteous, Beholder of reins and heart, I do see Thy vengeance out of them, For unto Thee I have revealed my cause.
Sing ye to Jehovah, praise Jehovah, For He hath delivered the soul of the needy From the hand of evil doers.
Cursed [is] the day in hich I as born, The day that my mother bare me, Let it not be blessed!
Cursed [is] the man ho bore tidings [to] my father, saying, ’Born to thee hath been a child — a male,’ Making him very glad!
Then hath that man been as the cities, That Jehovah overthre, and repented not, And he hath heard a cry at morning, And a shout at time of noon.
Because he hath not put me to death from the omb, And my mother is to me — my grave, And her omb a pregnancy age-during.
Why [is] this? from the omb I have come out, To see labour and sorro, Yea, consumed in shame are my days!
The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, in the king Zedekiah’s sending unto him Pashhur son of Malchiah, and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,

’Inquire, e pray thee, for us at Jehovah, for Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath fought against us; perhaps Jehovah doth deal ith us according to all His onders, and doth cause him to go up from off us.’
And Jeremiah saith unto them, ’Thus do ye say unto Zedekiah,

Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel: Lo, I am turning round the eapons of battle That [are] in your hand, With hich ye do fight the king of Babylon, And the Chaldeans, ho are laying siege against you, At the outside of the all, And I have gathered them into the midst of this city,
And I — I have fought against you, With a stretched-out hand, and ith a strong arm, And in anger, and in fury, and in great rath,
And I have smitten the inhabitants of this city, Both man and beast, By a great pestilence do they die.

And after this — an affirmation of Jehovah, I give Zedekiah king of Judah, And his servants, and the people, And those left in this city, From the pestilence, from the sord, and from the famine, Into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, And into the hand of their enemies, And into the hand of those seeking their life, And he hath smitten them by the mouth of the sord, He hath no pity on them, Nor doth he spare, nor hath he mercy.
And unto this people thou dost say, Thus said Jehovah: Lo, I am setting before you the ay of life, And the ay of death!

Whoso is abiding in this city — dieth, By sord, and by famine, and by pestilence, And hoso is going forth, And hath fallen unto the Chaldeans, Who are laying siege against you — liveth, And his life hath been to him for a spoil.
For I have set My face against this city for evil, And not for good — an affirmation of Jehovah. Into the hand of the king of Babylon it is given, And he hath burned it ith fire.
And as to the house of the king of Judah, Hear ye a ord of Jehovah;

O house of David, thus said Jehovah: Decide ye judgment at morning, And deliver the plundered from the hand of the oppressor, Lest My fury go forth as fire, And hath burned, and none is quenching, Because of the evil of your doings.
Lo, I [am] against thee — an affirmation of Jehovah, O inhabitant of the valley, rock of the plain, Who are saying, Who cometh don against us? And ho cometh into our habitations?
And I have laid a charge against you, According to the fruit of your doings, An affirmation of Jehovah, And I have kindled a fire in its forest, And it hath consumed — all its suburbs!
Thus said Jehovah, ’Go don [to] the house of the king of Judah, and thou hast spoken there this ord, and hast said,
Hear a ord of Jehovah, O king of Judah, ho art sitting on the throne of David, thou, and thy servants, and thy people, ho are coming in at these gates,

Thus said Jehovah: Do ye judgment and righteousness, And deliver the plundered from the hand of the oppressor, And sojourner, orphan, and ido, ye do not oppress nor rong, And innocent blood ye do not shed in this place.
For, if ye certainly do this thing, Then come in by the gates of this house Have kings sitting for David on his throne, Riding on chariot, and on horses, He, and his servants, and his people.
And if ye do not hear these ords, By myself I have sorn — an affirmation of Jehovah, That this house is for a desolation.
For thus said Jehovah, Concerning the house of the king of Judah: Gilead [art] thou to Me — head of Lebanon, If not — I make thee a ilderness, Cities not inhabited.
And I have separated for thee destroyers, Each ith his eapons, And they have cut don the choice of thy cedars, And have cast them on the fire.
And many nations have passed by this city, And they have said, each to his neighbour, For hat hath Jehovah done thus to this great city?
And they have said, ’Because that they have forsaken The covenant of Jehovah their God, And bo themselves to other gods, and serve them.’
Ye do not eep for the dead, nor bemoan for him, Weep ye sore for the traveller, For he doth not return again, Nor hath he seen the land of his birth.
For thus said Jehovah concerning Shallum son of Josiah king of Judah, ho is reigning instead of Josiah his father, ho hath gone forth from this place: He doth not turn back hither again;
For in the place hither they have removed him he dieth, And this land he doth not see again.
Woe to him ho is building his house by unrighteousness, And his upper chambers by injustice, On his neighbour he layeth service for nought, And his age he doth not give to him.
Who is saying, ’I build for myself a large house, And airy upper chambers,’ And he hath cut out for himself its indos, Ceiled ith cedar, and painted ith vermilion.
Dost thou reign, because thou art fretting thyself in cedar? Thy father — did he not eat and drink? Yea, he did judgment and righteousness, Then [it is] ell ith him.
He decided the cause of the poor and needy, Then [it is] ell — is it not to kno Me? An affirmation of Jehovah.
But thine eyes and thy heart are not, Except on thy dishonest gain, And on shedding of innocent blood, And on oppression, and on doing of violence.
Therefore, thus said Jehovah concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: They do not lament for him, Ah, my brother, and Ah, sister, They do not lament for him, Ah, lord, and Ah, his honour.
The burial of an ass — he is buried, Dragged and cast out thence to the gates of Jerusalem.
Go up to Lebanon, and cry, And in Bashan give forth thy voice, And cry from Abarim, For destroyed have been all loving thee.
I have spoken unto thee in thine ease, Thou hast said, ’I do not hearken,’ This [is] thy ay from thy youth, For thou hast not hearkened to My voice.
All thy friends consume doth ind, And thy lovers into captivity do go, Surely then thou art ashamed, And hast blushed for all thy ickedness.
O deller in Lebanon, making a nest among cedars, Ho gracious hast thou been hen pangs come to thee, Pain — as of a travailing oman.
I live — an affirmation of Jehovah, Though Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah Were a seal on My right hand, Surely thence I dra thee aay,
And I have given thee into the hand of those seeking thy life, And into hands of hich thou art afraid, Into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, And into the hand of the Chaldeans.
And I have cast thee, And thy mother ho bore thee, unto another country, Where ye ere not born, and there do ye die.
And to the land hither they are lifting up their soul to return, Thither they do not return.

A grief — a despised broken thing — is this man Coniah? A vessel in hich there is no pleasure? Wherefore have they been cast up and don, He and his seed, Yea, they ere cast on to a land that they kne not?
Earth, earth, earth, hear a ord of Jehovah,
Thus said Jehovah: Write ye this man childless, A man — he doth not prosper in his days, For none of his seed doth prosper, Sitting on the throne of David, And ruling again in Judah!
Woe to shepherds destroying, And scattering the flock of My pasture, An affirmation of Jehovah.

Therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Against the shepherds ho feed My people, Ye have scattered My flock, and drive them aay, And have not inspected them, Lo, I am charging on you the evil of your doings, An affirmation of Jehovah.
And I do gather the remnant of My flock Out of all the lands hither I drove them, And have brought them back unto their fold, And they have been fruitful, and multiplied.
And I have raised for them shepherds, And they have fed them, And they fear no more, nor are affrighted, Nor are they lacking — an affirmation of Jehovah.
Lo, days are coming — an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have raised to David a righteous shoot, And a king hath reigned and acted isely, And done judgment and righteousness in the earth.
In his days is Judah saved, and Israel delleth confidently, And this his name that Jehovah proclaimeth him, ’Our Righteousness.’
Therefore, lo, days are coming, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they do not say any more, Jehovah liveth ho brought up The sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,
But — Jehovah liveth, ho brought up, And ho brought in, the seed of the house of Israel, From the land of the north, And from all the lands hither I drove them, And they have delt on their on ground!

In reference to the prophets: Broken hath been my heart in my midst, Fluttered have all my bones, I have been as a man — a drunkard, And as a man — ine hath passed over him, Because of Jehovah, and of His holy ords.
For of adulterers hath the land been full, For because of these hath the land mourned, Dried up hath been the pleasant places of the ilderness, And their course is evil, and their might — not right.
For both prophet and priest have been profane, Yea, in My house I found their ickedness, An affirmation of Jehovah.

Therefore is their ay to them as slippery places, Into thick darkness they are driven, And they have fallen in it, For I bring in against them evil, The year of their inspection, An affirmation of Jehovah.
And in prophets of Samaria I have seen folly, They have prophesied by Baal, And cause my people — Israel — to err.

And in prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing, Committing adultery, and alking falsely, Yea, they strengthened the hands of evil doers, So that they have not turned back Each from his ickedness, They have been to me — all of them — as Sodom, And its inhabitants as Gomorrah.

Therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts, concerning the prophets: Lo, I am causing them to eat ormood, And have caused them to drink ater of gall, For, from prophets of Jerusalem Hath profanity gone forth to all the land.

Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Ye do not hearken unto the ords Of the prophets ho are prophesying to you, They are making you vain things, A vision of their on heart they speak, Not from the mouth of Jehovah.
Saying diligently to those despising The ord of Jehovah: Peace is for you, And [to] every one alking in the stubbornness of his heart they have said: Evil doth not come in unto you.
For ho hath stood in the counsel of Jehovah, And seeth and heareth His ord? Who hath regarded My ord, and hearkeneth?
Lo, a hirlind of Jehovah — Fury hath gone out, even a piercing hirlind, On the head of the icked it stayeth.
The anger of Jehovah doth not turn back Till His doing, and till His establishing, The thoughts of His heart, In the latter end of the days ye attend to it With understanding.
I have not sent the prophets, and they have run, I have not spoken unto them, and they have prophesied.
But — if they stood in My counsel, Then they cause My people to hear My ords, And they turn them back from their evil ay, And from the evil of their doings.
A God near [am] I — an affirmation of Jehovah, And not a God afar off?
Is any one hidden in secret places, And I see him not? an affirmation of Jehovah, Do not I fill the heavens and the earth? An affirmation of Jehovah.
I have heard that hich the prophets said, Who prophesy in My name falsehood, saying, ’I have dreamed, I have dreamed.’
Till hen is it in the heart of the prophets? The prophets of falsehood, Yea, prophets of the deceit of their heart,
Who are devising to cause My people To forget My name by their dreams, That they recount each to his neighbour, As their fathers forgot my name for Baal.
The prophet ith hom [is] a dream, Let him recount the dream, And he ith hom [is] My ord, Let him truly speak My ord. What — to the stra ith the corn? An affirmation of Jehovah.
Is it not thus? My ord [is] as a fire, An affirmation of Jehovah. And as a hammer — it breaketh in pieces a rock.
Therefore, lo, I [am] against the prophets, An affirmation of Jehovah, Stealing My ords each from his neighbour.
Lo, I [am] against the prophets, An affirmation of Jehovah, Who are making smooth their tongue, And they affirm — an affirmation.

Lo, I [am] against the prophets of false dreams, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they recount them, and cause my people to err, By their falsehoods, and by their instability, And I — I have not sent them, Nor have I commanded them, And they are not at all profitable to this people, An affirmation of Jehovah.

And hen this people, or the prophet, Or a priest, doth ask thee, saying, What [is] the burden of Jehovah? Then thou hast said unto them: Ye [are] the burden, and I have left you, An affirmation of Jehovah.
And the prophet, and the priest, and the people, That saith, The burden of Jehovah, I have seen after that man, and after his house.
Thus do ye say each unto his neighbour, And each unto his brother: What hath Jehovah ansered? And hat hath Jehovah spoken?
And the burden of Jehovah ye do not mention any more, For the burden to each is — His ord, And ye have overturned the ords of the living God, Jehovah of Hosts, our God.
Thus dost thou say unto the prophet What hath Jehovah ansered thee? And hat hath Jehovah spoken?
And if the burden of Jehovah ye say, Therefore thus said Jehovah: Because of your saying this ord, The burden of Jehovah, And I do send unto you, saying, Ye do not say, The burden of Jehovah.
Therefore, lo, I — I have taken you utterly aay, And I have sent you out, And the city that I gave to you, And to your fathers, from before My face,
And I have put on you reproach age-during, And shame age-during that is not forgotten!

Jehovah hath sheed me, and lo, to baskets of figs, appointed before the temple of Jehovah, — after the removing by Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, of Jeconiah, son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the heads of Judah, and the artisan, and the smith, from Jerusalem, hen he bringeth them into Babylon —
In the one basket [are] figs very good, like the first-ripe figs, and in the other basket [are] figs very bad, that are not eaten for badness.
And Jehovah saith unto me, ’What art thou seeing, Jeremiah?’ and I say, ’Figs, the good figs [are] very good, and the bad [are] very bad, that are not eaten for badness.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Like these good figs so do I acknoledge The removed of Judah — that I sent from this place, [To] the land of the Chaldeans — for good.
And I have set Mine eyes on them for good, And have brought them back to this land, And built them up, and I thro not don, And have planted them, and pluck not up.
And have given to them a heart to kno Me, For I [am] Jehovah, And they have been to Me for a people, And I am to them for God, For they turned back unto Me ith all their heart.

And like the bad figs, that are not eaten for badness, Surely thus said Jehovah: So do I make Zedekiah king of Judah, And his heads, and the remnant of Jerusalem, Who are left in this land, And ho are delling in the land of Egypt,
And I have given them for a trembling, For evil — to all kingdoms of the earth, For a reproach, and for a simile, For a byord, and for a reviling, In all the places hither I drive them.
And I have sent against them the sord, The famine and the pestilence, Till their consumption from off the ground, That I gave to them and to their fathers!
The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, — it [is] the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, —
Which Jeremiah the prophet hath spoken concerning all the people of Judah, even unto all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:

’From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah, and unto this day — this three and tentieth year — hath the ord of Jehovah been unto me, and I speak unto you, rising early and speaking, and ye have not hearkened;
And Jehovah hath sent unto you all His servants, the prophets, rising early and sending, and ye have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear, saying:
’Turn back, I pray you, each from his evil ay, and from the evil of your doings, and dell on the ground that Jehovah hath given to you and to your fathers from age unto age,
And ye do not go after other gods to serve them, and to bo yourselves to them, nor do ye provoke Me to anger ith the ork of your hands, and I do no evil to you;
And ye have not hearkened unto Me — an affirmation of Jehovah — so as to provoke Me to anger ith the ork of your hands for evil to you.
’Therefore thus said Jehovah of Hosts, Because that ye have not obeyed My ords,

Lo, I am sending, and have taken all the families of the north — an affirmation of Jehovah — even unto Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and have brought them in against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations round about, and have devoted them, and appointed them for an astonishment, and for a hissing, and for astes age-during.
And I have destroyed from them the voice of rejoicing, and the voice of joy, voice of bridegroom and voice of bride, noise of millstones, and the light of lamps.
And all this land hath been for a aste, for an astonishment, and these nations have served the king of Babylon seventy years.

’And it hath come to pass, at the fulness of seventy years, I charge against the king of Babylon, and against that nation — an affirmation of Jehovah — their iniquity, and against the land of the Chaldeans, and have appointed it for desolations age-during.
And I have brought in on that land all My ords that I have spoken against it, all that is ritten in this book, that Jeremiah hath prophesied concerning all the nations.
For laid service on them — also them — have many nations and great kings, and I have given recompence to them according to their doing, and according to the ork of their hands.
’For thus said Jehovah God of Israel unto me, Take the ine cup of this fury out of My hand, and thou hast caused all the nations to drink it unto hom I am sending thee;
And they have drunk, and shaken themselves and shen themselves foolish, because of the sord that I am sending among them.
’And I take the cup out of the hand of Jehovah, and cause all the nations to drink unto hom Jehovah sent me:
Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, And its kings, its heads, To give them to aste, to astonishment, To hissing, and to reviling, as [at] this day.
Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, And his heads, and all his people,
And all the mixed people, And all the kings of the land of Uz, And all the kings of the land of the Philistines, And Ashkelon, and Gazzah, and Ekron, And the remnant of Ashdod,
Edom, and Moab, and the sons of Ammon,
And all the kings of Tyre, And all the kings of Zidon, And the kings of the isle that [is] beyond the sea,
Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, And all cutting the corners [of the beard],
And all the kings of Arabia, And all the kings of the mixed people, Who are delling in the ilderness,
And all the kings of Zimri, And all the kings of Elam, And all the kings of Media,
And all the kings of the north, The near and the far off, one unto another, And all the kingdoms of the earth, That [are] on the face of the ground, And king Sheshach drinketh after them.
And thou hast said unto them: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts God of Israel, Drink ye, yea drink abundantly, And vomit, and fall, and rise not, Because of the sord that I am sending among you.
And it hath come to pass, When they refuse to receive the cup out of thy hand to drink, That thou hast said unto them: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, Ye do certainly drink.

For lo, in the city over hich My name is called, I am beginning to do evil, And ye — ye are entirely acquitted! Ye are not acquitted, for a sord I am proclaiming, For all inhabitants of the land, An affirmation of Jehovah of Hosts.

And thou, thou dost prophesy unto them all these ords, and hast said unto them: Jehovah from the high place doth roar, And from His holy habitation giveth forth His voice, He surely roareth for His habitation, A shout as of treaders don, God ansereth all the inhabitants of the land,
Wasting hath come unto the end of the earth, For a controversy hath Jehovah ith nations, He hath executed judgment for all flesh, The icked! He hath given them to the sord, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Lo, evil is going out from nation to nation, And a great hirlind is stirred up from the sides of the earth.

And the pierced of Jehovah have been in that day, From the end of the earth even unto the end of the earth, They are not lamented, nor gathered, nor buried, For dung on the face of the ground they are.
Hol, ye shepherds, and cry, And roll yourselves, ye honourable of the flock, For full have been your days, For slaughtering, and [for] your scatterings, And ye have fallen as a desirable vessel.
And perished hath refuge from the shepherds, And escape from the honourable of the flock.
A voice [is] of the cry of the shepherds, And a holing of the honourable of the flock, For Jehovah is spoiling their pasture.
And the peaceable habitations have been cut don, Because of the fierceness of the anger of Jehovah.
He hath forsaken, as a young lion, His covert, Surely their land hath become a desolation, Because of the oppressing fierceness, And because of the fierceness of His anger!
In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, hath this ord been from Jehovah, saying:

’Thus said Jehovah, Stand thou in the court of the house of Jehovah, and thou hast spoken unto all [those of] the cities of Judah ho are coming in to bo themselves in the house of Jehovah, all the ords that I have commanded thee to speak unto them, thou dost not diminish a ord.
If so be they hearken, and turn back each from his evil ay, then I have repented concerning the evil that I am thinking of doing to them, because of the evil of their doings.
’And thou hast said unto them: Thus said Jehovah, If ye do not hearken unto Me, to alk in My la, that I set before you,
To hearken to the ords of My servants the prophets, hom I am sending unto you, yea, rising early and sending, and ye have not hearkened,
Then I have given up this house as Shiloh, and this city I give up for a reviling to all nations of the earth.’
And the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, hear Jeremiah speaking these ords in the house of Jehovah,

And it cometh to pass, at the completion of Jeremiah’s speaking all that Jehovah hath commanded him to speak unto all the people, that the priests, and the prophets, and all the people catch him, saying, Thou dost surely die,

Wherefore hast thou prophesied in the name of Jehovah, saying, ’As Shiloh this house shall be, and this city is asted, ithout inhabitant?’ and all the people are assembled unto Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah.
And the heads of Judah hear these things, and they go up from the house of the king [to] the house of Jehovah, and sit in the opening of the ne gate of Jehovah.

And the priests and the prophets speak unto the heads, and unto all the people, saying, ’Judgment of death [is] for this man, for he hath prophesied against this city, as ye have heard ith your ears.’
And Jeremiah speaketh unto all the heads, and unto all the people, saying, ’Jehovah sent me to prophesy concerning this house, and concerning this city, all the ords that ye have heard;
And no, amend your ays, and your doings, and hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God, and Jehovah doth repent concerning the evil that He hath spoken against you.
’And I, lo, I [am] in your hand, do to me as is good and as is right in your eyes;

Only, kno ye certainly, that if ye are putting me to death, surely innocent blood ye are putting on yourselves, and on this city, and on its inhabitants; for truly hath Jehovah sent me unto you to speak in your ears all these ords.’
And the heads and all the people say unto the priests and unto the prophets, ’There is not for this man a judgment of death, for in the name of Jehovah our God he hath spoken unto us.’
And certain of the elders of the land rise up, and speak unto all the assembly of the people, saying,

’Micah the Morashtite hath been prophesying in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he saith unto all the people of Judah, saying: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Zion is a ploed field, and Jerusalem is heaps, And the mountain of the house is for high places of a forest.

’Put him at all to death did Hezekiah king of Judah, and all Judah? Did he not fear Jehovah? yea, he appeaseth the face of Jehovah, and Jehovah repenteth concerning the evil that He spake against them; and e are doing great evil against our souls.

’And also there hath been a man prophesying in the name of Jehovah, Urijah son of Shemaiah, of Kirjath-Jearim, and he prophesieth against this city, and against this land according to all the ords of Jeremiah,
And the king Jehoiakim, and all his mighty ones, and all the heads, hear his ords, and the king seeketh to put him to death, and Urijah heareth, and feareth, and fleeth, and goeth in to Egypt.
And the king Jehoiakim sendeth men to Egypt — Elnathan son of Achbor, and men ith him unto Egypt —
And they bring out Urijah from Egypt, and bring him in unto the king Jehoiakim, and he smiteth him ith a sord, and casteth his corpse unto the graves of the sons of the people.’
Only, the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan hath been ith Jeremiah so as not to give him up into the hand of the people to put him to death.
In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, hath this ord been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
’Thus said Jehovah unto me, Make to thee bands and yokes,

And thou hast put them on thy neck, and hast sent them unto the king of Edom, and unto the king of Moab, and unto the king of the sons of Ammon, and unto the king of Tyre, and unto the king of Zidon, by the hand of messengers ho are coming in to Jerusalem, unto Zedekiah king of Judah;
And thou hast commanded them for their lords, saying, Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel,

Thus do ye say unto your lords, I — I have made the earth ith man, and the cattle that [are] on the face of the earth, by My great poer, and by My stretched-out arm, and I have given it to hom it hath been right in Mine eyes.
’And no, I — I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and also the beast of the field I have given to him to serve him;
And served him have all the nations, and his son, and his son’s son, till the coming in of the time of his land, also it; and done service for him have many nations and great kings.

And it hath come to pass, the nation and the kingdom that do not serve him — Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon — and that hich putteth not its neck into the yoke of the king of Babylon, ith sord, and ith famine, and ith pestilence, I lay a charge on that nation — an affirmation of Jehovah — till I consume them by his hand.

’And ye, ye do not hearken unto your prophets, and unto your diviners, and unto your dreamers, and unto your observers of clouds, and unto your sorcerers ho are speaking unto you, saying, Ye do not serve the king of Babylon, —
For falsehood they are prophesying to you, so as to remove you far from off your ground, and I have driven you out, and ye have perished.

And the nation that causeth its neck to enter into the yoke of the king of Babylon, and hath served him — I have left it on its ground — an affirmation of Jehovah — and it hath tilled it, and delt in it.’
And unto Zedekiah king of Judah I have spoken according to all these ords, saying, ’Cause your necks to enter into the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
Why do ye die, thou and thy people, by sord, by famine, and by pestilence, as Jehovah hath spoken concerning the nation that doth not serve the king of Babylon?
’And ye do not hearken unto the ords of the prophets ho are speaking unto you, saying, Ye do not serve the king of Babylon, — for falsehood they are prophesying to you.
For I have not sent them — an affirmation of Jehovah — and they are prophesying in My name falsely, so as to drive you out, and ye have perished, ye, and the prophets ho are prophesying to you.’

And unto the priests, and unto all this people, I have spoken, saying, ’Thus said Jehovah, Ye do not hearken unto the ords of your prophets, ho are prophesying to you, saying, Lo, the vessels of the house of Jehovah are brought back from Babylon no in haste, for falsehood they are prophesying to you.
Ye do not hearken unto them, serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why is this city a aste?

’And, if they be prophets, and if a ord of Jehovah be ith them, let them intercede, I pray you, ith Jehovah of Hosts, so that the vessels that are left in the house of Jehovah, and [in] the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, have not gone into Babylon.
For thus said Jehovah of Hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,
That Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon hath not taken, in his removing Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon ith all the freemen of Judah and Jerusalem,
Surely thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left of the house of Jehovah, and of the house of the king of Judah, and [in] Jerusalem:
To Babylon they are brought, and there they are till the day of My inspecting them — an affirmation of Jehovah; then I have brought them up, and have brought them back unto this place.’

And it cometh to pass, in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, spoken unto me hath Hananiah son of Azur the prophet, ho [is] of Gibeon, in the house of Jehovah, before the eyes of the priests, and all the people, saying,
’Thus spake Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon;
Within to years of days I am bringing back unto this place all the vessels of the house of Jehovah that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon hath taken from this place, and doth carry to Babylon,

And Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the removed of Judah, ho are entering Babylon, I am bringing back unto this place — an affirmation of Jehovah; for I do break the yoke of the king of Babylon.’
And Jeremiah the prophet saith unto Hananiah the prophet, before the eyes of the priests, and before the eyes of all the people ho are standing in the house of Jehovah,

Yea, Jeremiah the prophet saith, ’Amen! so may Jehovah do; Jehovah establish thy ords that thou hast prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the house of Jehovah and all the removal from Babylon, unto this place.
’Only, hear, I pray thee, this ord that I am speaking in thine ears, and in the ears of all the people.
The prophets ho have been before me, and before thee, from of old, even they prophesy concerning many lands, and concerning great kingdoms, of battle, and of evil, and of pestilence.
The prophet ho doth prophesy of peace — by the coming in of the ord of the prophet, knon is the prophet that Jehovah hath truly sent him.’
And Hananiah the prophet taketh the yoke from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, and breaketh it,

And Hananiah speaketh before the eyes of all the people, saying, ’Thus said Jehovah, Thus I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, ithin to years of days, from off the neck of all the nations;’ and Jeremiah the prophet goeth on his ay.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah after the breaking, by Hananiah the prophet, of the yoke from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
’Go, and thou hast spoken unto Hananiah, saying, Thus said Jehovah, Yokes of ood thou hast broken, and I have made instead of them yokes of iron;

Therefore thus said Jehovah, Lo, I am casting thee from off the face of the ground; this year thou diest, for apostasy thou hast spoken concerning Jehovah.’
And Hananiah the prophet dieth in that year, in the seventh month.

And these [are] ords of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem unto the remnant of the elders of the removal, and unto the priests, and unto the prophets, and unto all the people — hom Nebuchadnezzar removed from Jerusalem to Babylon,
After the going forth of Jeconiah the king, and the mistress, and the officers, heads of Judah and Jerusalem, and the artificer, and the smith, from Jerusalem —
By the hand of Eleasah son of Shaphan, and Gemariah son of Hilkijah, hom Zedekiah king of Judah sent unto Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon — to Babylon, saying,
’Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, to all the removal that I removed from Jerusalem to Babylon,
Build ye houses, and abide; and plant ye gardens, and eat their fruit;
Take ye ives, and beget sons and daughters; and take for your sons ives, and your daughters give to husbands, and they bear sons and daughters; and multiply there, and ye are not fe;
And seek the peace of the city hither I have removed you, and pray for it unto Jehovah, for in its peace ye have peace.
’For thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Let not your prophets ho [are] in your midst, and your diviners, lift you up, nor hearken ye unto their dreams, that ye are causing [them] to dream;
For ith falsehood they are prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, an affirmation of Jehovah.
’For thus said Jehovah, Surely at the fulness of Babylon — seventy years — I inspect you, and have established toards you My good ord, to bring you back unto this place.
For I have knon the thoughts that I am thinking toards you — an affirmation of Jehovah; thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give to you posterity and hope.
’And ye have called Me, and have gone, and have prayed unto Me, and I have hearkened unto you,

’Because ye have said, Jehovah hath raised up to us prophets in Babylon,
Surely thus said Jehovah concerning the king ho is sitting on the throne of David, and concerning all the people that is delling in this city, your brethren ho ent not forth ith you in the removal;

And taken from them hath been a reviling by all the removed of Judah that [are] in Babylon, saying, Jehovah doth set thee as Zedekiah, and as Ahab, hom the king of Babylon roasted ith fire;

Because that they have done folly in Israel, and commit adultery ith the ives of their neighbours, and speak a ord in My name falsely that I have not commanded them, and I [am] He ho knoeth and a itness — an affirmation of Jehovah.
’And unto Shemaiah the Nehelamite thou dost speak, saying,

Jehovah hath made thee priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, for there being inspectors of the house of Jehovah, for every one mad and making himself a prophet, and thou hast put him unto the torture and unto the stocks.
And no, hy hast thou not pushed against Jeremiah of Anathoth, ho is making himself a prophet to you?
Because that he hath sent unto us to Babylon, saying, It [is] long, build ye houses, and abide; and plant ye gardens, and eat their fruit.’

The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,

For, lo, days are coming — an affirmation of Jehovah — and I have turned back [to] the captivity of My people Israel and Judah, said Jehovah, and I have caused them to turn back unto the land that I gave to their fathers, and they do possess it.’
And these [are] the ords that Jehovah hath spoken concerning Israel and concerning Judah:
Surely thus said Jehovah: A voice of trembling e have heard, Fear — and there is no peace.

And thou, be not afraid, My servant Jacob, An affirmation of Jehovah, Nor be affrighted, O Israel, For, lo, I am saving thee from afar, And thy seed from the land of their captivity, And Jacob hath turned back and rested, And is quiet, and there is none troubling.

For ith thee [am] I, An affirmation of Jehovah — to save thee, For I make an end of all the nations Whither I have scattered thee, Only, of thee I do not make an end, And I have chastised thee in judgment, And do not entirely acquit thee.
For thus said Jehovah: Incurable is thy breach, grievous thy stroke,
There is none judging thy cause to bind up, Healing medicines there are none for thee.

all loving thee have forgotten thee, Thee they do not seek, For ith the stroke of an enemy I smote thee, The chastisement of a fierce one, Because of the abundance of thy iniquity, Mighty have been thy sins!
What! — thou criest concerning thy breach! Incurable [is] thy pain, Because of the abundance of thy iniquity, Mighty have been thy sins! I have done these to thee.
Therefore all consuming thee are consumed, And all thine adversaries — all of them — Into captivity do go, And thy spoilers have been for a spoil, And all thy plunderers I give up to plunder.
For I increase health to thee, And from thy strokes I do heal thee, An affirmation of Jehovah, For ’Outcast’ they have called to thee, ’Zion it [is], there is none seeking for her.’

For there is a day, Cried have atchmen on mount Ephraim, ’Rise, and e go up to Zion, unto Jehovah our God;

Then rejoice doth a virgin in a chorus, Both young men and old men — together, And I have turned their mourning to joy, And have comforted them, And gladdened them above their sorro,
And satisfied the soul of the priests [ith] fatness, And My people ith My goodness are satisfied, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Thus said Jehovah, A voice in Ramah is heard, ailing, eeping most bitter, Rachel is eeping for her sons, She hath refused to be comforted for her sons, because they are not.
Thus said Jehovah: Withhold thy voice from eeping, and thine eyes from tears, For there is a reard for thy ork, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they have turned back from the land of the enemy.
And there is hope for thy latter end, An affirmation of Jehovah, And the sons have turned back [to] their border.

For after my turning back I repented, And after my being instructed I struck on the thigh, I have been ashamed, I have also blushed, For I have borne the reproach of my youth.

A precious son is Ephraim to Me? A child of delights? For since My speaking against him, I do thoroughly remember him still, Therefore have My boels been moved for him, I do greatly love him, An affirmation of Jehovah.
Set up for thee signs, make for thee heaps, Set thy heart to the highay, the ay thou entest, Turn back, O virgin of Israel, Turn back unto these thy cities.

And delt in Judah have husbandmen, and in all its cities together, And they have journeyed in order.
For I have satiated the eary soul, And every grieved soul I have filled.’
On this I have aaked, and I behold, and my sleep hath been seet to me.
Lo, days are coming, an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have son the house of Israel, And the house of Judah, With seed of man, and seed of beast.

And Jeremiah saith, ’A ord of Jehovah hath been unto me saying,

And I pray unto Jehovah — after my giving the purchase-book unto Baruch son of Neriah — saying,
’Ah, Lord Jehovah, lo, Thou hast made the heavens and the earth by Thy great poer, and by Thy stretched-out arm; there is nothing too onderful for Thee:
Doing kindness to thousands, and recompensing iniquity of fathers into the bosom of their sons after them; God, the great, the mighty, Jehovah of Hosts [is] His name,
Great in counsel, and mighty in act, in that Thine eyes are open on all the ays of the sons of Adam, to give to each according to his ays, and according to the fruit of his doings:
In that thou hast done signs and onders in the land of Egypt unto this day, and in Israel, and among men, and Thou dost make for Thee a name as [at] this day.
’And Thou bringest forth Thy people Israel from the land of Egypt, ith signs and ith onders, and by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great fear,
And thou givest to them this land that thou didst sear to their fathers to give to them, a land floing ith milk and honey,

’Lo, the mounts — they have come in to the city to capture it, and the city hath been given into the hand of the Chaldeans ho are fighting against it, because of the sord, and the famine, and the pestilence; and that hich Thou hast spoken hath come to pass, and lo, Thou art seeing;

And the ord of Jehovah is unto Jeremiah, saying:
’Lo, I [am] Jehovah, God of all flesh: For Me is anything too onderful?
’Therefore, thus said Jehovah, Lo, I am giving this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he hath captured it;

And come in have the Chaldeans ho are fighting against this city, and they have set this city on fire, and have burned it, and the houses on hose roofs they made perfume to Baal, and poured out libations to other gods, so as to provoke Me to anger.

For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been only doing evil in Mine eyes, from their youth; for the sons of Israel are only provoking Me ith the ork of their hands — an affirmation of Jehovah.
’For a cause of Mine anger, and a cause of My fury, hath this city been to Me, even from the day that they built it, and unto this day — to turn it aside from before My face,

Because of all the evil of the sons of Israel, and of the sons of Judah that they have done, so as to provoke Me — they, their kings, their heads, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And they turn unto Me the neck, and not the face, and teaching them, rising early and teaching, and they are not hearkening to accept instruction.
’And they set their abominations in the house over hich My name is called, so as to defile it;

And they build the high places of Baal, that [are] in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through to Molech, hich I did not command them, nor did it come up on my heart to do this abomination, so as to cause Judah to sin.
’And no, therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, concerning this city, of hich ye are saying, It hath been given into the hand of the king of Babylon by sord, and by famine, and by pestilence,

Lo, I am gathering them out of all the lands hither I have driven them in Mine anger, and in My fury, and in great rath, and I have brought them back unto this place, and have caused them to dell confidently;
and they have been to Me for a people, and I am to them for God;
and I have given to them one heart, and one ay, to fear Me all the days, for good to them, and to their sons after them:
and I have made for them a covenant age-during, in that I turn not back from after them for My doing them good, and My fear I put in their heart, so as not to turn aside from me;
and I have rejoiced over them to do them good, and have planted them in this land in truth, ith all my heart, and ith all My soul.

and bought hath been the field in this land of hich ye are saying, A desolation it [is], ithout man and beast, it hath been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.

And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah a second time — and he [is] yet detained in the court of the prison — saying:

they are coming in to fight ith the Chaldeans, and to fill them ith the carcases of men, hom I have smitten in Mine anger, and in My fury, and [for] hom I have hidden My face from this city, because of all their evil:

Is a voice of joy and a voice of gladness, Voice of bridegroom, and voice of bride, The voice of those saying, Thank Jehovah of Hosts, for Jehovah [is] good, For His kindness [is] to the age, Who are bringing in thanksgiving to the house of Jehovah, For I turn back the captivity of the land, As at the first, said Jehovah.

And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah, saying,
’Thus said Jehovah: If ye do break My covenant of the day, And My covenant of the night, So that they are not daily and nightly in their season,

And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah, saying:
’Hast thou not considered hat this people have spoken, saying: The to families on hich Jehovah fixed, He doth reject them, And my people they despise — So that they are no more a people before them!

and thou, thou dost not escape out of his hand, for thou art certainly caught, and into his hand thou art given, and thine eyes see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and his mouth ith thy mouth speaketh, and Babylon thou enterest.

to send out each his man-servant, and each his maid-servant — the Hebre and the Hebreess — free, so as not to lay service on them, any on a Je his brother;

and hearken do all the heads, and all the people ho have come in to the covenant to send forth each his man-servant and each his maid-servant free, so as not to lay service on them any more, yea, they hearken, and send them aay;
and they turn afterards, and cause the men-servants and the maid-servants to return, hom they had sent forth free, and they subdue them for men-servants and for maid-servants.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:
’Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, I — I made a covenant ith your fathers in the day of My bringing them forth from the land of Egypt, from a house of servants, saying,

At the end of seven years ye do send forth each his brother, the Hebre, ho is sold to thee, and hath served thee six years, yea, thou hast sent him forth free from thee: and your fathers hearkened not unto Me, nor inclined their ear.
’And ye turn back, ye to-day, and ye do that hich is right in Mine eyes, to proclaim liberty each to his neighbour, and ye make a covenant before Me in the house over hich My name is called.

And — ye turn back, and pollute My name, and ye cause each his man-servant and each his maid-servant, hom he had sent forth free, (at their pleasure,) to return, and ye subdue them to be to you for men-servants and for maid-servants.

’Therefore, thus said Jehovah: Ye have not hearkened unto Me to proclaim freedom, each to his brother, and each to his neighbour; lo, I am proclaiming to you liberty — an affirmation of Jehovah — unto the sord, unto the pestilence, and unto the famine, and I have given you for a trembling to all kingdoms of the earth.

’And I have given the men ho are transgressing My covenant, ho have not established the ords of the covenant that they have made before Me, by the calf, that they have cut in to, and pass through beteen its pieces —
heads of Judah, and heads of Jerusalem, the officers, and the priests, and all the people of the land those passing through beteen the pieces of the calf —
yea, I have given them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those seeking their soul, and their carcase hath been for food to the fol of the heavens, and to the beast of the earth.

’And Zedekiah king of Judah, and his heads, I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those seeking their soul, and into the hand of the forces of the king of Babylon, that are going up from off you.

Lo, I am commanding — an affirmation of Jehovah — and have brought them back unto this city, and they have fought against it, and captured it, and burned it ith fire, and the cities of Judah I do make a desolation — ithout inhabitant.’
The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, saying:
’Go unto the house of the Rechabites, and thou hast spoken ith them, and brought them into the house of Jehovah, unto one of the chambers, and caused them to drink ine.’
And I take Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and all the house of the Rechabites,

and bring them into the house of Jehovah, unto the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God, that [is] near to the chamber of the princes, that [is] above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum, keeper of the threshold;
and I put before the sons of the house of the Rechabites goblets full of ine, and cups, and I say unto them, Drink ye ine.
And they say, ’We do not drink ine: for Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, charged us, saying, Ye do not drink ine, ye and your sons — unto the age;

and a house ye do not build, and seed ye do not so, and a vineyard ye do not plant, nor have ye any; for in tents do ye dell all your days, that ye may live many days on the face of the ground hither ye are sojourning.
’And e hearken to the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, to all that he commanded us, not to drink ine all our days, e, our ives, our sons, and our daughters;
nor to build houses for our delling; and vineyard, and field, and seed, e have none;
and e dell in tents, and e hearken, and e do according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us;

and it cometh to pass, in the coming up of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon unto the land, that e say, Come, and e enter Jerusalem, because of the force of the Chaldeans, and because of the force of Aram — and e dell in Jerusalem.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah, saying: ’Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel:
’Go, and thou hast said to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Do ye not receive instruction? — to hearken unto My ords — an affirmation of Jehovah.

Performed have been the ords of Jonadab son of Rechab, hen he commanded his sons not to drink ine, and they have not drunk unto this day, for they have obeyed the command of their father; and I — I have spoken unto you, rising early and speaking, and ye have not hearkened unto Me.

And I send unto you all My servants the prophets, rising early and sending, saying: Turn back, I pray you, each from his evil ay, and amend your doings, yea, ye do not alk after other gods, to serve them, and dell ye on the ground that I have given to you and to your fathers; and ye have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened unto Me.
’Because the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab have performed the command of their father, that he commanded them, and this people have not hearkened unto Me,

therefore thus said Jehovah, God of Hosts, God of Israel: Lo, I am bringing in unto Judah, and unto all inhabitants of Jerusalem, all the evil that I have spoken against them, because I have spoken unto them, and they have not hearkened, yea, I call to them, and they have not ansered.’

And to the house of the Rechabites said Jeremiah: ’Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Because that ye have hearkened unto the command of Jonadab your father, and ye observe all his commands, and do according to all that he commanded you;
therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Of Jonadab son of Rechab one standing before me is not cut off all the days.’
And it cometh to pass, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this ord hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:

’Take to thee a roll of a book, and thou hast ritten on it all the ords that I have spoken unto thee concerning Israel, and concerning Judah, and concerning all the nations, from the day I spake unto thee, from the days of Josiah, even unto this day;
if so be the house of Israel do hear all the evil that I am thinking of doing to them, so that they turn back each from is evil ay, and I have been propitious to their iniquity, and to their sin.’
And Jeremiah calleth Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch riteth from the mouth of Jeremiah all the ords of Jehovah, that He hath spoken unto him, on a roll of a book.
And Jeremiah commandeth Baruch, saying, ’I am restrained, I am not able to enter the house of Jehovah;

but thou hast entered — and thou hast read in the roll that thou hast ritten from my mouth, the ords of Jehovah, in the ears of the people, in the house of Jehovah, in the day of the fast, and also in the ears of all Judah ho are coming in from their cities thou dost read them;
if so be their supplication doth fall before Jehovah, and they turn back each from his evil ay, for great [is] the anger and the fury that Jehovah hath spoken concerning this people.’
And Baruch son of Neriah doth according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, to read in the book the ords of Jehovah in the house of Jehovah.

And it cometh to pass, in the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, proclaimed a fast before Jehovah have all the people in Jerusalem, and all the people ho are coming in from cities of Judah to Jerusalem;

and Baruch readeth in the book the ords of Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah, in the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the opening of the ne gate of the house of Jehovah, in the ears of all the people.
And Michaiah son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, heareth all the ords of Jehovah from off the book,

and he goeth don [to] the house of the king, unto the chamber of the scribe, and lo, there are all the heads sitting: Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan son of Acbor, and Gemariah son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the heads.
And declare to them doth Micaiah all the ords that he hath heard, hen Baruch readeth in the book in the ears of the people;

and all the heads send unto Baruch, Jehudi son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, saying, ’The roll in hich thou hast read in the ears of the people take in thy hand, and come.’ And Baruch son of Neriah taketh the roll in his hand and cometh in unto them,
and they say unto him, ’Sit don, e pray thee, and read it in our ears,’ and Baruch readeth in their ears,
and it cometh to pass, hen they hear all the ords, they have been afraid one at another, and say unto Baruch, ’We do surely declare to the king all these ords.’
And they asked Baruch, saying, ’Declare, e pray thee, to us, ho didst thou rite all these ords — from his mouth?’
And Baruch saith to them, ’From his mouth, he pronounceth unto me all these ords, and I am riting on the book ith ink.’
And the heads say unto Baruch, ’Go, be hidden, thou and Jeremiah, and let no one kno here ye [are].’
And they go in unto the king, to the court, and the roll they have laid up in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and they declare in the ears of the king all the ords.

And the king sendeth Jehudi to take the roll, and he taketh it out of the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and Jehudi readeth it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the heads ho are standing by the king;
and the king is sitting in the inter-house, in the ninth month, and the stove before him is burning,

and it cometh to pass, hen Jehudi readeth three or four leaves, he cutteth it out ith the scribe’s knife, and hath cast unto the fire, that [is] on the stove, till the consumption of all the roll by the fire that [is] on the stove.
And the king and all his servants ho are hearing all these ords have not been afraid, nor rent their garments.
And also Elnathan, and Delaiah, and Gemariah have interceded ith the king not to burn the roll, and he hath not hearkened unto them.
And the king commandeth Jerahmeel son of Hammelek, and Seraiah son of Azriel, and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Jehovah doth hide them.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah — after the king’s burning the roll, even the ords that Baruch hath ritten from the mouth of Jeremiah — saying:
’Turn, take to thee another roll, and rite on it all the former ords that ere on the first roll, that Jehoiakim king of Judah burnt,

and unto Jehoiakim king of Judah thou dost say: Thus said Jehovah, Thou hast burnt this roll, saying, Wherefore hast thou ritten on it, saying, The king of Babylon surely cometh in, and hath destroyed this land, and caused to cease from it man and beast?
’Therefore, thus said Jehovah, concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He hath none sitting on the throne of David, and his carcase is cast out to heat by day, and to cold by night;

and I have charged on him, and on his seed, and on his servants, their iniquity; and I have brought in on them, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and unto the men of Judah, all the evil that I have spoken unto them, and they hearkened not.’

And Jeremiah hath taken another roll, and giveth it unto Baruch son of Neriah the scribe, and he riteth on it from the mouth of Jeremiah all the ords of the book that Jehoiakim king of Judah hath burnt in the fire; and again there ere added unto them many ords like these.
And reign doth king Zedekiah son of Josiah instead of Coniah son of Jehoiakim hom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had caused to reign in the land of Judah,
and he hath not hearkened, he, and his servants, and the people of the land, unto the ords of Jehovah, that He spake by the hand of Jeremiah the prophet.
And Zedekiah the king sendeth Jehucal son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, unto Jeremiah the prophet, saying, ’Pray, e beseech thee, for us unto Jehovah our God.’
And Jeremiah is coming in and going out in the midst of the people, (and they have not put him in the prison-house),
and the force of Pharaoh hath come out of Egypt, and the Chaldeans, ho are laying siege against Jerusalem, hear their report, and go up from off Jerusalem.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto Jeremiah the prophet, saying:

’Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Thus do ye say unto the king of Judah, ho is sending you unto Me, to seek Me: Lo, the force of Pharaoh that is coming out to you for help hath turned back to its land, to Egypt,
and the Chaldeans have turned back, and fought against this city, and captured it, and burnt it ith fire.
’Thus said Jehovah: Lift not up your souls saying, The Chaldeans surely go from off us, for they do not go;
for though ye had smitten all the force of the Chaldeans ho are fighting ith you, and there ere left of them ounded men — each in his tent — they rise, and have burnt this city ith fire.’
And it hath come to pass, in the going up of the force of the Chaldeans from off Jerusalem, because of the force of Pharaoh,
that Jeremiah goeth out from Jerusalem to go [to] the land of Benjamin, to receive a portion thence in the midst of the people.

And it cometh to pass, he is at the gate of Benjamin, and there [is] a master of the ard — and his name is Irijah son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah — and he catcheth Jeremiah the prophet, saying, ’Unto the Chaldeans thou art falling.’
And Jeremiah saith, ’Falsehood — I am not falling unto the Chaldeans;’ and he hath not hearkened unto him, and Irijah layeth hold on Jeremiah, and bringeth him in unto the heads,
and the heads are roth against Jeremiah, and have smitten him, and put him in the prison-house — the house of Jonathan the scribe, for it they had made for a prison-house.
When Jeremiah hath entered into the house of the dungeon, and unto the cells, then Jeremiah delleth there many days,

and the king Zedekiah sendeth, and taketh him, and the king asketh him in his house in secret, and saith, ’Is there a ord from Jehovah?’ And Jeremiah saith, ’There is,’ and he saith, ’Into the hand of the king of Babylon thou art given.’
And Jeremiah saith unto the king Zedekiah, ’What have I sinned against thee, and against thy servants, and against this people, that ye have given me unto a prison-house?
And here [are] your prophets ho prophesied to you, saying, The king of Babylon doth not come in against you, and against this land?
And no, hearken, I pray thee, my lord, O king, let my supplication fall, I pray thee, before thee, and cause me not to return [to] the house of Jonathan the scribe, that I die not there.’

And the king Zedekiah commandeth, and they commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, also to give to him a cake of bread daily from the bakers’ street, till the consumption of all the bread of the city, and Jeremiah delleth in the court of the prison.
And Shephatiah son of Mattan, and Gedaliah son of Pashhur, and Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malchiah, hear the ords that Jeremiah is speaking unto all the people, saying,

’Thus said Jehovah: He ho is remaining in this city dieth, by sord, by famine, and by pestilence, and he ho is going forth unto the Chaldeans liveth, and his soul hath been to him for a prey, and he liveth.
Thus said Jehovah: This city is certainly given into the hand of the force of the king of Babylon, and he hath captured it.’

And the heads say unto the king, ’Let, e pray thee, this man be put to death, because that he is making feeble the hands of the men of ar, ho are left in this city, and the hands of all the people, by speaking unto them according to these ords, for this man is not seeking for the peace of this people, but for its evil.’
And the king Zedekiah saith, ’Lo, he [is] in your hand: for the king is not able for you [in] anything.’

And they take Jeremiah, and cast him into the pit of Malchiah son of the king, that [is] in the court of the prison, and they send don Jeremiah ith cords; and in the pit there is no ater, but mire, and Jeremiah sinketh in the mire.
And Ebed-Melech the Cushite, a eunuch ho [is] in the king’s house, heareth that they have put Jeremiah into the pit; and the king is sitting at the gate of Benjamin,
and Ebed-Melech goeth forth from the king’s house, and speaketh unto the king, saying,

’My lord, O king, these men have done evil [in] all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, hom they have cast into the pit, and he dieth in his place because of the famine, for there is no more bread in the city.’
And the king commandeth Ebed-Melech the Cushite, saying, ’Take ith thee from this thirty men, and thou hast brought up Jeremiah the prophet from the pit, before he dieth.’

And Ebed-Melech taketh the men ith him, and entereth the house of the king, unto the place of the treasury, and taketh thence orn-out clouts, and orn-out rags, and sendeth them unto Jeremiah unto the pit by cords.
And Ebed-Melech the Cushite saith unto Jeremiah, ’Put, I pray thee, the orn-out clouts and rags under thine arm-holes, at the place of the cords,’ and Jeremiah doth so,
and they dra out Jeremiah ith cords, and bring him up out of the pit, and Jeremiah delleth in the court of the prison.

And the king Zedekiah sendeth, and taketh Jeremiah the prophet unto him, unto the third entrance that [is] in the house of Jehovah, and the king saith unto Jeremiah, ’I am asking thee a thing, do not hide from me anything.’
And Jeremiah saith unto Zedekiah, ’When I declare to thee, dost thou not surely put me to death? and hen I counsel thee, thou dost not hearken unto me.’

And the king Zedekiah seareth unto Jeremiah in secret, saying, ’Jehovah liveth, He ho made for us this soul, I do not put thee to death, nor give thee unto the hand of these men ho are seeking thy soul.’

And Jeremiah saith unto Zedekiah, ’Thus said Jehovah, God of Hosts, God of Israel: If thou dost certainly go forth unto the heads of the king of Babylon, then hath thy soul lived, and this city is not burned ith fire, yea, thou hast lived, thou and thy house.

And if thou dost not go forth unto the heads of the king of Babylon, then hath this city been given into the hand of the Chaldeans, and they have burnt it ith fire, and thou dost not escape from their hand.’
And the king Zedekiah saith unto Jeremiah, ’I am fearing the Jes ho have fallen unto the Chaldeans, lest they give me into their hand, and they have insulted me.’
And Jeremiah saith, ’They do not give thee up; hearken, I pray thee, to the voice of Jehovah, to that hich I am speaking unto thee, and it is ell for thee, and thy soul doth live.
’And if thou art refusing to go forth, this [is] the thing that Jehovah hath shen me:

That, lo, all the omen ho have been left in the house of the king of Judah are brought forth unto the heads of the king of Babylon, and lo, they are saying: Persuaded thee, and prevailed against thee, Have thine allies, Sunk into mire have thy feet, They have been turned backard.

’And all thy ives, and thy sons, are brought forth unto the Chaldeans, and thou dost not escape from their hand, for by the hand of the king of Babylon thou art caught, and this city is burnt ith fire.’
And Zedekiah saith unto Jeremiah, ’Let no man kno of these ords, and thou dost not die;

and hen the heads hear that I have spoken ith thee, and they have come in unto thee, and have said unto thee, Declare to us, e pray thee, hat thou didst speak unto the king, do not hide [it] from us, and e do not put thee to death, and hat the king spake unto thee,
then thou hast said unto them, I am causing my supplication to fall before the king, not to cause me to return to the house of Jonathan, to die there.’
And all the heads come in unto Jeremiah, and ask him, and he declareth to them according to all these ords that the king commanded, and they keep silent from him, for the matter as not heard;
and Jeremiah delleth in the court of the prison till the day that Jerusalem hath been captured, and he as [there] hen Jerusalem as captured.
In the ninth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the tenth month, come hath Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon and all his force unto Jerusalem, and they lay siege against it;
in the eleventh year of Zedekiah, in the fourth month, in the ninth of the month, hath the city been broken up;

and come in do all the heads of the king of Babylon, and they sit at the middle gate, Nergal-Sharezer, Samgar-Nebo, Sarsechim, chief of the eunuchs, Nergal-Sharezer, chief of the Mages, and all the rest of the heads of the king of Babylon.

And it cometh to pass, hen Zedekiah king of Judah, and all the men of ar, have seen them, that they flee and go forth by night from the city, the ay of the king’s garden, through the gate beteen the to alls, and he goeth forth the ay of the plain.

And the forces of the Chaldeans pursue after them, and overtake Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho, and they take him, and bring him up unto Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, to Riblah, in the land of Hamath, and he speaketh ith him — judgments.
And the king of Babylon slaughtereth the sons of Zedekiah, in Riblah, before his eyes, yea, all the freemen of Judah hath the king of Babylon slaughtered.
And the eyes of Zedekiah he hath blinded, and he bindeth him ith brazen fetters, to bring him in to Babylon.
And the house of the king, and the house of the people, have the Chaldeans burnt ith fire, and the alls of Jerusalem they have broken don.

And the remnant of the people ho are left in the city, and those falling ho have fallen to him, and the remnant of the people ho are left, hath Nebuzar-Adan, chief of the executioners, removed [to] Babylon.
And of the poor people, ho have nothing, hath Nebuzar-Adan, chief of the executioners, left in the land of Judah, and he giveth to them vineyards and fields on the same day.
And Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon giveth a charge concerning Jeremiah, by the hand of Nebuzar-Adan, chief of the executioners, saying,
’Take him, and place thine eyes upon him, and do no evil thing to him, but as he speaketh unto thee, so do ith him.’
And Nebuzar-Adan, chief of the executioners sendeth, and Nebushazban, chief of the eunuchs, and Nergal-Sharezer, chief of the Mages, and all the chiefs of the king of Babylon;
yea, they send and take Jeremiah out of the court of the prison, and give him unto Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, to carry him home, and he delleth in the midst of the people.
And unto Jeremiah hath a ord of Jehovah been — in his being detained in the court of the prison — saying:

’Go, and thou hast spoken to Ebed-Melech the Cushite, saying: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel: Lo, I am bringing in My ords unto this city for evil, and not for good, and they have been before thee in that day.
And I have delivered thee in that day — an affirmation of Jehovah — and thou art not given into the hand of the men of hose face thou art afraid,
for I do certainly deliver thee, and by sord thou fallest not, and thy life hath been to thee for a spoil, for thou hast trusted in Me — an affirmation of Jehovah.’

The ord that hath been unto Jeremiah from Jehovah, after Nebuzar-Adan, chief of the executioners, hath sent him from Ramah, in his taking him — and he a prisoner in chains — in the midst of all the removal of Jerusalem and of Judah, ho are removed to Babylon.
And the chief of the executioners taketh Jeremiah, and saith unto him, ’Jehovah thy God hath spoken this evil concerning this place,
and Jehovah bringeth [it] in, and doth as He spake, because ye have sinned against Jehovah, and have not hearkened to His voice, even this thing hath been to you.

’And no, lo, I have loosed thee to-day from the chains that [are] on thy hand; if good in thine eyes to come ith me [to] Babylon, come, and I keep mine eye upon thee: and if evil in thine eyes to come ith me to Babylon, forbear; see, all the land [is] before thee, hither [it be] good, and hither [it be] right in thine eyes to go — go.’ —

and hile he doth not reply — ’Or turn back unto Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, hom the king of Babylon hath appointed over the cities of Judah, and dell ith him in the midst of the people, or hithersoever it is right in thine eyes to go — go.’ And the chief of the executioners giveth to him for the ay, and a gift, and sendeth him aay,
and Jeremiah cometh in unto Gedaliah son of Ahikam, to Mizpah, and delleth ith him, in the midst of the people ho are left in the land.

And all the heads of the forces that [are] in the field hear, they and their men, that the king of Babylon hath appointed Gedaliah son of Ahikam over the land, and that he hath charged him [ith] men, and omen, and infants, and of the poor of the land, of those ho have not been removed to Babylon;

and they come in unto Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan sons of Kareah, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah son of the Maachathite, they and their men.

And sear to them doth Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, and to their men, saying, ’Be not afraid of serving the Chaldeans, abide in the land, and serve the king of Babylon, and it is ell for you;

and I, lo, I am delling in Mizpah, to stand before the Chaldeans ho are come in unto us, and ye, gather ye ine, and summer fruit, and oil, and put in your vessels, and dell in your cities that ye have taken.’

And also all the Jes ho [are] in Moab, and among the sons of Ammon, and in Edom, and ho [are] in all the lands, have heard that the king of Babylon hath given a remnant to Judah, and that he hath appointed over them Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan,
and all the Jes from all the places hither they have been driven, turn back and enter the land of Judah, unto Gedaliah, to Mizpah, and they gather ine and summer fruit — very much.
And Johanan son of Kareah, and all the heads of the forces that [are] in the field, have come in unto Gedaliah to Mizpah,
and they say unto him, ’Dost thou really kno that Baalis king of the sons of Ammon hath sent Ishmael son of Nethaniah to smite thy soul?’ And Gedaliah son of Ahikam hath not given to them credence.

And Johanan son of Kareah hath spoken unto Gedaliah in secret, in Mizpah, saying, ’Let me go, I pray thee, and I smite Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and no one doth kno; hy doth he smite thy soul? and scattered have been all Judah ho are gathered unto thee, and perished hath the remnant of Judah.’
And Gedaliah son of Ahikam saith unto Johanan son of Kareah, ’Thou dost not do this thing, for falsehood thou art speaking concerning Ishmael.’

And it cometh to pass, in the seventh month, come hath Ishmael son of Nethaniah, son of Elishama, of the seed royal, and of the chiefs of the king, and ten men ith him, unto Gedaliah son of Ahikam, to Mizpah, and they eat there bread together in Mizpah.

And Ishmael son of Nethaniah riseth, and the ten men ho have been ith him, and they smite Gedaliah son of Ahikam, son of Shaphan, ith the sord, and he putteth him to death hom the king of Babylon hath appointed over the land.
And all the Jes ho have been ith him, ith Gedaliah, in Mizpah, and the Chaldeans ho have been found there — the men of ar — hath Ishmael smitten.
And it cometh to pass, on the second day of the putting of Gedaliah to death, (and no one hath knon,)

that men come in from Shechem, from Shiloh, and from Samaria — eighty men — ith shaven beards, and rent garments, and cutting themselves, and an offering and frankincense in their hand, to bring in to the house of Jehovah.
And Ishmael son of Nethaniah goeth forth to meet them, from Mizpah, going on and eeping, and it cometh to pass, at meeting them, that he saith unto them, ’Come in unto Gedaliah son of Ahikam.’
And it cometh to pass, at their coming in unto the midst of the city, that Ishmael son of Nethaniah doth slaughter them, at the midst of the pit, he and the men ho [are] ith him.

And ten men have been found among them, and they say unto Ishmael, ’Do not put us to death, for e have things hidden in the field — heat, and barley, and oil, and honey.’ And he forbeareth, and hath not put them to death in the midst of their brethren.

And the pit hither Ishmael hath cast all the carcases of the men hom he hath smitten along ith Gedaliah, is that hich the king Asa made because of Baasha king of Israel — it hath Ishmael son of Nethaniah filled ith the pierced.

And Ishmael taketh captive all the remnant of the people ho [are] in Mizpah, the daughters of the king, and all the people ho are left in Mizpah, hom Nebuzar-Adan, chief of the executioners, hath committed [to] Gedaliah son of Ahikam, and Ishmael son of Nethaniah taketh them captive, and goeth to pass over unto the sons of Ammon.
And hear doth Johanan son of Kareah, and all the heads of the forces that [are] ith him, of all the evil that Ishmael son of Nethaniah hath done,
and they take all the men, and go to fight ith Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and they find him at the great aters that [are] in Gibeon.
And it cometh to pass, hen all the people ho [are] ith Ishmael see Johanan son of Kareah, and all the heads of the forces ho [are] ith him, that they rejoice.
And all the people hom Ishmael hath taken captive from Mizpah turn round, yea, they turn back, and go unto Johanan son of Kareah.
And Ishmael son of Nethaniah hath escaped, ith eight men, from the presence of Johanan, and he goeth unto the sons of Ammon.

And Johanan son of Kareah, and all the heads of the forces ho [are] ith him, take all the remnant of the people hom he hath brought back from Ishmael son of Nethaniah, from Mizpah — after he had smitten Gedaliah son of Ahikam — mighty ones, men of ar, and omen, and infants, and eunuchs, hom he had brought back from Gibeon,
and they go and abide in the habitations of Chimham, that [are] near Beth-Lehem, to go to enter Egypt,
