And a spirit hath lifted me up, and doth take me aay, and I go bitterly, in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of Jehovah on me [is] strong.
And I come in unto the Removed, at Tel-Ahib, ho are delling at the river Chebar, and here they are delling I also dell seven days, causing astonishment in their midst.
And it cometh to pass, at the end of seven days,
that there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying, ’Son of man, a atchman I have given thee to the house of Israel, and thou hast heard from My mouth a ord, and hast arned them from Me.

In My saying to the icked: Thou dost surely die; and thou hast not arned him, nor hast spoken to arn the icked from his icked ay, so that he doth live; he — the icked — in his iniquity dieth, and his blood from thy hand I require.
And thou, because thou hast arned the icked, and he hath not turned back from his ickedness, and from his icked ay, he in his iniquity dieth, and thou thy soul hast delivered.

’And in the turning back of the righteous from his righteousness, and he hath done perversity, and I have put a stumbling-block before him, he dieth; because thou hast not arned him, in his sin he dieth, and not remembered is his righteousness that he hath done, and his blood from thy hand I require.
And thou, because thou hast arned him — the righteous — that the righteous sin not, and he hath not sinned, he surely liveth, because he hath been arned; and thou thy soul hast delivered.’
And there is on me there a hand of Jehovah, and He saith to me, ’Rise, go forth to the valley, and there I do speak ith thee.’
And I rise and go forth unto the valley, and lo, there the honour of Jehovah is standing as the honour that I had seen by the river Chebar, and I fall on my face.
And come into me doth a spirit, and causeth me to stand on my feet, and He speaketh ith me, and saith unto me, ’Go in, be shut up in the midst of thy house.
’And thou, son of man, lo, they have put on thee thick bands, and have bound thee ith them, and thou goest not forth in their midst;
and thy tongue I cause to cleave unto thy palate, and thou hast been dumb, and art not to them for a reprover, for a rebellious house [are] they.
And in My speaking ith thee, I do open thy mouth, and thou hast said unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah; the hearer doth hear, and the forbearer doth forbear; for a rebellious house [are] they.
’And thou, son of man, take to thee a brick, and thou hast put it before thee, and hast graven on it a city — Jerusalem,
and hast placed against it a siege, and builded against it a fortification, and poured out against it a mount, and placed against it camps, yea, set thou against it battering-rams round about.

And thou, take to thee an iron pan, and thou hast made it a all of iron beteen thee and the city; and thou hast prepared thy face against it, and it hath been in a siege, yea, thou hast laid siege against it. A sign it [is] to the house of Israel.
’And thou, lie on thy left side, and thou hast placed the iniquity of the house of Israel on it; the number of the days that thou liest on it, thou bearest their iniquity.
And I — I have laid on thee the years of their iniquity, the number of days, three hundred and ninety days; and thou hast borne the iniquity of the house of Israel.

And thou hast completed these, and hast lain on thy right side, a second time, and hast borne the iniquity of the house of Judah forty days — a day for a year — a day for a year I have appointed to thee.
’And unto the siege of Jerusalem thou dost prepare thy face, and thine arm [is] uncovered, and thou hast prophesied concerning it.
And lo, I have put on thee thick bands, and thou dost not turn from side to side till thy completing the days of thy siege.

’And thou, take to thee heat, and barley, and beans, and lentiles, and millet, and spelt, and thou hast put them in one vessel, and made them to thee for bread; the number of the days that thou art lying on thy side — three hundred and ninety days — thou dost eat it.
And thy food that thou dost eat [is] by eight, tenty shekels daily; from time to time thou dost eat it.
’And ater by measure thou dost drink, a sixth part of the hin; from time to time thou dost drink [it].
A barley-cake thou dost eat it, and it ith dung — the filth of man — thou dost bake before their eyes.
And Jehovah saith, ’Thus do the sons of Israel eat their defiled bread among the nations hither I drive them.’
And I say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah, lo, my soul is not defiled, and carcase, and torn thing, I have not eaten from my youth, even till no; nor come into my mouth hath abominable flesh.’
And He saith unto me, ’See, I have given to thee bullock’s dung instead of man’s dung, and thou hast made thy bread by it.’
And He saith unto me, ’Son of man, lo, I am breaking the staff of bread in Jerusalem, and they have eaten bread by eight and ith fear; and ater by measure and ith astonishment, they do drink;
so that they lack bread and ater, and have been astonished one ith another, and been consumed in their iniquity.

’And thou, son of man, take to thee a sharp eapon, the barber’s razor thou dost take to thee, and thou hast caused [it] to pass over thy head, and over thy beard, and thou hast taken to thee eighing scales, and apportioned them.

A third part ith fire thou dost burn in the midst of the city, at the fulness of the days of the siege; and thou hast taken the third part, thou dost smite ith a eapon round about it; and the third part thou dost scatter to the ind, and a eapon I dra out after them.
And thou hast taken thence a fe in number — and hast bound them in thy skirts;
and of them thou dost take again, and hast cast them unto the midst of the fire, and hast burned them in the fire — out of it cometh forth a fire unto all the house of Israel.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: this [is] Jerusalem, In the midst of the nations I have set her, And round about her [are] the lands.

And she changeth My judgments into ickedness more than the nations, And My statutes more than the lands that [are] round about her, For against My judgments they have kicked, And My statutes — they have not alked in them.

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of your multiplying above the nations that [are] around you, In My statutes ye have not alked, And My judgments ye have not done, According to the judgments of the nations That [are] round about you ye have not done.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, even I, And I have done in thy midst judgments, Before the eyes of the nations.
And I have done in thee that hich I have not done, And that hich I do not its like again, Because of all thine abominations.
Therefore fathers do eat sons in thy midst, And sons eat their fathers, And I have done in thee judgments, And have scattered all thy remnant to every ind.

Therefore, I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah: Because My sanctuary thou hast defiled, With all thy detestable things, And ith all thine abominations, Mine eye pitieth not, and I also spare not. Do not even I also diminish?

Thy third part — by pestilence they die, And by famine are consumed in thy midst, And the third part, by sord they fall round about thee, And the third part, to every ind I scatter, And a sord I dra out after them.
And completed hath been Mine anger, And I have caused My fury to rest on them, And I have been comforted, And they have knon that I, Jehovah, have spoken in My zeal, In My completing My fury on them.
And I give thee for a aste, And for a reproach among nations that [are] round about thee, Before the eyes of every passer by.

And it hath been a reproach and a reviling, An instruction and an astonishment, To nations that [are] round about thee, In My doing in thee judgments, In anger and fury, and in furious reproofs, I, Jehovah, have spoken.
In My sending the evil arros of famine among them, That have been for destruction, That I send to destroy you, And famine I am adding upon you, And I have broken to you the staff of bread.
And I have sent on you famine and evil beasts, And they have bereaved thee, And pestilence and blood pass over on thee, And a sord I do bring in against thee, I, Jehovah, have spoken!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, set thy face unto mountains of Israel, and prophesy concerning them:

And thou hast said: Mountains of Israel, Hear ye a ord of the Lord Jehovah: Thus said the Lord Jehovah To the mountains, and to the hills, To the streams, and to the valleys, Lo, I, I am bringing in against you a sord, And I have destroyed your high places.
And desolated have been your altars, And broken your images, And I have caused your ounded to fall before your idols,
And put the carcases of the sons of Israel before their idols, And scattered your bones round about your altars.

In all your dellings the cities are laid aste, And the high places are desolate, So that aste and desolate are your altars, And broken and ceased have your idols, And cut don have been your images, And blotted out have been your orks.
And fallen hath the ounded in your midst, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
And I have caused [some] to remain, In their being to you the escaped of the sord among nations, In your being scattered through lands.

And remembered Me have your escaped among nations, Whither they have been taken captive, Because I have been broken ith their heart that is going a-horing, That hath turned aside from off Me, And ith their eyes they are going a-horing after their idols, And they have been loathsome in their on faces, For the evils that they have done — all their abominations.
And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, Not for nought have I spoken to do to them this evil.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: ’Smite ith thy palm, and stamp ith thy foot, And say: Alas, for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel, Who by sord, by famine, and by pestilence do fall.
The far-off by pestilence dieth, And the near by sord falleth, And the left and the besieged by famine dieth, And I have completed my fury upon them.

And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In their ounded being in the midst of their idols, Round about their altars, On every high hill, on all tops of mountains, And under every green tree, and under every thick oak, The place here they gave seet fragrance to all their idols.
And I have stretched out my hand against them, And have made the land a desolation, Even a desolation from the ilderness to Diblath, In all their dellings, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying, ’And thou, son of man, Thus said the Lord Jehovah to the ground of Israel:
An end, come hath the end on the four corners of the land.
No [is] the end unto thee, And I have sent Mine anger upon thee, And judged thee according to thy ays, And set against thee all thine abominations.
And no pity on thee hath Mine eye, nor do I spare, For thy ays against thee I do set, And thine abominations are in thy midst, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Evil, a single evil, lo, it hath come.
An end hath come, come hath the end, It hath aked for thee, lo, it hath come.
Come hath the morning unto thee, O inhabitant of the land! Come hath the time, near [is] a day of trouble, And not the shouting of mountains.
No, shortly I pour out My fury on thee, And have completed Mine anger against thee, And judged thee according to thy ays, And set against thee all thine abominations.
And not pity doth Mine eye, nor do I spare, According to thy ays unto thee I give, And thine abominations are in thy midst, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah the smiter.
Lo, the day, lo, it hath come, Gone forth hath the morning, Blossomed hath the rod, flourished the pride.
The violence hath risen to a rod of ickedness, There is none of them, nor of their multitude, Nor of their noise, nor is there ailing for them.
Come hath the time, arrived hath the day, The buyer doth not rejoice, And the seller doth not become a mourner, For rath [is] unto all its multitude.

For the seller to the sold thing turneth not, And yet among the living [is] their life, For the vision [is] unto all its multitude, It doth not turn back, And none by his iniquity doth strengthen his life.
They have blon ith a trumpet to prepare the hole, And none is going to battle, For My rath [is] unto all its multitude.
The sord [is] ithout, And the pestilence and the famine ithin, He ho is in a field by sord dieth, And he ho is in a city, Famine and pestilence devour him.
And escaped aay have their fugitives, And they have been on the mountains As doves of the valleys, All of them make a noising — each for his iniquity.
All the hands are feeble, and all knees go — aters.
And they have girded on sackcloth, And covered them hath trembling, And unto all faces [is] shame, And on all their heads — baldness.

Their silver into out-places they cast, And their gold impurity becometh. Their silver and their gold is not able to deliver them, In a day of the rath of Jehovah, Their soul they do not satisfy, And their boels they do not fill, For the stumbling-block of their iniquity it hath been.
As to the beauty of his ornament, For excellency He set it, And the images of their abominations, Their detestable things — they made in it, Therefore I have given it to them for impurity,
And I have given it into the hand of the strangers for a prey, And to the icked of the land for a spoil, And they have polluted it.
And I have turned My face from them, And they have polluted My hidden place, Yea, come into it have destroyers, and polluted it.
Make the chain; for the land Hath been full of bloody judgments, And the city hath been full of violence.
And I have brought in the icked of the nations, And they have possessed their houses, And I have caused to cease the excellency of the strong, And polluted have been those sanctifying them.
Destruction hath come, And they have sought peace, and there is none.
Mischief on mischief cometh, and report is on report, And they have sought a vision from a prophet, And la doth perish from the priest, And counsel from the elders,

The king doth become a mourner, And a prince putteth on desolation, And the hands of the people of the land are troubled, From their on ay I deal ith them, And ith their on judgments I judge them, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!’

And it cometh to pass, in the sixth year, in the sixth [month], in the fifth of the month, I am sitting in my house, and elders of Judah are sitting before me, and fall on me there doth a hand of the Lord Jehovah,
and I look, and lo, a likeness as the appearance of fire, from the appearance of His loins and donard — fire, and from His loins and upard, as the appearance of brightness, as the colour of copper.

And He putteth forth a form of a hand, and taketh me by a lock of my head, and lift me up doth a spirit beteen the earth and the heavens, and it bringeth me in to Jerusalem in visions of God, unto the opening of the inner gate that is facing the north, here [is] the seat of the figure of jealousy that is making jealous,
and lo, there the honour of the God of Israel, as the appearance that I sa in the valley.

And He saith unto me, ’Son of man, lift up, I pray thee, thine eyes the ay of the north.’ And I lift up mine eyes the ay of the north, and lo, on the north of the gate of the altar this figure of jealousy, at the entrance.

And He saith unto me, ’Son of man, art thou seeing hat they are doing? the great abominations that the house of Israel are doing here, to keep far off from My sanctuary; and again thou dost turn, thou dost see great abominations.’
And He bringeth me in unto an opening of the court, and I look, and lo, a hole in the all;
and He saith unto me, ’Son of man, dig, I pray thee, through the all;’ and I dig through the all, and lo, an opening.
And He saith to me, ’Go in, and see the evil abominations that they are doing here.’
And I go in, and look, and lo, every form of creeping thing, and detestable beast — and all the Idols of the house of Israel — graved on the all, all round about,

and seventy men of the elders of the house of Israel — and Jaazaniah son of Shaphan standing in their midst — are standing before them, and each his censer in his hand, and the abundance of the cloud of perfume is going up.

And He saith unto me, ’Hast thou seen, son of man, that hich elders of the house of Israel are doing in darkness, each in the inner chambers of his imagery, for they are saying, Jehovah is not seeing us, Jehovah hath forsaken the land?’
And He saith unto me, ’Again thou dost turn, thou dost see great abominations that they are doing.’
And He bringeth me in unto the opening of the gate of the house of Jehovah that [is] at the north, and lo, there the omen are sitting eeping for Tammuz.
And He saith unto me, ’Hast thou seen, son of man? again thou dost turn, thou dost see greater abominations than these.’

And He bringeth me in unto the inner court of the house of Jehovah, and lo, at the opening of the temple of Jehovah, beteen the porch and the altar, about tenty-five men, their backs toard the temple of Jehovah, and their faces eastard, and they are boing themselves eastard to the sun.

And He saith unto me, ’Hast thou seen, son of man? hath it been a light thing to the house of Judah to do the abomination that they have done here, that they have filled the land ith violence, and turn back to provoke Me to anger? and lo, they are putting forth the branch unto their nose!
And I also deal in fury, Mine eye doth not pity, nor do I spare, and they have cried in Mine ears — a loud voice — and I do not hear them.’
And He crieth in mine ears — a loud voice — saying, ’Dran near have inspectors of the city, and each his destroying eapon in his hand.’

And lo, six men are coming from the ay of the upper gate, that is facing the north, and each his slaughter-eapon in his hand, and one man in their midst is clothed ith linen, and a scribe’s inkhorn at his loins, and they come in, and stand near the brazen altar.
And the honour of the God of Israel hath gone up from off the cherub, on hich it hath been, unto the threshold of the house.

And He calleth unto the man ho is clothed ith linen, ho hath the scribe’s inkhorn at his loins, and Jehovah saith unto him, ’Pass on into the midst of the city, into the midst of Jerusalem, and thou hast made a mark on the foreheads of the men ho are sighing and ho are groaning for all the abominations that are done in its midst.’
And to the others he said in mine ears, ’Pass on into the city after him, and smite; your eye doth not pity, nor do ye spare;
aged, young man, and virgin, and infant, and omen, ye do slay — to destruction; and against any man on hom [is] the mark ye do not go nigh, and from My sanctuary ye begin.’

And they begin among the aged men ho [are] before the house, and He saith unto them, ’Defile the house, and fill the courts ith the ounded, go forth.’ And they have gone forth and have smitten in the city.

And it cometh to pass, as they are smiting, and I — I am left — that I fall on my face, and cry, and say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah, art Thou destroying all the remnant of Israel, in Thy pouring out Thy rath on Jerusalem?’

And He saith unto me, ’The iniquity of the house of Israel and Judah [is] very very great, and the land is full of blood, and the city hath been full of perverseness, for they have said: Jehovah hath forsaken the land, and Jehovah is not seeing.
And I also, Mine eye doth not pity, nor do I spare; their ay on their on head I have put.’
And lo, the man clothed ith linen, at hose loins [is] the inkhorn, is bringing back ord, saying, ’I have done as Thou hast commanded me.’
And I look, and lo, on the expanse that [is] above the head of the cherubs, as a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne, He hath been seen over them.

And He speaketh unto the man clothed ith linen, and saith, ’Go in unto the midst of the heel, unto the place of the cherub, and fill thy hands ith coals of fire from beteen the cherubs, and scatter over the city.’ And he goeth in before mine eyes.
And the cherubs are standing on the right side of the house, at the going in of the man, and the cloud hath filled the inner court,

and become high doth the honour of Jehovah above the cherub, over the threshold of the house, and the house is filled ith the cloud, and the court hath been filled ith the brightness of the honour of Jehovah.
And a noise of the ings of the cherubs hath been heard unto the outer court, as the voice of God — the Mighty One — in His speaking.
And it cometh to pass, in His commanding the man clothed ith linen, saying, ’Take fire from beteen the heel, from beteen the cherubs,’ and he goeth in and standeth near the heel,

that the [one] cherub putteth forth his hand from beteen the cherubs unto the fire that [is] beteen the cherubs, and lifteth up, and giveth into the hands of him ho is clothed ith linen, and he receiveth, and cometh forth.
And there appeareth in the cherubs the form of a hand of man under their ings,
and I look, and lo, four heels near the cherubs, one heel near the one cherub, and another heel near the other cherub, and the appearance of the heels [is] as the colour of a beryl stone.
As to their appearances, one likeness [is] to them four, as it ere the heel in the midst of the heel.
In their going, on their four sides they go; they turn not round in their going, for to the place hither the head turneth, after it they go, they turn not round in their going.
And all their flesh, and their backs, and their hands, and their ings, and the heels, are full of eyes round about; to them four [are] their heels.
To the heels — to them is one calling in mine ears, ’O heel!’
And four faces [are] to each; the face of the one [is] the face of the cherub, and the face of the second the face of man, and of the third the face of a lion, and of the fourth the face of an eagle.
And the cherubs are lifted up, it [is] the living creature that I sa by the river Chebar.
And in the going of the cherubs, the heels go beside them; and in the cherubs lifting up their ings to be high above the earth, the heels turn not round, even they, from being beside them.
In their standing they stand, and in their exaltation they are exalted ith them: for the living spirit [is] in them.
And go forth doth the honour of Jehovah from off the threshold of the house, and standeth over the cherubs,

and the cherubs lift up their ings, and are lifted up from the earth before mine eyes; in their going forth, the heels also [are] over-against them, and he standeth at the opening of the east gate of the house of Jehovah, and the honour of the God of Israel [is] over them from above.
It [is] the living creature that I sa under the God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I kno that they are cherubs.
Four faces [are] to each, and four ings to each, and the likeness of the hands of man [is] under their ings.
As to the likeness of their faces, they [are] the faces that I sa by the river Chebar, their appearances and themselves; each straight forard they go.

And lift me up doth a spirit, and it bringeth me in unto the east gate of the house of Jehovah, that is facing the east, and lo, at the opening of the gate tenty and five men, and I see in their midst Jaazaniah son of Azzur, and Pelatiah son of Benaiah, heads of the people.
And He saith unto me, ’Son of man, these [are] the men ho are devising iniquity, and ho are giving evil counsel in this city;
ho are saying, It [is] not near — to build houses, it [is] the pot, and e the flesh.
Therefore prophesy concerning them, prophesy, son of man.’
And fall upon me doth the Spirit of Jehovah, and He saith unto me, ’Say: Thus said Jehovah: Rightly ye have said, O house of Israel, And the steps of your spirit I have knon.
Ye multiplied your ounded in this city, And filled its out-places ith the ounded.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Your ounded hom ye placed in its midst, They [are] the flesh, and it [is] the pot, And you he hath brought out from its midst.
A sord ye have feared, And a sord I bring in against you, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And I have brought you out of its midst, And given you into the hand of strangers, And I have done among you judgments.
By the sord ye do fall, On the border of Israel I do judge you, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
It is not to you for a pot, Nor are ye in its midst for flesh, At the border of Israel I do judge you.
And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah, For in My statutes ye have not alked, And My Judgments ye have not done, And according to the judgments of the nations Who are round about you — ye have done!’

And it cometh to pass, at my prophesying, that Pelatiah son of Benaiah is dying, and I fall on my face, and cry — a loud voice — and say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah, an end Thou art making of the remnant of Israel.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, thy brethren, thy brethren, men of thy kindred, and all the house of Israel — all of it, [are] they to hom inhabitants of Jerusalem have said, Keep far off from Jehovah;

it [is] ours, the land hath been given for an inheritance; therefore say: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because I put them afar off among nations, And because I scattered them through lands, I also am to them for a little sanctuary, In lands hither they have gone in.

Therefore say: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: And I have assembled you from the peoples, And I have gathered you from the lands, Into hich ye have been scattered, And I have given to you the ground of Israel.
And they have gone in thither. And turned aside all its detestable things, And all its abominations — out of it.
And I have given to them one heart, And a ne spirit I do give in your midst, And I have turned the heart of stone out of their flesh, And I have given to them a heart of flesh.
So that in My statutes they alk, And My judgments they keep, and have done them, And they have been to me for a people, And I am to them for God.
As to those hose heart is going unto the heart Of their detestable and their abominable things, Their ay on their head I have put, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And the cherubs lift up their ings, and the heels [are] over-against them, and the honour of the God of Israel [is] over them above.
And the honour of Jehovah goeth up from off the midst of the city, and standeth on the mountain, that [is] on the east of the city.
And a spirit hath lifted me up, and bringeth me in to Chaldea, unto the Removed, in a vision, by the Spirit of God, and go up from off me doth the vision that I have seen;
and I speak unto the Removed all the matters of Jehovah that He hath sheed me.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, in the midst of the rebellious house thou art delling, that have eyes to see, and they have not seen; ears they have to hear, and they have not heard; for a rebellious house [are] they.

And thou, son of man, make to thee vessels of removal, and remove by day before their eyes, and thou hast removed from thy place unto another place before their eyes, it may be they consider, for a rebellious house they [are].
And thou hast brought forth thy vessels as vessels of removal by day before their eyes, and thou, thou dost go forth at even before their eyes, as the goings forth of a removal.
Before their eyes dig for thee through the all, and thou hast brought forth by it.

Before their eyes on the shoulder thou dost bear, in the darkness thou dost bring forth, thy face thou dost cover, and thou dost not see the earth, for a type I have given thee to the house of Israel.’

And I do so, as I have been commanded; my vessels I have brought forth as vessels of removal by day, and at even I have dug for me through the all ith the hand; in the darkness I have brought forth, on the shoulder I have borne aay, before their eyes.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, in the morning, saying,
’Son of man, have they not said unto thee — the house of Israel — the rebellious house — What art thou doing?
say unto them, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: ’The prince [is] this burden in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel ho are in their midst.
Say: I [am] your type; as I have done so it is done to them, into a removal, into a captivity, they do go.

As to the prince ho [is] in their midst, on the shoulder he beareth in the darkness, and he goeth forth, through the all they dig to bring forth by it, his face he covereth, that he may not look on the very surface of the land.
And I have spread My net for him, and he hath been caught in My snare, and I have brought him in to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, and it he doth not see — and there doth he die.
’And all ho are round about him to help him, and all his bands, I do scatter to every ind, and a sord I dra out after them.
And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, in My scattering them among nations, and I have spread them through lands;

and I have left of them, a fe in number, from the sord, from the famine, and from the pestilence, so that they recount all their abominations among the nations hither they have come, and they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, thy bread in haste thou dost eat, and thy ater ith trembling and ith fear thou dost drink;

and thou hast said unto the people of the land, Thus said the Lord Jehovah concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem, concerning the land of Israel: Their bread ith fear they do eat, and their ater ith astonishment drink, because its land is desolate, because of its fulness, because of the violence of all ho are delling in it.
And the cities that are inhabited are laid aste, and the land is a desolation, and ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, hat [is] this simile to you, concerning the land of Israel, saying, Prolonged are the days, and perished hath every vision?

therefore say unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: I have caused this simile to cease, And they use it not as a simile again in Israel, But speak to them: Dran near have the days, And spoken hath every vision.
For there is no more any vain vision, and flattering divination, In the midst of the house of Israel.

For I [am] Jehovah, I speak, The ord that I speak — it is done, It is not prolonged any more, For, in your days, O rebellious house, I speak a ord, and I have done it, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, lo, the house of Israel are saying, The vision that he is seeing [is] for many days, and of times far off he is prophesying,
therefore say unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: None of my ords are prolonged any more, When I speak a ord — it is done, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, prophesy concerning the prophets of Israel ho are prophesying, and thou hast said to those prophesying from their on heart: Hear ye a ord of Jehovah:
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Woe unto the prophets ho are foolish, Who are going after their on spirit, And they have seen nothing.
As foxes in the astes, Thy prophets, O Israel, have been.
Ye have not gone up into breaches, Nor do ye make a fence for the house of Israel, To stand in battle in a day of Jehovah.
They have seen vanity, and lying divination, Who are saying: An affirmation of Jehovah, And Jehovah hath not sent them, And they have hoped to establish a ord.
A vain vision have ye not seen, And a lying divination spoken, When ye say: An affirmation of Jehovah, And I have not spoken?
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen a lie, Therefore, lo, I [am] against you, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.

And My hand hath been on the prophets, Who are seeing vanity, and ho are divining a lie, In the assembly of My people they are not, And in the riting of the house of Israel they are not ritten, And unto the ground of Israel they come not, And ye have knon that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.
Because, even because, they did cause My people to err, Saying, Peace! and there is no peace, And that one is building a all, And lo, they are daubing it ith chalk.
Say to those daubing ith chalk — It falleth, There hath been an overfloing shoer, And ye, O hailstones, do fall, And a tempestuous ind doth rend,
And lo, fallen hath the all! Doth not one say unto you, Where [is] the daubing that ye daubed?
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: I have rent ith a tempestuous ind in My fury, And an overfloing shoer is in Mine anger, And hailstones in My fury — to consume.

And I have broken don the all that ye daubed ith chalk, And have caused it to come unto the earth, And revealed hath been its foundation, And it hath fallen, And ye have been consumed in its midst, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
And I have completed My rath on the all, And on those daubing it ith chalk, And I say to you: The all is not, And those daubing it are not;
The prophets of Israel ho are prophesying concerning Jerusalem, And ho are seeing for her a vision of peace, And there is no peace, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And thou, son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, ho are prophesying out of their on heart, and prophesy concerning them,

And thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Woe to those soing pillos for all joints of the arm, And to those making the kerchiefs For the head of every stature — to hunt souls, The souls do ye hunt of My people? And the souls ye have do ye keep alive?

Yea, ye pierce Me concerning My people, For handfuls of barley, And for pieces of bread, to put to death Souls that should not die, And to keep alive souls that should not live, By your lying to My people — hearkening to lies.

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against your pillos, With hich ye are hunting there the souls of the flourishing, And I have rent them from off your arms, And have sent aay the souls that ye are hunting, The souls of the flourishing.
And I have torn your kerchiefs, And delivered My people out of your hand, And they are no more in your hand for a prey, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
Because of paining the heart of the righteous ith falsehood, And I have not pained it, And strengthening the hands of the icked, So as not to turn back from his evil ay, To keep him alive,
Therefore, vanity ye do not see, And divination ye do not divine again, And I have delivered My people out of your hand, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah!’
And come in unto me do certain of the elders of Israel, and sit before me.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, these men have caused their idols to go up on their heart, and the stumbling-block of their iniquity they have put over-against their faces; am I inquired of at all by them?

’Therefore, speak ith them, and thou hast said unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Every one of the house of Israel ho causeth his idols to go up unto his heart, and the stumbling-block of his iniquity setteth over-against his face, and hath gone in unto the prophet — I Jehovah have given an anser to him for this, for the abundance of his idols,
in order to catch the house of Israel by their heart, in that they have become estranged from off me by their idols — all of them.
’Therefore say unto the house of Israel: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Turn ye back, yea, turn ye back from your idols, and from all your abominations turn back your faces,

for every one of the house of Israel, and of the sojourners ho doth sojourn in Israel, ho is separated from after Me, and doth cause his idols to go up unto his heart, and the stumbling-block of his iniquity setteth over-against his face, and hath come in unto the prophet to inquire of him concerning Me, I, Jehovah, have ansered him for Myself;
and I have set My face against that man, and made him for a sign, and for similes, and I have cut him off from the midst of My people, and ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.

’And the prophet, hen he is enticed, and hath spoken a ord — I, Jehovah, I have enticed that prophet, and have stretched out My hand against him, and have destroyed him from the midst of My people Israel.
And they have borne their iniquity: as the iniquity of the inquirer, so is the iniquity of the prophet;

so that the house of Israel do not ander any more from after Me, nor are defiled any more ith all their transgressions, and they have been to Me for a people, and I am to them for God — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’Son of man, the land — hen it sinneth against Me to commit a trespass, and I have stretched out My hand against it, and broken for it the staff of bread, and sent into it famine, and cut off from it man and beast —
and these three men have been in its midst, Noah, Daniel, and Job — they by their righteousness deliver their on soul — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
’If an evil beast I cause to pass through the land, and it hath bereaved, and it hath been a desolation, ithout any passing through because of the beast —
these three men in its midst: I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah — neither sons nor daughters do they deliver; they alone are delivered, and the land is a desolation.
’Or — a sord I bring in against that land, and I have said: Sord, thou dost pass over through the land, and I have cut off from it man and beast —
and these three men in its midst: I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah — they deliver not sons and daughters, for they alone are delivered.
’Or — pestilence I send unto that land, and I have poured out My fury against it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast —
and Noah, Daniel, and Job, in its midst: I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah — neither son nor daughter do they deliver; they, by their righteousness, deliver their on soul.
’For thus said the Lord Jehovah: Although My four sore judgments — sord, and famine, and ild beast, and pestilence — I have sent unto Jerusalem, to cut off from it man and beast,

yet, lo, there hath been left in it an escape, ho are brought forth, sons and daughters, lo, they are coming forth unto you, and ye have seen their ay, and their doings, and have been comforted concerning the evil that I have brought in against Jerusalem, all that hich I have brought in against it.
And they have comforted you, for ye see their ay and their doings, and ye have knon that not for nought have I done all that hich I have done in her — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, What is the vine-tree more than any tree? The vine-branch that hath been, Among trees of the forest?
Is ood taken from it to use for ork? Do they take of it a pin to hang any vessel on it?
Lo, to the fire it hath been given for fuel, Its to ends hath the fire eaten, And its midst hath been scorched! Is it profitable for ork?
Lo, in its being perfect it is not used for ork, Ho much less, hen fire hath eaten of it, And it is scorched, Hath it been used yet for ork?
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: As the vine-tree among trees of the forest, That I have given to the fire for fuel, So I have given the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
And I have set My face against them, From the fire they have gone forth, And the fire doth consume them, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My setting My face against them.
And I have made the land a desolation, Because they have committed a trespass, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, cause Jerusalem to kno her abominations, and thou hast said:
Thus said the Lord Jehovah to Jerusalem: Thy birth and thy nativity [Are] of the land of the Canaanite, Thy father the Amorite, and thy mother a Hittite.
As to thy nativity, in the day thou ast born, Thou — thy navel hath not been cut, And in ater thou ast not ashed for ease, And thou hast not been salted at all, And thou hast not been saddled at all.
No eye hath had pity on thee, to do to thee any of these, To have compassion on thee, And thou art cast on the face of the field, With loathing of thy person. In the day thou hast been born — thou!
And I do pass over by thee, And I see thee trodden don in thy blood, And I say to thee in thy blood, Live, And I say to thee in thy blood, Live.

A myriad — as the shoot of the field I have made thee, And thou art multiplied, and art great, And comest in ith an excellent adornment, Breasts have been formed, and thy hair hath gron — And thou, naked and bare!

And I pass over by thee, and I see thee, And lo, thy time [is] a time of loves, And I spread My skirt over thee, And I cover thy nakedness, And I sear to thee, and come in to a covenant ith thee, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And thou dost become Mine.
And I do ash thee ith ater, And I ash aay thy blood from off thee, And I anoint thee ith perfume.
And I clothe thee ith embroidery, And I shoe thee ith badger’s skin, And I gird thee ith fine linen, And I cover thee ith figured silk.
And I adorn thee ith adornments, And I give bracelets for thy hands, And a chain for thy neck.
And I give a ring for thy nose, And rings for thine ears, And a cron of beauty on thy head.

And thou dost put on gold and silver, And thy clothing [is] fine linen, And figured silk and embroidery, Fine flour, and honey, and oil thou hast eaten, And thou art very very beautiful, And dost go prosperously to the kingdom.
And go forth doth thy name among nations, Because of thy beauty — for it [is] complete, In My honour that I have set upon thee, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And thou dost trust in thy beauty, And goest a-horing because of thy renon, And dost pour out thy horedoms On every passer by — to him it is.
And thou dost take of thy garments, And dost make to thee spotted high-places, And dost go a-horing upon them, They are not coming in — nor shall it be!
And thou dost take thy beauteous vessels Of My gold and My silver that I gave to thee, And dost make to thee images of a male, And dost go a-horing ith them,
And dost take the garments of thy embroidery, And thou dost cover them, And My oil and My perfume thou hast set before them.
And My bread, that I gave to thee, Fine flour, and oil, and honey, that I caused thee to eat. Thou hast even set it before them, For a seet fragrance — thus it is, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And thou dost take thy sons and thy daughters Whom thou hast born to Me, And dost sacrifice them to them for food. Is it a little thing because of thy horedoms,
That thou dost slaughter My sons, And dost give them up in causing them to pass over to them?
And ith all thine abominations and thy horedoms, Thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, When thou ast naked and bare, Trodden don in thy blood thou ast!
And it cometh to pass, after all thy ickedness, (Woe, oe, to thee — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah),
That thou dost build to thee an arch, And dost make to thee a high place in every broad place.
At every head of the ay thou hast built thy high place, And thou dost make thy beauty abominable, And dost open ide thy feet to every passer by, And dost multiply thy horedoms,
And dost go a-horing unto sons of Egypt, Thy neighbours — great of appetite! And thou dost multiply thy horedoms, To provoke Me to anger.
And lo, I have stretched out My hand against thee, And I diminish thy portion, And give thee to the desire of those hating thee, The daughters of the Philistines, Who are ashamed of thy icked ay.
And thou goest a-horing unto sons of Asshur, Without thy being satisfied, And thou dost go a-horing ith them, And also — thou hast not been satisfied.
And thou dost multiply thy horedoms On the land of Canaan — toard Chaldea, And even ith this thou hast not been satisfied.
Ho eak [is] thy heart, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, In thy doing all these, The ork of a domineering horish oman.
In thy building thine arch at the head of every ay, Thy high place thou hast made in every broad place, And — hast not been as a hore deriding a gift.
The ife ho committeth adultery — Under her husband — doth receive strangers.
To all hores they give a gift, And — thou hast given thy gifts to all thy lovers, And dost bribe them to come in unto thee, From round about — in thy horedoms.
And the contrary is in thee from omen in thy horedoms, That after thee none doth go a-horing; And in thy giving a gift, And a gift hath not been given to thee; And thou art become contrary.
Therefore, O hore, hear a ord of Jehovah,

Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of thy brass being poured forth, And thy nakedness is revealed in thy horedoms near thy lovers, And near all the idols of thy abominations, And according to the blood of thy sons, Whom thou hast given to them;

Therefore, lo, I am assembling all thy lovers, To hom thou hast been seet, And all hom thou hast loved, Besides all hom thou hast hated; And I have assembled them by thee round about, And have revealed thy nakedness to them, And they have seen all thy nakedness.
And I have judged thee — judgments of adulteresses, And of omen shedding blood, And have given thee blood, fury, and jealousy.

And I have given thee into their hand, And they have thron don thine arch, And they have broken don thy high places, And they have stript thee of thy garments, And they have taken thy beauteous vessels, And they have left thee naked and bare.
And have caused an assembly to come up against thee, And stoned thee ith stones, And thrust thee through ith their sords,
And burnt thy houses ith fire, And done in thee judgments before the eyes of many omen, And I have caused thee to cease from going a-horing, And also a gift thou givest no more.
And I have caused My fury against thee to rest, And My jealousy hath turned aside from thee, And I have been quiet, and I am not angry any more.

Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, And dost give trouble to Me in all these, Lo, even I also thy ay at first gave up, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And I did not this thought for all thine abominations.
Lo, every one using a simile, Doth use a simile concerning thee, saying: As the mother — her daughter!

Thy mother’s daughter thou [art], Loathing her husband and her sons, And thy sisters’ sister thou [art], Who loathed their husbands and their sons, Your mother [is] a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
And thine elder sister [is] Samaria, she and her daughters, Who is delling at thy left hand, And thy younger sister, ho is delling on thy right hand, [is] Sodom and her daughters.
And — in their ays thou hast not alked, And according to their abominations done, As a little thing it hath been loathed, And thou dost more corruptly than they in all thy ays.
I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Sodom thy sister hath not done — she and her daughters — As thou hast done — thou and thy daughters.

Lo, this hath been the iniquity of Sodom thy sister, Arrogancy, fulness of bread, and quiet ease, Have been to her and to her daughters, And the hand of the afflicted and needy She hath not strengthened.
And they are haughty and do abomination before Me, And I turn them aside hen I have seen.
As to Samaria, as the half of thy sins — she hath not sinned, And thou dost multiply thine abominations more than they, And dost justify thy sisters by all thy abominations that thou hast done.

Thou also — bear thy shame, That thou hast adjudged to thy sisters, Because of thy sins that thou hast done more abominably than they, They are more righteous than thou, And thou, also, be ashamed and bear thy shame, In thy justifying thy sisters.
And I have turned back [to] their captivity, The captivity of Sodom and her daughters, And the captivity of Samaria and her daughters, And the captivity of thy captives in their midst,
So that thou dost bear thy shame, And hast been ashamed of all that thou hast done, In thy comforting them.

And thy sisters, Sodom and her daughters, Do turn back to their former state, And Samaria and her daughters Do turn back to their former state, And thou and thy daughters do turn back to your former state.
And thy sister Sodom hath not been for a report in thy mouth, In the day of thine arrogancy,
Before thy ickedness is revealed, As [at] the time of the reproach of the daughters of Aram, And of all her neighbours, the daughters of the Philistines, Who are despising thee round about.
Thy devices and thine abominations, Thou hast borne them, an affirmation of Jehovah.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: I have dealt ith thee as thou hast done, In that thou hast despised an oath — to break covenant.
And I — I have remembered My covenant ith thee, In the days of thy youth, And I have established for thee a covenant age-during.
And thou hast remembered thy ays, And thou hast been ashamed, In thy receiving thy sisters — Thine elder ith thy younger, And I have given them to thee for daughters, And not by thy covenant.
And I — I have established My covenant ith thee, And thou hast knon that I [am] Jehovah.

So that thou dost remember, And thou hast been ashamed, And there is not to thee any more an opening of the mouth because of thy shame, In My receiving atonement for thee, For all that thou hast done, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, put forth a riddle, and use a simile unto the house of Israel,

and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: The great eagle, great-inged, long-pinioned, Full of feathers, that hath diverse colours, Hath come in unto Lebanon, And it taketh the foliage of the cedar,
The top of its tender tigs it hath cropped, And it bringeth it in to the land of Canaan. In a city of merchants it hath placed it.
And it taketh of the seed of the land, And doth put it in a field of seed, To take by many aters, In a conspicuous place it hath set it.

And it springeth up, and becometh a spreading vine, humble of stature, To turn its thin shoots toard itself, And its roots are under it, And it becometh a vine, and maketh boughs, And sendeth forth beauteous branches.

And there is another great eagle, Great-inged, and abounding ith feathers, And lo, this vine hath bent its roots toard him, And its thin shoots it hath sent out toard him, To ater it from the furros of its planting,
On a good field, by many aters, it is planted, To make branches, and to bear fruit, To be for an goodly vine.

Say: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: It prospereth — its roots doth he not dra out, And its fruit cut off, and it is ithered? [In] all the leaves of its springing it ithereth, And not by great strength, and by a numerous people, To lift it up by its roots.
And lo, the planted thing — doth it prosper? When come against it doth the east ind, Doth it not utterly ither? On the furros of its springing it ithereth.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:

’Say, I pray thee, to the rebellious house, Have ye not knon hat these [are]? Say, Lo, come hath the king of Babylon to Jerusalem, And he taketh its king, and its princes, And bringeth them to himself to Babylon.
And he taketh of the seed of the kingdom, And maketh ith him a covenant, And bringeth him in to an oath, And the mighty of the land he hath taken,
That the kingdom may be humble, That it may not lift itself up, To keep his covenant — that it may stand.

And he rebelleth against him, To send his messengers to Egypt, To give to him horses, and much people, Doth he prosper? doth he escape ho is doing these things? And hath he broken covenant and escaped?

I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Doth he not — in the place of the king ho is causing him to reign, Whose oath he hath despised, And hose covenant he hath broken, With him — in the midst of Babylon — die?
And not ith a great force, and ith a numerous assembly, Doth Pharaoh maintain him in battle, By pouring out a mount, and in building a fortification, To cut off many souls.
And he despised the oath — to break covenant, And lo, he hath given his hand, And all these he hath done, he escapeth not.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: I live — Mine oath that he hath despised, And My covenant that he hath broken, Have I not put it on his head?
And I have spread out for him My snare, And he hath been caught in My net, And I have brought him in to Babylon, And pleaded ith him there his trespass, That he hath trespassed against Me.
And all his fugitives, ith all his bands, By sord do fall, and those remaining, To every ind they are spread out, And ye have knon that I, Jehovah, have spoken.

Thus said the Lord Jehovah: I have taken of the foliage of the high cedar, And I have set [it], From the top of its tender shoots a tender one I crop, And I — I have planted [it] on a mountain high and lofty.

In a mountain — the high place of Israel, I plant it, And it hath borne boughs, and yielded fruit, And become a goodly cedar, And delt under it have all birds of every ing, In the shade of its thin shoots they dell.

And knon have all trees of the field That I, Jehovah, have made lo the high tree, I have set on high the lo tree, I have dried up the moist tree, And I have caused the dry tree to flourish, I, Jehovah, have spoken, and have done [it]!’
’And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’What — to you, ye — using this simile Concerning the ground of Israel, saying: Fathers do eat unripe fruit, And the sons’ teeth are blunted?
I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Ye have no more the use of this simile in Israel.
Lo, all the souls are Mine, As the soul of the father, So also the soul of the son — they are Mine, The soul that is sinning — it doth die.
And a man, hen he is righteous, And hath done judgment and righteousness,
On the mountains he hath not eaten, And his eyes he hath not lifted up Unto idols of the house of Israel, And the ife of his neighbour defiled not, And to a separated oman cometh not near,
A man — he doth not oppress, His pledge to the debtor he doth return, Plunder he doth not take aay, His bread to the hungry he doth give, And the naked doth cover ith a garment,
In usury he doth not give, and increase taketh not, From perversity he turneth back his hand, True judgment he doth beteen man and man.
In My statutes he doth alk, And My judgments he hath kept — to deal truly, Righteous [is] he, he surely liveth, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And — he hath begotten a son, A burglar — a shedder of blood, And he hath made a brother of one of these,
And he all those hath not done, For even on the mountains he hath eaten, And the ife of his neighbour he hath defiled,
The afflicted and needy he hath oppressed, Plunder he hath taken violently aay, A pledge he doth not return, And unto the idols he hath lifted up his eyes, Abomination he hath done!
In usury he hath given, and increase taken, And he liveth: he doth not live, All these abominations he hath done, He doth surely die, his blood is on him.
And — lo, he hath begotten a son, And he seeth all the sins of his father, That he hath done, and he feareth, And doth not do like them,
On the mountains he hath not eaten, And his eyes he hath not lifted up Unto idols of the house of Israel, The ife of his neighbour he hath not defiled,
A man — he hath not oppressed, A pledge he hath not bound, And plunder he hath not taken aay, His bread to the hungry he hath given, And the naked he covered ith a garment,

From the afflicted he hath turned back his hand, Usury and increase he hath not taken, My judgments he hath done, In My statutes he hath alked, He doth not die for the iniquity of his father, He doth surely live.
His father — because he used oppression, Did violently Plunder a brother, And that hich [is] not good did in the midst of his people, And lo, he is dying in his iniquity.

And ye have said, Wherefore hath not the son, Borne of the iniquity of the father? And — the son judgment and righteousness hath done, All My statutes he hath kept, And he doeth them, he surely liveth.

The soul that doth sin — it doth die. A son doth not bear of the iniquity of the father, And a father doth not bear of the iniquity of the son, The righteousness of the righteous is on him, And the ickedness of the icked is on him.
And the icked — hen he turneth back From all his sins that he hath done, And he hath kept all My statutes, And hath done judgment and righteousness, He doth surely live, he doth not die.
All his transgressions that he hath done Are not remembered to him, In his righteousness that he hath done he liveth.
Do I at all desire the death of the icked? An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Is it not in his turning back from his ay — And he hath lived?

And in the turning back of the righteous from his righteousness, And he hath done perversity, According to all the abominations That the icked hath done, he doth — thus he liveth, All his righteousnesses that he hath done are not remembered, For his trespass that he hath trespassed, And for his sin that he hath sinned, For them he doth die.
And ye have said, Not pondered is the ay of the Lord. Hear, I pray you, O house of Israel, My ay — is it not pondered? Are not your ays unpondered?
In the turning back of the righteous from his righteousness, And he hath done perversity, And he is dying by them, for his perversity That he hath done he dieth.
And in the turning back of the icked From his ickedness that he hath done, And he doth judgment and righteousness, He his soul doth keep alive.
And he seeth and turneth back, From all his transgressions that he hath done, He doth surely live, he doth not die,
And the house of Israel have said, Not pondered is the ay of the Lord, My ays — are they not pondered? O house of Israel — are not your ays unpondered?

Therefore, each according to his ays I judge you, O house of Israel? An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Turn ye back, yea, turn yourselves back, From all your transgressions, And iniquity is not to you for a stumbling-block,
Cast from off you all your transgressions, By hich ye have transgressed, And make to you a ne heart, and a ne spirit, And hy do ye die, O house of Israel?
For I have no pleasure in the death of the dying, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And turn ye back and live!
And thou, lift up a lamentation unto princes of Israel,
and thou hast said: What [is] thy mother? — a lioness, Among lions she hath crouched don, In the midst of young lions she hath multiplied her helps.
And she bringeth up one of her helps, A young lion it hath been, And it learneth to tear prey, man it hath devoured.
And hear of it do nations, In their pit it hath been caught, And they bring it in ith chains unto the land of Egypt.
And she seeth, that stayed — perished hath her hope, And she taketh one of her helps, A young lion she hath made it.
And it goeth up and don in the midst of lions, A young lion it hath been, And it learneth to tear prey, man it hath devoured.
And it knoeth his forsaken habitations, And their cities it hath laid aste, And desolate is the land and its fulness, Because of the voice of his roaring.
And set against it do nations Round about from the provinces. And they spread out for it their net, In their pit it hath been caught.
And they put it in prison — in chains, And they bring it unto the king of Babylon, They bring it in unto bularks, So that its voice is not heard any more On mountains of Israel.
Thy mother [is] as a vine in thy blood by aters planted, Fruitful and full of boughs it hath been, Because of many aters.
And it hath strong rods for sceptres of rulers, And high is its stature above thick branches, And it appeareth in its height In the multitude of its thin shoots.
And it is plucked up in fury, To the earth it hath been cast, And the east ind hath dried up its fruit, Broken and ithered hath been the rod of its strength, Fire hath consumed it.
And no — it is planted in a ilderness, In a land dry and thirsty.
And go forth doth fire from a rod of its boughs, Its fruit it hath devoured, And it hath no rod of strength — a sceptre to rule, Lamentation it [is] — and it is for a lamentation!’
And it cometh to pass, in the seventh year, in the fifth [month], in the tenth of the month, come in have certain of the elders of Israel to seek Jehovah, and they sit before me;
and there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’Son of man, speak ith the elders of Israel, and thou hast said unto them, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: To seek Me are ye coming in? I live — I am not sought by you — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
Dost thou judge them? Dost thou judge, son of man? The abominations of their fathers cause them to kno,

and thou hast said unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In the day of My fixing on Israel, I lift up My hand, To the seed of the house of Jacob, And am knon to them in the land of Egypt, And I lift up My hand to them, Saying, I [am] Jehovah your God.
In that day I did lift up My hand to them, To bring them forth from the land of Egypt, Unto a land that I spied out for them, Floing ith milk and honey, A beauty it [is] to all the lands,
And I say unto them, Let each cast aay the detestable things of his eyes, And ith the idols of Egypt be not defiled, I [am] Jehovah your God.

And — they rebel against Me, And have not been illing to hearken to Me, Each, the detestable things of their eyes, They have not cast aay, And the idols of Egypt have not forsaken, And I say — to pour out My fury on them, To complete Mine anger against them, In the midst of the land of Egypt.
And I do [it] for My name’s sake, Not to pollute [it] before the eyes of the nations, In hose midst they [are], Before hose eyes I became knon to them, To bring them out from the land of Egypt.
And I bring them out of the land of Egypt, And I bring them in unto the ilderness,
And I give to them My statutes, And my judgments I caused them to kno, Which the man ho doth — liveth by them.
And also My sabbaths I have given to them, To be for a sign beteen Me and them, To kno that I [am] Jehovah their sanctifier.

And — rebel against me do the house of Israel in the ilderness, In My statutes they have not alked, And My judgments they have despised, Which the man ho doth — liveth by them. And My sabbaths they have greatly polluted, And I say to pour out My fury on them in the ilderness, to consume them.
And I do [it] for My name’s sake, Not to pollute [it] before the eyes of the nations, Before hose eyes I brought them forth.
And also, I, I have lifted up My hand to them in the ilderness, Not to bring them in to the land that I had given, Floing ith milk and honey, A beauty it [is] to all the lands,
Because against My judgments they did kick, And in My statutes they have not alked, And My sabbaths they have polluted, For after their idols their heart is going.
And Mine eye hath pity on them — against destroying them, And I have not made of them an end in the ilderness.
And I say to their sons in the ilderness: In the statutes of your fathers ye alk not, And their judgments ye do not observe, And ith their idols ye are not defiled.
I [am] Jehovah your God, in My statutes alk, And My judgments observe, and do them,
And My sabbaths sanctify, And they have been for a sign beteen Me and you, To kno that I, Jehovah, [am] your God.

And — the sons rebel against Me, In My statutes they have not alked, And My judgments they have not observed — to do them, Which the man ho doth — liveth by them. My sabbaths they have polluted, And I say to pour out My fury upon them, To complete Mine anger against them in the ilderness.
And I have turned back My hand, And I do [it] for My name’s sake, Not to pollute [it] before the eyes of the nations, Before hose eyes I brought them out.
I also, I have lifted up My hand to them in the ilderness, To scatter them among nations, And to spread them through lands.
Because My judgments they have not done, And My statutes they have despised, And My sabbaths they have polluted, And after idols of their fathers have their eyes been.
And I also, I have given to them statutes not good, And judgments by hich they do not live.
And I defile them by their on gifts, By causing to pass aay every opener of a omb, So that I make them desolate, So that they kno that I [am] Jehovah.
Therefore, speak unto the house of Israel, son of man, and thou hast said unto them, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Still in this have your fathers reviled Me, In their committing against Me a trespass.

And I bring them in unto the land, That I did lift up My hand to give to them, And they see every high hill, and every thick tree, And they sacrifice there their sacrifices, And give there the provocation of their offering, And make there their seet fragrance, And they pour out there their libations.
And I say unto them: What [is] the high place hither ye are going in? And its name is called ’high place’ to this day.
Therefore, say unto the house of Israel: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In the ay of your fathers are ye defiled? And after their detestable things go a-horing?

And in the offering of your gifts, In causing your sons to pass through fire, Ye are defiled by all your idols to this day, And I am sought by you, O house of Israel! I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, I am not sought by you.
And that hich is going up on your mind, It is not at all — in that ye are saying: We ill be as the nations, as the families of the lands, To serve ood and stone.
I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Do not I, ith a strong hand, And ith a stretched-out arm, And ith fury poured out — rule over you?
And I have brought you forth from the peoples, And assembled you from the lands In hich ye have been scattered, With a strong hand and ith a stretched-out arm, And ith fury poured out.
And I have brought you in unto the ilderness of the peoples, And have been judged ith you there face to face.
As I as judged ith your fathers, In the ilderness of the land of Egypt, So I am judged ith you, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And I have caused you to pass under the rod, And brought you into the bond of the covenant,

And cleared out from you the rebels, And them transgressing against Me, From the land of their sojournings I bring them out, And unto the land of Israel they come not, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.

And ye, O house of Israel, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Each his idols — go — serve ye, And, afterards, if ye are not hearkening to me, And My holy name ye do not pollute any more by your gifts, and by your idols.

For, in My holy mountain, In the mountain of the height of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, There serve Me do all the house of Israel, All of it, in the land — there I accept them, And there I do seek your heave-offerings, And ith the first-fruit of your gifts, With all your holy things.

With seet fragrance I do accept you, In My bringing you out from the peoples, And I have assembled you from the lands In hich ye have been scattered, And I have been sanctified in you Before the eyes of the nations.
And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My bringing you to the ground of Israel, Unto the land that I did lift up My hand To give it to your fathers,
And ye have remembered there your ays, And all your doings, In hich ye have been defiled, And ye have been loathsome in your on faces, For all your evils that ye have done.

And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My dealing ith you for My name’s sake, Not according to your evil ays, And according to your corrupt doings, O house of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
Son of man, set thy face the ay of Teman, and prophesy unto the south, and prophesy unto the forest of the field — the south;

and thou hast said to the forest of the south: Hear a ord of Jehovah: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am kindling in thee a fire, And it hath devoured in thee every moist tree, and every dry tree, Not quenched is the gloing flames, And burnt by it have been all faces from south to north.
And seen have all flesh, that I, Jehovah, have kindled it — it is not quenched.’
And I say, ’Ah, Lord Jehovah, They are saying of me, Is he not using similes?
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, set thy face unto Jerusalem, and prophesy unto the holy places, and prophesy unto the ground of Israel;
and thou hast said unto the ground of Israel: Thus said Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, And have brought out My sord from its scabbard, And have cut off from thee righteous and icked.
Because that I have cut off from thee righteous and icked, Therefore go out doth My sord from its scabbard, Unto all flesh, from south to north.
And knon have all flesh that I, Jehovah, Have brought out My sord from its scabbard, It doth not turn back any more.
And thou, son of man, sigh ith breaking of loins, yea, ith bitterness thou dost sigh before their eyes,

and it hath come to pass, hen they say unto thee, For hat art thou sighing? that thou hast said: Because of the report, for it is coming, And melted hath every heart, And feeble hath been all hands, And eak is every spirit, And all knees go — aters, Lo, it is coming, yea, it hath been, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, prophesy, and thou hast said, Thus said Jehovah, say: A sord, a sord is sharpened, and also polished.
So as to slaughter a slaughter it is sharpened. So as to have brightness it is polished, Desire hath rejoiced the sceptre of my son, It is despising every tree.
And he giveth it for polishing, For laying hold of by the hand. It is sharpened — the sord — and polished, To give it into the hand of a slayer.
Cry and hol, son of man, For it hath been among My people, It [is] among all the princes of Israel, Cast unto the sord have been My people. Therefore strike on thy thigh,
Because [it is] a trier, And hat if even the sceptre it is despising? It shall not be, an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.

And thou, son of man, prophesy, And smite hand on hand, And bent is the sord a third time, The sord of the ounded! It [is] the sord of the ounded — the great one, That is entering the inner chamber to them.
To melt the heart, and to multiply the ruins, By all their gates I have set the point of a sord. Ah, it is made for brightness, Wrapped up for slaughter.
Take possession of the right, place thyself at the left, Whither thy face is appointed.
And I also, I smite My hand on my hand, And have caused My fury to rest; I, Jehovah, have spoken.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’And thou, son of man, appoint for thee to ays, for the coming in of the sord of the king of Babylon; from one land they come forth, both of them, and a station prepare thou, at the top of the ay of the city prepare [it].
A ay appoint for the coming of the sord, Unto Rabbath of the sons of Ammon, And to Judah, in Jerusalem — the fenced.
For stood hath the king of Babylon at the head of the ay, At the top of the to ays, to use divination, He hath moved lightly ith the arros, He hath asked at the teraphim, He hath looked on the liver.

At his right hath been the divination — Jerusalem, To place battering-rams, To open the mouth ith slaughter, To lift up a voice ith shouting, To place battering-rams against the gates, To pour out a mount, to build a fortification.
And it hath been to them as a false divination in their eyes, Who have sorn oaths to them, And he is causing iniquity to be remembered to be caught.

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of your causing your iniquity to be remembered, In your transgressions being revealed, For your sins being seen, in all your doings, Because of your being remembered, By the hand ye are caught.
And thou, ounded, icked one, Prince of Israel, hose day hath come, In the time of the iniquity of the end!
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Turn aside the mitre, and bear aay the cron, This — not this — the lo make high, And the high make lo.
An overturn, overturn, overturn, I make it, Also this hath not been till the coming of Him, Whose [is] the judgment, and I have given it.

And thou, son of man, prophesy, and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah concerning the sons of Ammon, and concerning their reproach: and thou hast said: A sord, a sord, open for slaughter, Polished to the utmost for brightness!
In the seeing for thee of a vain thing, In the divining for thee of a lie, To put thee on the necks of the ounded of the icked, hose day hath come, In the time of the iniquity of the end.
Turn [it] back unto its scabbard, In the place here thou ast produced, In the land of thy birth I do judge thee.
And I have poured on thee Mine indignation, With fire of My rath I blo against thee, And have given thee into the hand of brutish men — artificers of destruction.
To the fire thou art for fuel, Thy blood is in the midst of the land, Thou art not remembered, For I, Jehovah, have spoken!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’And thou, son of man, dost thou judge? dost thou judge the city of blood? then thou hast caused it to kno all its abominations,
and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: The city is shedding blood in its midst, For the coming in of its time, And it hath made idols on it for defilement.

By thy blood that thou hast shed thou hast been guilty, And by thine idols that thou hast made thou hast been defiled, And thou causest thy days to dra near, And art come in unto thine years, Therefore I have given thee a reproach to nations, And a derision to all the lands.
The near and the far-off from thee scoff at thee, O defiled of name — abounding in trouble.
Lo, princes of Israel — each according to his arm Have been in thee to shed blood.
Father and mother made light of in thee, To a sojourner they dealt oppressively in thy midst, Fatherless and ido they oppressed in thee.
My holy things thou hast despised, And My sabbaths thou hast polluted.
Men of slander have been in thee to shed blood, And on the mountains they have eaten in thee, Wickedness they have done in thy midst.
The nakedness of a father hath one uncovered in thee, The defiled of impurity they humbled in thee.
And each ith the ife of his neighbour hath done abomination, And each his daughter-in-la hath defiled through ickedness, And each his sister, his father’s daughter, hath humbled in thee.
A bribe they have taken in thee to shed blood, Usury and increase thou hast taken, And cuttest off thy neighbour by oppression, And Me thou hast forgotten, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!
And lo, I have smitten My hand, Because of thy dishonest gain that thou hast gained, And for thy blood that hath been in thy midst.
Doth thy heart stand — are thy hands strong, For the days that I am dealing ith thee? I, Jehovah, have spoken and have done [it].
And I have scattered thee among nations, And have spread thee out among lands, And consumed thy uncleanness out of thee.
And thou hast been polluted in thyself Before the eyes of nations, And thou hast knon that I [am] Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying, ’Son of man,
The house of Israel hath been to Me for dross, All of them [are] brass, and tin, and iron, and lead, In the midst of a furnace — dross hath silver been,
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of your all becoming dross, Therefore, lo, I am gathering you unto the midst of Jerusalem,

A gathering of silver, and brass, and iron, and lead, and tin, Unto the midst of a furnace — to blo on it fire, to melt it, So do I gather in Mine anger and in My fury, And I have let rest, and have melted you.
And I have heaped you up, And blon on you in the fire of My rath, And ye have been melted in its midst.
As the melting of silver in the midst of a furnace, So are ye melted in its midst, And ye have knon that I, Jehovah, I have poured out My fury upon you.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, say to it, Thou [art] a land, It [is] not cleansed nor rained on in a day of indignation.
A conspiracy of its prophets [is] in its midst, as a roaring lion tearing prey; The soul they have devoured, Wealth and glory they have taken, Its idos have multiplied in its midst.

Its priests have ronged My la, And they pollute My holy things, Beteen holy and common they have not made separation, And beteen the unclean and the clean they have not made knon, And from my sabbaths they have hidden their eyes, And I am pierced in their midst.
Its princes in its midst [are] as olves, Tearing prey, to shed blood, to destroy souls, For the sake of gaining dishonest gain.
And its prophets have daubed for them ith chalk, Seeing a vain thing, and divining for them a lie, Saying, ’Thus said the Lord Jehovah:’ And Jehovah hath not spoken.
The people of the land have used oppression, And have taken plunder violently aay, And humble and needy have oppressed, And the sojourner oppressed — ithout judgment.
And I seek of them a man making a fence, And standing in the breach before Me, In behalf of the land — not to destroy it, And I have not found.
And I pour out on them mine indignation, By fire of My rath I have consumed them, Their ay on their on head I have put, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying, ’Son of man,
To omen ere daughters of one mother,
And they go a-horing in Egypt, In their youth they have gone a-horing, There they have bruised their breasts, And there they have dealt ith the loves of their virginity.
And their names [are] Aholah the elder, And Aholibah her sister, And they are Mine, and bear sons and daughters. As to their names — Samaria [is] Aholah, And Jerusalem [is] Aholibah.
And go a-horing doth Aholah under Me, And she doteth on her lovers, On the neighbouring Assyrians,
Clothed ith blue — governors and prefects, Desirable young men all of them, Horsemen, riding on horses,
And she giveth her horedoms on them, The choice of the sons of Asshur, All of them — even all on hom she doted, By all their idols she hath been defiled.
And her horedoms out of Egypt she hath not forsaken, For ith her they lay in her youth, And they dealt ith the loves of her virginity, And they pour out their horedoms on her.
Therefore I have given her into the hand of her lovers, Into the hand of sons of Asshur on hom she doted.
They have uncovered her nakedness, Her sons and her daughters they have taken, And her by sord they have slain, And she is a name for omen, And judgments they have done ith her.
And see doth her sister Aholibah, And she maketh her doting love more corrupt than she, And her horedoms than the horedoms of her sister.
On sons of Asshur she hath doted, Governors and prefects, Neighbouring ones — clothed in perfection, Horsemen, riding on horses, Desirable young men all of them.
And I see that she hath been defiled, One ay [is] to them both.
And she doth add unto her horedoms, And she seeth graved men on the all, Pictures of Chaldeans, graved ith red lead,
Girded ith a girdle on their loins, Dyed attire spread out on their heads, The appearance of rulers — all of them, The likeness of sons of Babylon, Chaldea is the land of their birth.
And she doteth on them at the sight of her eyes, And sendeth messengers to them, to Chaldea.
And come in unto her do sons of Babylon, To the bed of loves, And they defile her ith their horedoms, And she is defiled ith them, And her soul is alienated from them.
And she revealeth her horedoms, And she revealeth her nakedness, And alienated is My soul from off her, As alienated as My soul from off her sister.
And she multiplieth her horedoms, To remember the days of her youth, When she ent a-horing in the land of Egypt.
And she doteth on their paramours, Whose flesh [is] the flesh of asses, And the issue of horses — their issue.
