Thou lookest after the ickedness of thy youth, In dealing out of Egypt thy loves, For the sake of the breasts of thy youth.
Therefore, O Aholibah, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am stirring up thy lovers against thee, From hom thy soul hath been alienated, And have brought them in against thee from round about.

Sons of Babylon, and of all Chaldea, Pekod, and Shoa, and Koa, All the sons of Asshur ith them, Desirable young men, governors and prefects, All of them — rulers and proclaimed ones, Riding on horses, all of them.

And they have come in against thee, With arms, rider, and heel, And ith an assembly of peoples; Target, and shield, and helmet, They do set against thee round about, And I have set before them judgment, They have judged thee in their Judgments.

And I have set My jealousy against thee, And they have dealt ith thee in fury, Thy nose and thine ears they turn aside, And thy posterity by sord falleth, They, thy sons and thy daughters do take aay, And thy posterity is devoured by fire.
And they have stripped thee of thy garments, And have taken thy beauteous jeels.
And I have caused thy ickedness to cease from thee, And thy horedoms out of the land of Egypt, And thou liftest not up thine eyes unto them, And Egypt thou dost not remember again.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am giving thee into a hand that thou hast hated, Into a hand from hich thou ast alienated.

And they have dealt ith thee in hatred, And they have taken all thy labour, And they have left thee naked and bare, And revealed hath been the nakedness of thy horedoms, And the ickedness of thy horedoms.
To do these things to thee, In thy going a-horing after nations, Because thou hast been defiled ith their idols,
In the ay of thy sister thou hast alked, And I have given her cup into thy hand.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: The cup of thy sister thou dost drink, The deep and the ide one, (Thou art for laughter and for scorn,) Abundant to contain.
With drunkenness and sorro thou art filled, A cup of astonishment and desolation, The cup of thy sister Samaria.
And thou hast drunk it, and hast drained [it], And its earthen are thou dost gna, And thine on breasts thou pluckest off, For I have spoken, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah,
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because thou hast forgotten Me, And thou dost cast Me behind thy back, Even thou also bear thy ickedness and thy horedoms.’
And Jehovah saith unto me, ’Son of man, Dost thou judge Aholah and Aholibah? Declare then to them their abominations.
For they have committed adultery, And blood [is] in their hands, With their idols they committed adultery, And also their sons hom they bore to Me, They caused to pass over to them for food.
Again, this they have done to Me, They defiled My sanctuary in that day, And My sabbaths they have polluted.
And in their slaughtering their sons to their idols They also come in unto My sanctuary in that day to pollute it, And lo, thus they have done in the midst of My house,
And also that they send to men coming from afar, Unto hom a messenger is sent, And lo, they have come in for hom thou hast ashed, Painted thine eyes, and put on adornment.
And thou hast sat on a couch of honour, And a table arrayed before it, And My perfume and My oil placed on it.

And the voice of a multitude at ease [is] ith her, And unto men of the common people are brought in Sabeans from the ilderness, And they put bracelets on their hands, And a beauteous cron on their heads.
And I say of the orn-out one in adulteries, No they commit her horedoms — she also!
And they come in unto her, As the coming in unto a horish oman, So they have come in unto Aholah, And unto Aholibah — the icked omen.
As to righteous men, they judge them ith the judgment of adulteresses, And the judgment of omen shedding blood, For they [are] adulteresses, And blood [is] in their hands.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: Bring up against them an assembly, And give them to trembling and to spoiling.
And they have cast at them the stone of the assembly, And cut them ith their sords, Their sons and their daughters they do slay, And their houses ith fire they burn.
And I have caused ickedness to cease from the land, And instructed have been all the omen, And they do not according to your ickedness.
And they have put your ickedness on you, And the sins of your idols ye bear, And ye have knon that I [am] the Lord Jehovah!
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, in the tenth of the month, saying,
’Son of man, rite for thee the name of the day — this self-same day leaned hath the king of Babylon toard Jerusalem in this self-same day —
and use unto the rebellious house a simile, and thou hast said unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: To set on the pot, to set [it] on, and also to pour into it ater,
To gather its pieces unto it, every good piece, Thigh and shoulder, the choice of the bones to fill in.
The choice of the flock to take, And also to pile of the bones under it, Boil it thoroughly, yea, cook its bones in its midst.

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Woe [to] the city of blood, A pot hose scum [is] in it, And its scum hath not come out of it, By piece of it, by piece of it bring it out, Not fallen on it hath a lot.
For her blood in her midst hath been, On a clear place of a rock she hath set it, She hath not poured it on the earth, To cover it over ith dust.
To cause fury to come up to take vengeance, I have put her blood on a clear place of a rock — not to be covered.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Woe [to] the city of blood, yea, I — I make great the pile.
Make abundant the ood, Kindle the fire, consume the flesh, And make the compound, And let the bones be burnt.
And cause it to stand on its coals empty, So that its brass is hot and burning, Melted hath been in its midst its uncleanness, Consumed is its scum.
[With] sorros she hath earied herself, And the abundance of her scum goeth not out of her, In the fire [is] her scum.
In thine uncleanness [is] ickedness, Because I have cleansed thee, And thou hast not been cleansed, From thine uncleanness thou art not cleansed again, Till I have caused My fury to rest on thee.

I, Jehovah, hath spoken, It hath come, and I have done [it], I do not free, nor do I spare, nor do I repent, According to thy ays, and according to thine acts, they have judged thee, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, lo, I am taking from thee the desire of thine eyes by a stroke, and thou dost not mourn, nor eep, nor let thy tear come.

Cease to groan, [for] the dead thou dost make no mourning, thy bonnet bind on thee, and thy shoes thou dost put on thy feet, and thou dost not cover over the upper lip, and bread of men thou dost not eat.’
And I speak unto the people in the morning, and my ife dieth in the evening, and I do in the morning as I have been commanded.
And the people say unto me, ’Dost thou not declare to us hat these [are] to us, that thou art doing?’
And I say unto them, ’A ord of Jehovah hath been unto me, saying:

Say to the house of Israel: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am polluting My sanctuary, The excellency of your strength, The desire of your eyes, and the pitied of your soul, And your sons and your daughters hom ye have left, by sord they do fall.
And ye have done as I have done, On the upper lip ye are not covered, And bread of men ye do not eat.
And your bonnets [are] on your heads, And your shoes [are] on your feet, Ye do not mourn nor do ye eep, And ye have asted aay for your iniquities, And ye have holed one unto another.
And Ezekiel hath been to you for a type, According to all that he hath done ye do; In its coming in — ye have knon that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.
And thou, son of man, Is it not in the day of My taking from them their strength, The joy of their beauty, the desire of their eyes, And the song of their soul, Their sons and their daughters?
In that day come doth the escaped one to thee. To cause the ears to hear.
In that day opened is thy mouth ith the escaped, And thou speakest, and art not silent any more, And thou hast been to them for a type. And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, set thy face unto the sons of Ammon, and prophesy against them;

and thou hast said to the sons of Ammon: Hear ye a ord of the Lord Jehovah: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of thy saying, Aha, to My sanctuary, Because it hath been polluted, And unto the ground of Israel, Because it hath been desolate, And unto the house of Judah, Because they have gone into a removal:
Therefore, lo, I am giving thee to sons of the east for a possession, And they set their toers in thee, And have placed in thee their tabernacles. They eat thy fruit, and they drink thy milk,
And I have given Rabbah for a habitation of camels, And the sons of Ammon for the crouching of a flock, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of thy clapping the hand, And of thy stamping ith the foot, And thou rejoicest ith all thy despite in soul Against the ground of Israel,

Therefore, lo, I — I have stretched out My hand against thee, And have given thee for a portion to nations, And I have cut thee off from the peoples, And caused thee to perish from the lands; I destroy thee, and thou hast knon that I [am] Jehovah.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of the saying of Moab and Seir: Lo, as all the nations [is] the house of Judah;
Therefore, lo, I am opening the shoulder of Moab — From the cities — from his cities — from his frontier, The beauty of the land, Beth-Jeshimoth, Baal-Meon, and Kiriathaim,
To the sons of the east, ith the sons of Ammon, And I have given it for a possession, So that the sons of Ammon are not remembered among nations.
And in Moab I do judgments, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of the doings of Edom, In taking vengeance on the house of Judah, Yea, they are very guilty, And they have taken vengeance on them.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: I have stretched out My hand against Edom, And I have cut off from it man and beast, And given it up — a aste, from Teman even to Dedan, By sord they do fall.

And I have given My vengeance on Edom, By the hand of My people Israel, And they have done in Edom, According to My anger, and according to My fury, And they have knon My vengeance, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of the doings of the Philistines in vengeance, And they take vengeance ith despite in soul, To destroy — the enmity age-during!
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am stretching out My hand against the Philistines, And I have cut off the Cherethim, And destroyed the remnant of the haven of the sea,
And done upon them great vengeance ith furious reproofs, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My giving out My vengeance on them!
And it cometh to pass, in the eleventh year, in the first of the month, there hath been a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying: ’Son of man,
Because that Tyre hath said of Jerusalem: Aha, she hath been broken, the doors of the peoples, She hath turned round unto me, I am filled — she hath been laid aste,
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, O Tyre, And have caused to come up against thee many nations, As the sea causeth its billos to come up.
And they have destroyed the alls of Tyre, And they have broken don her toers, And I have scraped her dust from her, And made her for a clear place of a rock.
A spreading place of nets she is in the midst of the sea, For I — I have spoken — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And she hath been for a spoil to nations.
And her daughters ho [are] in the field, by sord they are slain, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah,

For, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am bringing in unto Tyre Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, From the north — a king of kings, With horse, and ith chariot, and ith horsemen, Even an assembly, and a numerous people.
Thy daughters in the field by sord he slayeth, And he hath made against thee a fort, And hath poured out against thee a mount, And hath raised against thee a buckler.
And a battering-ram before him he placeth against thy alls, And thy toers he breaketh by his eapons.
From the abundance of his horses cover thee doth their dust, From the noise of horseman, and heel, and rider, Shake do thy alls, in his coming in to thy gates, As the coming into a city broken-up.
With hoofs of his horses he treadeth all thine out-places, Thy people by sord he doth slay, And the pillars of thy strength to the earth come don.

And they have spoiled thy ealth, And they have plundered thy merchandise, And they have thron don thy alls, And thy desirable houses they break don, And thy stones, and thy ood, and thy dust, In the midst of the aters they place.
And I have caused the noise of thy songs to cease, And the voice of thy harps is heard no more.
And I have given thee up for a clear place of a rock, A spreading-place of nets thou art, Thou art not built up any more, For I, Jehovah, I have spoken, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah to Tyre: Do not — from the noise of thy fall, In the groaning of the ounded, In the slaying of the slaughter in thy midst, The isles shake?

And come don from off their thrones have all princes of the sea, And they have turned aside their robes, And their embroidered garments strip off, Trembling they put on, on the earth they sit, And they have trembled every moment, And they have been astonished at thee,

And have lifted up for thee a lamentation, And said to thee: Ho hast thou perished, That art inhabited from the seas, The praised city, that as strong in the sea, She and her inhabitants, Who put their terror on all her inhabitants!
No they tremble, is it not the day of thy fall? Troubled have been the isles that [are] in the sea, at thine outgoing.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: In my making thee a city asted, Like cities that have not been inhabited, In bringing up against thee the deep, Then covered thee have the great aters.

And I have caused thee to go don, With those going don to the pit, Unto the people of old, And I have caused thee to dell in the land, The loer parts — in astes of old, With those going don to the pit, So that thou art not inhabited, And I have given beauty in the land of the living.
Wastes I do make thee, and thou art not, And thou art sought, and art not found any more — to the age, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’And thou, son of man, lift up concerning Tyre a lamentation, and thou hast said to Tyre:
O deller on the entrances of the sea, Merchant of the peoples unto many isles, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: O Tyre, thou — thou hast said: I [am] the perfection of beauty.
In the heart of the seas [are] thy borders, Thy builders have perfected thy beauty.
Of firs of Senir they have built to thee all thy double-boarded ships, Of cedars of Lebanon they have taken to make a mast for thee,
Of oaks of Bashan they made thine oars, Thy bench they have made of ivory, A branch of Ashurim from isles of Chittim.
Of fine linen ith embroidery from Egypt hath been thy sail, To be to thee for an ensign, Of blue and purple from isles of Elishah hath been thy covering.
Inhabitants of Zidon and Arvad have been roers to thee, Thy ise men, O Tyre, have been in thee, They [are] thy pilots.
Elders of Gebal and its ise men have been in thee, Strengthening thy breach; All ships of the sea and their mariners, Have been in thee, to trade [ith] thy merchandise.
Persian and Lud and Phut Have been in thy forces — thy men of ar. Shield and helmet they hung up in thee, They — they have given out thine honour.

The sons of Arvad, and thy force, [Are] on thy alls round about, And short sordsmen in thy toers have been, Their shields they have hung up on thy alls round about, They — they have perfected thy beauty.
Tarshish [is] thy merchant, Because of the abundance of all ealth, For silver, iron, tin, and lead, They have given out thy remnants.
Javan, Tubal, and Meshech — they [are] thy merchants, For persons of men, and vessels of brass, They have given out thy merchandise.
They of the house of Togarmah, [For] horses, and riding steeds, and mules, They have given out thy remnants.
Sons of Dedan [are] thy merchants, Many isles [are] the mart of thy hand, Horns of ivory and ebony they sent back thy reard.
Aram [is] thy merchant, Because of the abundance of thy orks, For emerald, purple, and embroidery, And fine linen, and coral, and agate, They have given out thy remnants.
Judah and the land of Israel — they [are] thy merchants, For heat of Minnith, and Pannag, And honey, and oil, and balm, They have given out thy merchandise.
Damascus [is] thy merchant, For the abundance of thy orks, Because of the abundance of all ealth, For ine of Helbon, and hite ool.
Vedan and Javan go about ith thy remnants, They have given shining iron, cassia, and cane, In thy merchandise it hath been.
Dedan [is] thy merchant, For clothes of freedom for riding.
Arabia, and all princes of Kedar, They [are] the traders of thy hand, For lambs, and rams, and he-goats, In these thy merchants.
Merchants of Sheba and Raamah — they [are] thy merchants, For the chief of all spices, And for every precious stone, and gold, They have given out thy remnants.
Haran, and Canneh, and Eden, merchants of Sheba, Asshur — Chilmad — [are] thy merchants,
They [are] thy merchants for perfect things, For rappings of blue, and embroidery, And for treasuries of rich apparel, With cords bound and girded, for thy merchandise,
Ships of Tarshish [are] thy double alls of thy merchandise, And thou art filled and honoured greatly, In the heart of the seas.
Into great aters have they brought thee, Those roing thee, The east ind hath broken thee in the heart of the seas.

Thy ealth and thy remnants, Thy merchandise, thy mariners, And thy pilots, strengtheners of thy breach, And the traders of thy merchandise, And all thy men of ar, ho [are] in thee, And in all thine assembly that [is] in thy midst, Fall into the heart of the seas in the day of thy fall,
At the voice of the cry of thy pilots shake do the suburbs.
And come don from their ships have all handling an oar, Mariners, all the pilots of the sea, on the land they stand,
And have sounded for thee ith their voice, And cry bitterly, and cause dust to go up on their heads, In ashes they do roll themselves.
And they have made for thee baldness, And they have girded on sackcloth, And they have ept for thee, In bitterness of soul — a bitter mourning.
And lifted up for thee have their sons a lamentation, And they have lamented over thee, ho [is] as Tyre? As the cut-off one in the midst of the sea?
With the outgoing of thy remnants from the seas, Thou hast filled many peoples, With the abundance of thy riches, and thy merchandise, Thou hast made rich things of earth.
The time of [thy] being broken by the seas in the depths of the aters, Thy merchandise and all thy assembly in thy midst have fallen.
All inhabitants of the isles have been astonished at thee, And their kings have been sore afraid, They have been troubled in countenance.
Merchants among the peoples have shrieked for thee, Wastes thou hast been, and thou art not — to the age!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:

’Son of man, say to the leader of Tyre: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because thy heart hath been high, And thou dost say: A god I [am], The habitation of God I have inhabited, In the heart of the seas, And thou [art] man, and not God, And thou givest out thy heart as the heart of God,
Lo, thou [art] iser than Daniel, No hidden thing have they concealed from thee.
By thy isdom and by thine understanding Thou hast made for thee ealth, And makest gold and silver in thy treasuries.
By the abundance of thy isdom, Through thy merchandise, Thou hast multiplied thy ealth, And high is thy heart through thy ealth.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because of thy giving out thy heart as the heart of God,
Therefore, lo, I am bringing in against thee strangers, The terrible of the nations, And they have dran out their sords Against the beauty of thy isdom, And they have pierced thy brightness.
To destruction they bring thee don, Thou diest by the deaths of the ounded, in the heart of the seas.
Dost thou really say, ’I [am] God,’ Before him ho is slaying thee? And thou [art] man, and not God, In the hand of him ho is piercing thee.
The deaths of the uncircumcised thou diest, By the hand of strangers, for I have spoken, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, lift up a lamentation for the king of Tyre, And thou hast said to him: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Thou art sealing up a measurement, Full of isdom, and perfect in beauty.

In Eden, the garden of God, thou hast been, Every precious stone thy covering, Ruby, topaz, and diamond, beryl, onyx, and jasper, Sapphire, emerald, and carbuncle, and gold, The orkmanship of thy tabrets, and of thy pipes, In thee in the day of thy being produced, have been prepared.
Thou [art] an anointed cherub ho is covering, And I have set thee in the holy mount, God thou hast been, In the midst of stones of fire thou hast alked up and don.
Perfect [art] thou in thy ays, From the day of thy being produced, Till perversity hath been found in thee.

By the abundance of thy merchandise They have filled thy midst ith violence, And thou dost sin, And I thrust thee from the mount of God, And I destroy thee, O covering cherub, From the midst of the stones of fire.
High hath been thy heart, because of thy beauty, Thou hast corrupted thy isdom because of thy brightness, On the earth I have cast thee, Before kings I have set thee, to look on thee,

From the abundance of thy iniquity, By the perversity of thy traffic, Thou hast polluted thy sanctuaries, And I bring forth fire from thy midst, It hath devoured thee, And I make thee become ashes on the earth, Before the eyes of all beholding thee.
All knoing thee among the peoples Have been astonished at thee, Wastes thou hast been, and thou art not — to the age.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, set thy face unto Zidon, and prophesy concerning it;

and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, O Zidon, And I have been honoured in thy midst, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My doing in her judgments, And I have been sanctified in her.
And I have sent into her pestilence, And blood into her out-places, The ounded hath been judged in her midst, By the sord upon her round about, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
And there is no more to the house of Israel A pricking brier, and paining thorn, Of all round about them — despising them, And they have knon that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.

Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In My gathering the house of Israel, Out of the peoples among hom they ere scattered, I have been sanctified in them, Before the eyes of the nations, And they have delt on their ground, That I gave to My servant, to Jacob,

And they have delt on it confidently, And builded houses, and planted vineyards, And delt confidently — in My doing judgments, On all those despising them round about, And they have knon that I, Jehovah, [am] their God!’
In the tenth year, in the tenth [month], in the telfth of the month, hath a ord of Jehovah been unto me, saying,
’Son of man, set thy face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy concerning him, and concerning Egypt — all of it.

Speak, and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, Pharaoh king of Egypt! The great dragon that is crouching in the midst of his floods, Who hath said, My flood [is] my on, And I — I have made it [for] myself.

And I have put hooks in thy jas, And I have caused the fish of thy floods to cleave to thy scales, And I have caused thee to come up from the midst of thy floods, And every fish of thy floods to thy scales doth cleave.

And I have left thee in the ilderness, Thou and every fish of thy floods, On the face of the field thou dost fall, Thou art not gathered nor assembled, To the beast of the earth and to the fol of the heavens I have given thee for food.
And knon have all inhabitants of Egypt That I [am] Jehovah, Because of their being a staff of reed to the house of Israel.
In their taking hold of thee by thy hand, — thou art crushed, And hast rent to them all the shoulder, And in their leaning on thee thou art broken, And hast caused all their thighs to stand.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am bringing in against thee a sord, And have cut off from thee man and beast.
And the land of Egypt hath been for a desolation and a aste, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah. Because he said: The flood [is] mine, and I made [it].
Therefore, lo, I [am] against thee, and against thy floods, And have given the land of Egypt for astes, A aste, a desolation, from Migdol to Syene, And unto the border of Cush.
Not pass over into it doth a foot of man, Yea, the foot of beast doth not pass into it, Nor is it inhabited forty years.

And I have made the land of Egypt a desolation, In the midst of desolate lands, And its cities, in the midst of aste cities, Are a desolation forty years, And I have scattered the Egyptians among nations, And I have dispersed them through lands.
But thus said the Lord Jehovah: At the end of forty years I gather the Egyptians Out of the peoples hither they have been scattered,
And I have turned back [to] the captivity of Egypt, And I have brought them back [To] the land of Pathros, to the land of their birth, And they have been there a lo kingdom.
Of the kingdoms it is loest, And it lifteth not up itself any more above the nations, And I have made them fe, So as not to rule among nations.
And it is no more to the house of Israel for a confidence, Bringing iniquity to remembrance, By their turning after them, And they have knon that I [am] the Lord Jehovah.’
And it cometh to pass, in the tenty and seventh year, in the first [month], in the first of the month, hath a ord of Jehovah been unto me, saying:

’Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, Hath caused his force to serve a great service against Tyre, Every head [is] bald — every shoulder peeled, And reard he had none, nor his force, out of Tyre, For the service that he served against it.

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah, Lo, I am giving to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon the land of Egypt, And he hath taken aay its store, And hath taken its spoil, and taken its prey, And it hath been a reard to his force.
His age for hich he laboured I have given to him, The land of Egypt — in that they rought for Me, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
In that day I cause to shoot up a horn to the house of Israel, And to thee I give an opening of the mouth in their midst, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, prophesy, and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Hol ye, ha! for the day!
For near [is] a day, near [is] a day to Jehovah! A day of clouds, the time of nations it is.
And come in hath a sord to Egypt, And there hath been great pain in Cush, In the falling of the ounded in Egypt, And they have taken its store, And broken don have been its foundations.
Cush, and Phut, and Lud, and all the mixture, and Chub, And the sons of the land of the covenant ith them by sord do fall,
Thus said Jehovah: And — fallen have supporters of Egypt, And come don hath the arrogance of her strength, From Migdol to Syene, by sord they fall in her, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And they have been desolated in the midst of desolate lands, And its cities are in the midst of asted cities.
And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My giving fire against Egypt, And broken have been all her helpers.
In that day go forth do messengers from before Me in ships, To trouble confident Cush, And there hath been great pain among them, As the day of Egypt, for lo, it hath come.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: I have caused the multitude of Egypt to cease, By the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon,
He and his people ith him — the terrible of nations, Are brought in to destroy the land, And they have dran their sords against Egypt, And have filled the land [ith] the ounded.
And I have made floods a dry place, And I have sold the land into the hand of evil doers, And I have made desolate the land, And its fulness, by the hand of strangers, I, Jehovah, have spoken.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: And — I have destroyed idols, And caused vain things to cease from Noph, And a prince of the land of Egypt there is no more, And I give fear in the land of Egypt.
And I have made Pathros desolate, And I have given fire against Zoan, And I have done judgments in No,
And I have poured out My fury on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, And I have cut off the multitude of No.
And I have given fire against Egypt, Greatly pained is Sin, and No is to be rent, And Noph hath daily distresses.
The youths of Aven and Pi-Beseth by sord do fall, And these into captivity do go.

And in Tehaphnehes hath the day been dark, In My breaking there the yokes of Egypt, And ceased in her hath the excellency of her strength, She — a cloud doth cover her, And her daughters into captivity do go.
And I have done judgments in Egypt, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.’
And it cometh to pass, in the eleventh year, in the first [month], in the seventh of the month, hath a ord of Jehovah been unto me, saying: ’Son of man,
The arm of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, I have broken, And lo, it hath not been bound up to give healing, To put a bandage to bind it, To strengthen it — to lay hold on the sord.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against Pharaoh, king of Egypt, And I have broken his arms, The strong one and the broken one, And have caused the sord to fall out of his hand,
And scattered the Egyptians among nations, And I have spread them through lands,
And strengthened the arms of the king of Babylon, And I have given My sord into his hand, And I have broken the arms of Pharaoh, And he hath groaned the groans of a pierced one — before him.

And I have strengthened the arms of the king of Babylon, And the arms of Pharaoh do fall don, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My giving My sord into the hand of the king of Babylon, And he hath stretched it out toard the land of Egypt.
And I have scattered the Egyptians among nations, And I have spread them through lands, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!’
And it cometh to pass, in the eleventh year, in the third [month], in the first of the month, hath a ord of Jehovah been unto me, saying:
’Son of man, say unto Pharaoh king of Egypt, and unto his multitude: To hom hast thou been like in thy greatness?
Lo, Asshur, a cedar in Lebanon, Fair in branch, and shading bough, and high in stature, And beteen thickets hath its foliage been.
Waters have made it great, The deep hath exalted him ith its floings, Going round about its planting, And its conduits it hath sent forth unto all trees of the field.
Therefore higher hath been his stature than all trees of the field, And multiplied are his boughs, and long are his branches, Because of many aters in his shooting forth,
In his boughs made a nest hath every fol of the heavens, And under his branches brought forth hath every beast of the field, And in his shade dell do all great nations.
And he is fair in his greatness, In the length of his thin shoots, For his root hath been by great aters.

Cedars have not hid him in the garden of God, Firs have not been like unto his boughs, And chesnut-trees have not been as his branches, No tree in the garden of God hath been like unto him in his beauty,
Fair I have made him in the multitude of his thin shoots, And envy him do all trees of Eden that [are] in the garden of God.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because that thou hast been high in stature, And he yieldeth his foliage beteen thickets, And high is his heart in his haughtiness,
I give him into the hand of a god of nations, He dealeth sorely ith him, In his ickedness I have cast him out.

And cut him off do strangers, The terrible of nations, and they leave him, On the mountains and in all valleys have his thin shoots fallen, And broken are his boughs at all streams of the land, And go don from his shade do all peoples of the land, and they leave him.
On his ruin dell do all fols of the heavens, And on his boughs have been all the beasts of the field,

In order that none of the trees of the aters May become haughty because of their stature, Nor give their foliage beteen thickets, Nor any drinking aters stand up unto them in their haughtiness, For all of them are given up to death, Unto the earth — the loer part, In the midst of the sons of men, Unto those going don to the pit.

Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In the day of his going don to sheol I have caused mourning, I have covered for him the deep, and diminish its floings, And restrained are many aters, And I make Lebanon black for him, And all trees of the field have been covered for him.

From the sound of his fall I have caused nations to shake, In My causing him to go don to sheol, With those going don to the pit, And comforted in the earth — the loer part, are all trees of Eden, The choice and the good of Lebanon, All drinking aters.
Also they ith him have gone don to sheol, Unto the pierced of the sord, And — his arm — they delt in his shade in the midst of nations.

Unto hom hast thou been thus like, In honour and in greatness among the trees of Eden, And thou hast been brought don ith the trees of Eden, Unto the earth — the loer part, In the midst of the uncircumcised thou liest, With the pierced of the sord? It [is] Pharaoh, and all his multitude, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And it cometh to pass, in the telfth year, in the telfth month, in the first of the month, hath a ord of Jehovah been unto me, saying,

’Son of man, lift up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and thou hast said unto him: A young lion of nations thou hast been like, And thou [art] as a dragon in the seas, And thou comest forth ith thy floings, And dost trouble the aters ith thy feet, And thou dost foul their floings.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: And — I have spread out for thee My net, With an assembly of many peoples, And they have brought thee up in My net.
And I have left thee in the land, On the face of the field I do cast thee out, And have caused to dell upon thee every fol of the heavens, And have satisfied out of thee the beasts of the hole earth.
And I have put thy flesh on the mountains, And filled the valleys [ith] thy hugeness,
And atered the land ith thy floing, From thy blood — unto the mountains, And streams are filled from thee.
And in quenching thee I have covered the heavens, And have made black their stars, The sun ith a cloud I do cover, And the moon causeth not its light to shine.
All luminaries of light in the heavens, I make black over thee, And I have given darkness over thy land, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah,
And I have vexed the heart of many peoples, In My bringing in thy destruction among nations, Unto lands that thou hast not knon.

And I have made many peoples astonished at thee, And their kings are afraid at thee ith trembling, In My brandishing My sord before their faces, And they have trembled every moment, Each for his life — in the day of thy fall.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: A sord of the king of Babylon entereth thee,
By sords of the mighty I cause thy multitude to fall, The terrible of nations — all of them, And they have spoiled the excellency of Egypt, And destroyed hath been all her multitude.
And I have destroyed all her beasts, From beside many aters, And trouble them not doth a foot of man any more, Yea, the hoofs of beasts trouble them not.
Then do I cause their aters to sink, And their rivers as oil I cause to go, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
In My making the land of Egypt a desolation, And desolated hath been the land of its fulness, In My smiting all the inhabitants in it, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
A lamentation it [is], and they have lamented her, Daughters of the nations do lament her, For Egypt, and for all her multitude, they lament her, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And it cometh to pass, in the telfth year, in the fifteenth of the month, hath a ord of Jehovah been unto me, saying,
’Son of man, Wail for the multitude of Egypt, And cause it to go don, It — and the daughters of honourable nations, Unto the earth — the loer parts, With those going don to the pit.
Than hom hast thou been more pleasant? Go don, and be laid ith the uncircumcised.
In the midst of the pierced of the sord they fall, [To] the sord she hath been given, They dre her out, and all her multitude.
Speak to him do the gods of the mighty out of the midst of sheol, With his helpers — they have gone don, They have lain ith the uncircumcised, The pierced of the sord.
There [is] Asshur, and all her assembly, Round about him [are] his graves, All of them [are] ounded, ho are falling by sord,
Whose graves are appointed in the sides of the pit, And her assembly is round about her grave, All of them ounded, falling by sord, Because they gave terror in the land of the living.

There [is] Elam, and all her multitude, Round about [is] her grave, All of them ounded, ho are falling by sord, Who have gone don uncircumcised unto the earth — the loer parts, Because they gave their terror in the land of the living, And they bear their shame ith those going don to the pit.

In the midst of the ounded they have appointed a bed for her ith all her multitude, Round about him [are] her graves, All of them uncircumcised, pierced of the sord, For their terror as given in the land of the living, And they bear their shame ith those going don to the pit, In the midst of the pierced he hath been put.
There [is] Meshech, Tubal, and all her multitude, Round about him [are] her graves, All of them uncircumcised, pierced of the sord, For they gave their terror in the land of the living,

And they lie not ith the mighty, Who are falling of the uncircumcised, Who have gone don to sheol ith their eapons of ar, And they put their sords under their heads, And their iniquities are on their bones, For the terror of the mighty [is] in the land of the living.
And thou, in the midst of the uncircumcised art broken, And dost lie ith the pierced of the sord.
There [is] Edom, her kings, and all her princes, Who have been given up in their might, With the pierced of the sord, They ith the uncircumcised do lie, And ith those going don to the pit.

There [are] princes of the north, All of them, and every Zidonian, Who have gone don ith the pierced in their terror, Of their might they are ashamed, And they lie uncircumcised ith the pierced of the sord, And they bear their shame ith those going don to the pit.
Then doth Pharaoh see, And he hath been comforted for all his multitude, The pierced of the sord — Pharaoh and all his force, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.

For I have given his terror in the land of the living, And he hath been laid don in the midst of the uncircumcised, With the pierced of the sord — Pharaoh, and all his multitude, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’Son of man, speak unto the sons of thy people, and thou hast said unto them: A land — hen I bring in against it a sord, And the people of the land have taken one man out of their borders, And made him to them for a atchman.
And he hath seen the sord coming against the land, And hath blon ith a trumpet, and hath arned the people,
And the hearer hath heard the voice of the trumpet, and he hath not taken arning, And come in doth the sord, and taketh him aay, His blood is on his head.
The voice of the trumpet he heard, And he hath not taken arning, his blood is on him, And he ho took arning his soul hath delivered.

And the atchman, hen he seeth the sord coming in, And he hath not blon ith a trumpet, And the people hath not been arned, And come in doth a sord, And taketh aay of them — a soul, He in his iniquity is taken aay, And his blood from the hand of the atchman I require.
And thou, son of man, A atchman I gave thee to the house of Israel, And thou hast heard from My mouth a ord, And thou hast arned them from Me.
In My saying to the icked, O icked one — thou dost surely die, And thou hast not spoken to arn the icked from his ay, He — the icked — in his iniquity doth die, And his blood from thy hand I require.
And thou, hen thou hast arned the icked of his ay, to turn back from it, And he hath not turned back from his ay, He in his iniquity doth die, And thou thy soul hast delivered.
And thou, son of man, say unto the house of Israel: Rightly ye have spoken, saying: Surely our transgressions and our sins [are] on us, And in them e are asting aay, Ho, then, do e live?

Say unto them, I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, I delight not in the death of the icked, But — in the turning of the icked from his ay, And he hath lived, Turn back, turn back, from your evil ays, Yea, hy do ye die, O house of Israel?

And thou, son of man, say unto the sons of thy people: The righteousness of the righteous doth not deliver him in the day of his transgression, And the ickedness of the icked, He doth not stumble for it in the day of his turning from his ickedness, And the righteous is not able to live in it in the day of his sinning.

In My saying of the righteous: He surely liveth, And — he hath trusted on his righteousness, And he hath done perversity, All his righteous acts are not remembered, And for his perversity that he hath done, For it he doth die.
And in My saying to the icked: Thou surely diest, And — he hath turned back from his sin, And hath done judgment and righteousness,
(The pledge the icked restoreth, plunder he repayeth,) In the statutes of life he hath alked, So as not to do perversity, He surely liveth — he doth not die.
None of his sin that he hath sinned is remembered to him, Judgment and righteousness he hath done, He doth surely live.
And the sons of thy people have said: The ay of the Lord is not pondered, As to them — their ay is not pondered.
In the turning back of the righteous from his righteousness, And he hath done perversity — he dieth for it.
And in the turning back of the icked from his ickedness, And he hath done judgment and righteousness, by them he liveth.
And ye have said: The ay of the Lord is not pondered, Each according to his ays do I judge you, O house of Israel.’

And it cometh to pass, in the telfth year — in the tenth [month], in the fifth of the month — of our removal, come in unto me doth one ho is escaped from Jerusalem, saying, ’The city hath been smitten.’

And the hand of Jehovah hath been unto me in the evening, before the coming in of the escaped one, and He openeth my mouth till the coming in unto me in the morning, and opened is my mouth, and I have not been silent again.
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’Son of man, the inhabitants of these astes on the ground of Israel are speaking, saying: Alone hath been Abraham — and he possesseth the land, and e [are] many — to us hath the land been given for a possession.
Therefore say unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: With the blood ye do eat, And your eyes ye lift up unto your idols, And blood ye shed, and the land ye inherit!
Ye have stood on your sord, Ye have done abomination, Each the ife of his neighbour ye have defiled, And the land ye possess!

Thus dost thou say unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: I live — do not they ho [are] in the astes by the sord fall? And they ho [are] on the face of the field, To the beast I have given for food, And they ho are in strongholds and in caves by pestilence die.
And I have made the land a desolation and an astonishment, And ceased hath the excellency of its strength, And desolated have been mountains of Israel, Without any one passing through.
And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My making the land a desolation and an astonishment, For all their abominations that they have done.

And thou, son of man, the sons of thy people ho are speaking about thee, By the alls, and in openings of the houses, Have spoken one ith another, each ith his brother, Saying: Come in, I pray you, And hear hat [is] the ord that cometh out from Jehovah.

And they come in unto thee as the coming in of a people, And they sit before thee — My people, And have heard thy ords, and they do them not, For doting loves ith their mouth they are making, After their dishonest gain their heart is going.
And lo, thou [art] to them as a singer of doting loves, A pleasant voice, and playing ell on an instrument, And they have heard thy ords, and they are not doing them.
And in its coming in — lo, it hath come, And they have knon that a prophet hath been in their midst!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’Son of man, prophesy concerning shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and thou hast said unto them: To the shepherds, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Woe [to] the shepherds of Israel, Who have been feeding themselves! The flock do not the shepherds feed?
The fat ye do eat, and the ool ye put on, The fed one ye slaughter, the flock ye feed not.

The eak ye have not strengthened, And the sick one ye have not healed, And the broken ye have not bound up, And the driven aay have not brought back, And the lost ye have not sought, And ith might ye have ruled them and ith rigour.
And they are scattered from ant of a shepherd, And are for food to every beast of the field, Yea, they are scattered.
Go astray do My flock on all the mountains, And on every high hill, And on all the face of the land have My flock been scattered, And there is none inquiring, and none seeking.
Therefore, shepherds, hear a ord of Jehovah:

I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, If not, because of My flock being for a prey, Yea, My flock is for food to every beast of the field, Because there is no shepherd, And My shepherds have not sought My flock, And the shepherds do feed themselves, And My flock they have not fed.
Therefore, O shepherds, hear a ord of Jehovah:

Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against the shepherds, And have required My flock from their hand, And caused them to cease from feeding the flock, And no more do the shepherds feed themselves, And I have delivered My flock from their mouth, And they are not to them for food.
For thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I — even I, have required My flock, And I have sought it out.

As a shepherd’s searching of his drove, In the day of his being in the midst of his scattered flock, so I do seek My flock, And have delivered them out of all places, Whither they have been scattered, In a day of cloud and thick darkness.

And brought them out from the peoples, And have gathered them from the lands, And brought them unto their on ground, And have fed them on mountains of Israel, By streams, and by all dellings of the land.
With good pasture I do feed them, And on mountains of the high place of Israel is their habitation, There do they lie don in a good habitation, And fat pastures they enjoy on mountains of Israel.
I feed My flock, and cause them to lie don, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
The lost I seek, and the driven aay bring back, And the broken I bind up, and the sick I strengthen, And the fat and the strong I destroy, I feed it ith judgment.
And you, My flock, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am judging beteen sheep and sheep, Beteen rams and he-goats.
Is it a little thing for you — the good pasture ye enjoy, And the remnant of your pasture ye tread don ith your feet, And a depth of aters ye do drink, And the remainder ith your feet ye trample,
And My flock the trodden thing of your feet consumeth, And the trampled thing of your feet drinketh?
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah to them: Lo, I — even I, have judged beteen fat sheep and lean sheep.
Because ith side and ith shoulder ye thrust aay, And ith your horns push all the diseased, Till ye have scattered them to the out-place,
And I have given safety to My flock, And they are not any more for prey, And I have judged beteen sheep and sheep.
And have raised up over them one shepherd, And he hath fed them — my servant David, He doth feed them, and he is their shepherd,
And I, Jehovah, I am their God, And My servant David prince in their midst, I, Jehovah, have spoken.
And I have made for them a covenant of peace, And caused evil beasts to cease out of the land, And they have delt in a ilderness confidently, And they have slept in forests.
And I have given them, and the suburbs of my hill, a blessing, And caused the shoer to come don in its season, Shoers of blessing they are.

And given hath the tree of the field its fruit, And the land doth give her increase, And they have been on their land confident, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My breaking the bands of their yoke, And I have delivered them from the hand of those laying service on them.
And they are no more a prey to nations, And the beast of the earth devoureth them not, And they have delt confidently, And there is none troubling.
And I have raised for them a plant for renon, And they are no more consumed by hunger in the land, And they bear no more the shame of the nations.
And they have knon that I, Jehovah, their God, [am] ith them, And they — the house of Israel — My people, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And ye, My flock, the flock of My pasture, Men ye [are] — I [am] your God, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, set thy face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it,
and thou hast said to it: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, O mount Seir, And have stretched out My hand against thee, And made thee a desolation and an astonishment.
Thy cities a aste I make, and thou art a desolation, And thou hast knon that I [am] Jehovah.
Because of thy having an enmity age-during, And thou dost sa the sons of Israel, By the hands of the sord, In the time of their calamity, In the time of the iniquity of the end:
Therefore, I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Surely for blood I do appoint thee, And blood doth pursue thee, If blood thou hast not hated, Blood also doth pursue thee.
And I have given mount Seir for a desolation and an astonishment, And have cut off from it him ho is passing over and him ho is returning,
And filled his mountains ith his ounded, Thy hills, and thy valleys, and all thy streams, The pierced of the sord fall into them.
Desolations age-during I make thee, And thy cities do not return, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
Because of thy saying: The to nations and the to lands are mine, and e have possessed it, And Jehovah hath been there;

Therefore, I live — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And I have done according to thine anger, And according to thine envy, With hich thou hast rought, Because of thy hatred against them, And I have been knon among them hen I judge thee.
And thou hast knon that I — Jehovah, I have heard all thy despisings that thou hast spoken Against mountains of Israel, saying: A desolation, to us they ere given for food.
And ye magnify yourselves against Me ith your mouth, And have made abundant against Me your ords, I — I have heard.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: According to the rejoicing of the hole land, A desolation I make of thee.

According to thy joy at the inheritance of the house of Israel because of desolation, So I do to thee — a desolation thou art, O mount Seir, and all Edom — all of it, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!
And thou, son of man, prophesy unto mountains of Israel, and thou hast said, O mountains of Israel, hear a ord of Jehovah.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because the enemy said against you, Aha, and the high places of old for a possession have been to us,

therefore, prophesy, and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because, even because, of desolating, And of salloing you up from round about, For your being a possession to the remnant of the nations, And ye are taken up on the tip of the tongue, And [are] an evil report of the people.

Therefore, O mountains of Israel, Hear a ord of the Lord Jehovah: Thus said the Lord Jehovah, to mountains, and to hills, To streams, and to valleys, And to astes that [are] desolate, And to cities that are forsaken, That have been for a prey, And for a scorn, to the remnant of the nations ho [are] round about.

Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Have I not, in the fire of My jealousy, Spoken against the remnant of the nations, And against Edom — all of it, Who gave My land to themselves for a possession, With the joy of the hole heart — ith despite of soul, For the sake of casting it out for a prey?

Therefore, prophesy concerning the ground of Israel, And thou hast said to mountains, and to hills, To streams, and to valleys, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I, in My jealousy, and in My fury, I have spoken, Because the shame of nations ye have borne.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: I — I have lifted up My hand, Do not — the nations ho [are] ith you from round about — they their on shame bear?
And ye, O mountains of Israel, Your branch ye give out, and your fruits ye bear for My people Israel, For they have dran near to come.
For, lo, I [am] for you, and have turned to you, And ye have been tilled and son.
And I have multiplied on you men, All the house of Israel — all of it, And the cities have been inhabited, And the astes are built.

And I have multiplied on you man and beast, And they have multiplied and been fruitful, And I have caused you to dell according to your former states, And I have done better than at your beginnings, And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
And I have caused man to alk over you, — My people Israel, And they possess thee, and thou hast been to them for an inheritance, And thou dost add no more to bereave them.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Because they are saying to you: A devourer of men [art] thou, And a bereaver of thy nations thou hast been,
Therefore, man thou devourest no more, And thy nations thou causest not to stumble any more, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And I proclaim not unto thee any more the shame of the nations, And the reproach of peoples thou bearest no more, And thy nations stumble not any more, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,
’Son of man, The house of Israel are delling on their land, And they defile it by their ay and by their doings, As the uncleanness of a separated one hath their ay been before Me.
And I do pour out My fury upon them For the blood that they shed on the land, And ith their idols they have defiled it.
And I scatter them among nations, And they are spread through lands, According to their ay, and according to their doings, I have judged them.
And one goeth in unto the nations hither they have gone, And they pollute My holy name by saying to them, The people of Jehovah [are] these, And from His land they have gone forth.
And I have pity on My holy name, That the house of Israel have polluted among nations hither they have gone in.

Therefore, say to the house of Israel, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Not for your sake am I orking, O house of Israel, But — for My holy name, That ye have polluted among nations hither ye have gone in.

And I have sanctified My great name, That is profaned among nations, That ye have polluted in your midst, And knon have the nations that I [am] Jehovah, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, In My being sanctified in you before your eyes.
And I have taken you out of the nations, And have gathered you out of all the lands, And I have brought you in unto your land,
And I have sprinkled over you clean ater, And ye have been clean; From all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols, I do cleanse you.
And I have given to you a ne heart, And a ne spirit I give in your midst, And I have turned aside the heart of stone out of your flesh, And I have given to you a heart of flesh.
And My Spirit I give in your midst, And I have done this, so that in My statutes ye alk, And My judgments ye keep, and have done them.
And ye have delt in the land that I have given to your fathers, And ye have been to Me for a people, And I — I am to you for God.
And I have saved you from all your uncleannesses, And I have called unto the corn, and multiplied it, And I have put no famine upon you.
And I have multiplied the fruit of the tree, And the increase of the field, So that ye receive not any more a reproach of famine among nations.
And ye have remembered your ays that [are] evil, And your doings that [are] not good, And have been loathsome in your on faces, For your iniquities, and for your abominations.
Not for your sake am I orking, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Be it knon to you, Be ashamed and confounded, because of your ays, O house of Israel.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In the day of My cleansing you from all your iniquities, I have caused the cities to be inhabited, And the astes have been built,
And the desolate land is tilled, Instead of hich it as a desolation before the eyes of every passer by,
And they have said: This land, that as desolated, Hath been as the garden of Eden, And the cities — the asted, And the desolated, and the broken don, Fenced places have remained.
And knon have the nations ho are left round about you, That I Jehovah have built the thron don, I have planted the desolated: I Jehovah have spoken, and I have done [it].
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Yet this I am required, By the house of Israel to do to them, I multiply them as a flock of men,
As a flock of holy ones, as a flock of Jerusalem, In her appointed seasons, So are the aste cities full of flocks of men, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!’
There hath been upon me a hand of Jehovah, and He taketh me forth in the Spirit of Jehovah, and doth place me in the midst of the valley, and it is full of bones,
and He causeth me to pass over by them, all round about, and lo, very many [are] on the face of the valley, and lo, very dry.
And He saith unto me, ’Son of man, do these bones live?’ And I say, ’O Lord Jehovah, Thou — Thou hast knon.’
And He saith unto me, ’Prophesy concerning these bones, and thou hast said unto them: O dry bones, hear a ord of Jehovah:
Thus said the Lord Jehovah to these bones: Lo, I am bringing into you a spirit, and ye have lived,
and I have given on you sines, and cause flesh to come up upon you, and covered you over ith skin, and given in you a spirit, and ye have lived, and ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah.’
And I have prophesied as I have been commanded, and there is a noise, as I am prophesying, and lo, a rushing, and dra near do the bones, bone unto its bone.
And I beheld, and lo, on them [are] sines, and flesh hath come up, and cover them doth skin over above — and spirit there is none in them.

And He saith unto me: ’Prophesy unto the Spirit, prophesy, son of man, and thou hast said unto the Spirit: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: From the four inds come in, O Spirit, and breathe on these slain, and they do live.’
And I have prophesied as He commanded me, and the Spirit cometh into them, and they live, and stand on their feet — a very very great force.
And He saith unto me, ’Son of man, these bones are the hole house of Israel; lo, they are saying: Dried up have our bones, And perished hath our hope, We have been cut off by ourselves.

Therefore, prophesy, and thou hast said unto them, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am opening your graves, And have brought you up out of your graves, O My people, And brought you in unto the land of Israel.
And ye have knon that I [am] Jehovah, In My opening your graves, And in My bringing you up out of your graves, O My people.
And I have given My Spirit in you, and ye have lived, And I have caused you to rest on your land, And ye have knon that I Jehovah, I have spoken, and I have done [it], An affirmation of Jehovah.’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying,

’And thou, son of man, take to thee one stick, and rite on it, For Judah, and for the sons of Israel, his companions; and take another stick, and rite on it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and all the house of Israel, his companions,
and bring them near one unto another, to thee, for one stick, and they have become one in thy hand.
’And hen sons of thy people speak unto thee, saying, Dost thou not declare to us hat these [are] to thee?

Speak unto them, Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am taking the stick of Joseph, that [is] in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his companions, and have given them unto him, ith the stick of Judah, and have made them become one stick, and they have been one in My hand.
And the sticks on hich thou ritest have been in thy hand before thine eyes,

and speak thou unto them: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I am taking the sons of Israel, From among the nations hither they have gone, And have gathered them from round about, And I have brought them in unto their land.

And I have made them become one nation in the land, on mountains of Israel, And one king is to them all for king, And they are no more as to nations, Nor are they divided any more into to kingdoms again.

Nor are they defiled any more ith their idols, And ith their abominations, And ith any of their transgressions, And I have saved them out of all their dellings, In hich they have sinned, And I have cleansed them, And they have been to Me for a people, And I — I am to them for God.
And My servant David [is] king over them, And one shepherd have they all, And in My judgments they go, And My statutes they keep, and have done them.

And they have delt on the land that I gave to My servant, to Jacob, In hich your fathers have delt, And they have delt on it, they and their sons, And their son’s sons — unto the age, And David My servant [is] their prince — to the age.
And I have made to them a covenant of peace, A covenant age-during it is ith them, And I have placed them, and multiplied them, And placed My sanctuary in their midst — to the age.
And My tabernacle hath been over them, And I have been to them for God, And they have been to Me for a people.
And knon have the nations that I Jehovah am sanctifying Israel, In My sanctuary being in their midst — to the age!’
And there is a ord of Jehovah unto me, saying:
’Son of man, set thy face unto Gog, of the land of Magog, prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy concerning him,
and thou hast said: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, O Gog, Prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal,

And I have turned thee back, And I have put hooks in thy jas, And have brought thee out, and all thy force, Horses and horsemen, Clothed in perfection all of them, A numerous assembly, [ith] buckler and shield, Handling sords — all of them.
Persia, Cush, and Phut, ith them, All of them [ith] shield and helmet.
Gomer and all its bands, The house of Togarmah of the sides of the north, And all its bands, many peoples ith thee,
Be prepared, yea, prepare for thee, Thou and all thine assemblies ho are assembled unto thee, And thou hast been to them for a guard.

After many days thou art appointed, In the latter end of the years thou comest in unto a land brought back from sord, [A people] gathered out of many peoples, Upon mountains of Israel, That have been for a perpetual aste, And it from the peoples hath been brought out, And delt safely have all of them.
And thou hast gone up — as asting thou comest in, As a cloud to cover the land art thou, Thou and all thy bands, and many peoples ith thee.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: And it hath come to pass in that day, Come up do things on thy heart, And thou hast thought an evil thought,
And thou hast said: I go up against a land of unalled villages, I go in to those at rest, delling confidently, All of them are delling ithout alls, And bar and doors they have not.
To take a spoil, and to take a prey, To turn back thy hand on inhabited astes, And on a people gathered out of nations, Making cattle and substance, Delling on a high part of the land.

Sheba, and Dedan, and merchants of Tarshish, And all its young lions say to thee: To take a spoil art thou come in? To take a prey assembled thine assembly? To bear aay silver and gold? To take aay cattle and substance? To take a great spoil?
Therefore, prophesy, son of man, and thou hast said to Gog: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: In that day, in the delling of My people Israel safely, Dost thou not kno?
And thou hast come in out of thy place, From the sides of the north, Thou and many peoples ith thee, Riding on horses — all of them, A great assembly, and a numerous force.

And thou hast come up against My people Israel, As a cloud to cover the land, In the latter end of the days it is, And I have brought thee in against My land, In order that the nations may kno Me, In My being sanctified in thee before their eyes, O Gog.
Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Art thou he of hom I spake in former days, By the hand of My servants, prophets of Israel, Who are prophesying in those days — years, To bring thee in against them?
And it hath come to pass, in that day, In the day of the coming in of Gog against the land of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Come up doth My fury in My face,
And in My zeal, in the fire of My rath, I have spoken: Is there not in that day a great rushing on the land of Israel?

And rushed from My presence have fishes of the sea, And the fol of the heavens, And the beast of the field, And every creeping thing that is creeping on the ground, And all men ho [are] on the face of the ground, And thron don have been the mountains, And fallen have the ascents, And every all to the earth falleth.
And I have called against him, to all My mountains a sord, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, The sord of each is against his brother.
And I have been judged ith him, With pestilence and ith blood, And an overfloing rain and hailstones, Fire and brimstone I rain on him, and on his bands, And on many peoples ho [are] ith him.
And I have magnified Myself, and sanctified Myself, And I have been knon before the eyes of many nations, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah!
And thou, son of man, prophesy concerning Gog, and thou hast said: Thus said the Lord Jehovah: Lo, I [am] against thee, O Gog, Prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal,
And have turned thee back, and enticed thee, And caused thee to come up from the sides of the north, And brought thee in against mountains of Israel,
And have smitten thy bo out of thy left hand, Yea, thine arros out of thy right I cause to fall.
On mountains of Israel thou fallest, Thou, and all thy bands, and the peoples ho [are] ith thee, To ravenous fol — a bird of every ing, And [to] a beast of the field, I have given thee for food.
On the face of the field thou fallest, for I have spoken, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And I have sent a fire against Magog, And against the confident inhabitants of the isles, And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah.
And My holy name I make knon in the midst of My people Israel, And I pollute not My holy name any more, And knon have the nations that I, Jehovah, the Holy One, [am] in Israel.
Lo, it hath come, and it hath been done, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, It [is] the day of hich I spake.

And gone out have the inhabitants of cities of Israel, And they have burned and kindled [a fire], With armour, and shield, and buckler, With bo, and ith arros, And ith hand-staves, and ith javelins, And they have caused a fire to burn ith them seven years,

And they do not take ood out of the field, Nor do they he out of the forests, For ith armour they cause the fire to burn, And they have spoiled their spoilers, And they have plundered their plunderers, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.

And it hath come to pass, in that day, I give to Gog a place there — a grave in Israel, the valley of those passing by, east of the sea, and it is stopping those passing by, and they have buried there Gog, and all his multitude, and have cried, O valley of the multitude of Gog!
And the house of Israel have buried them — in order to cleanse the land — seven months.
Yea, all the people of the land have buried them, and it hath been to them for a name — the day of My being honoured — an affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.

And men for continual employment they separate, passing on through the land, burying ith those passing by those ho are left on the face of the earth, to cleanse it: at the end of seven months they search.
And those passing by have passed through the land, and seen a bone of man, and one hath constructed near it a sign till those burying have buried it in the valley of the multitude of Gog.
And also the name of the city [is] The multitude; and they have cleansed the land.

And thou, son of man, thus said the Lord Jehovah: Say to the bird — every ing, and to every beast of the field: Be assembled and come in, Be gathered from round about, For My sacrifice that I am sacrificing for you, A great sacrifice on mountains of Israel, And ye have eaten flesh, and drunk blood.
Flesh of the mighty ye do eat, And blood of princes of the earth ye drink, Of rams, of lambs, and of he-goats, Of calves, fatlings of Bashan — all of them.
And ye have eaten fat to satiety, And ye have drunk blood — to drunkenness, Of My sacrifice that I sacrificed for you.
And ye have been satisfied at My table ith horse and rider, Mighty man, and every man of ar, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
And I have given My honour among nations, And seen have all the nations My Judgment that I have done, And My hand that I have laid on them.
And knon have the house of Israel that I [am] Jehovah their God, From that day and henceforth.

And knon have the nations that for their iniquity, Removed have the house of Israel, Because they have trespassed against Me, And I do hide My face from them, And give them into the hand of their adversaries, And they fall by sord — all of them.
According to their uncleanness, And according to their transgressions, I have done ith them, And I do hide My face from them.
Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: No do I bring back the captivity of Jacob, And I have pitied all the house of Israel, And have been zealous for My holy name.
And they have forgotten their shame, And all their trespass that they trespassed against Me, In their delling on their land confidently and none troubling.
In My bringing them back from the peoples, I have assembled them from the lands of their enemies, And I have been sanctified in them before the eyes of the many nations,
And they have knon that I [am] Jehovah their God, In My removing them unto the nations, And I have gathered them unto their land, And I leave none of them any more there.
And I hide not any more My face from them, In that I have poured out My spirit on the house of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah!’

In the tenty and fifth year of our removal, in the beginning of the year, in the tenth of the month, in the fourteenth year after that the city as smitten, in this self-same day hath a hand of Jehovah been upon me, and He bringeth me in thither;
in visions of God He hath brought me in unto the land of Israel, and causeth me to rest on a very high mountain, and upon it [is] as the frame of a city on the south.
And He bringeth me in thither, and lo, a man, his appearance as the appearance of brass, and a thread of flax in his hand, and a measuring-reed, and he is standing at the gate,

and the man speaketh unto me: ’Son of man, see ith thine eyes, And ith thine ears hear, And set thy heart to all that I am sheing thee, For, in order to she [it] thee, Thou hast been brought in hither, Declare all that thou art seeing to the house of Israel.’

And lo, a all on the outside of the house all round about, and in the hand of the man a measuring-reed, six cubits by a cubit and a handbreadth, and he measureth the breadth of the building one reed, and the height one reed.
And he cometh in unto the gate hose front [is] eastard, and he goeth up by its steps, and he measureth the threshold of the gate one reed broad, even the one threshold one reed broad,
and the little chamber one reed long and one reed broad, and beteen the little chambers five cubits, and the threshold of the gate, from the side of the porch of the gate from ithin, one reed.
And he measureth the porch of the gate from ithin one reed,
and he measureth the porch of the gate eight cubits, and its posts to cubits, and the porch of the gates from ithin,
and the little chambers of the gate eastard, three on this side, and three on that side; one measure [is] to them three, and one measure [is] to the posts, on this side and on that side.
And he measureth the breadth of the opening of the gate ten cubits, the length of the gate thirteen cubits;
and a border before the little chambers, one cubit, and one cubit [is] the border on this side, and the little chamber [is] six cubits on this side, and six cubits on that side.
And he measureth the gate from the roof of the [one] little chamber to the roof of another; the breadth tenty and five cubits, opening over-against opening.
And he maketh the posts of sixty cubits, even unto the post of the court, the gate all round about;
and by the front of the gate of the entrance, by the front of the porch of the inner gate, fifty cubits;

and narro indos [are] unto the little chambers, and unto their posts at the inside of the gate all round about — and so to the arches — and indos all round about [are] at the inside, and at the post [are] palm-trees.
And he bringeth me in unto the outer court, and lo, chambers and a pavement made for the court all round about — thirty chambers on the pavement —
and the pavement unto the side of the gates over-against the length of the gates [is] the loer pavement;
and he measureth the breadth from before the loer gate, to the front of the inner court, on the outside, a hundred cubits, eastard and northard.
As to the gate of the outer court hose front [is] northard, he hath measured its length and its breadth;

and its little chambers, three on this side, and three on that side, and its posts and its arches have been according to the measure of the first gate, fifty cubits its length, and the breadth five and tenty by the cubit;
and its indos, and its arches, and its palm-trees [are] according to the measure of the gate hose face [is] eastard, and by seven steps they go up on it, and its arches [are] before them.
And the gate of the inner court [is] over-against the gate at the north and at the east; and he measureth from gate unto gate, a hundred cubits.
And he causeth me to go southard, and lo, a gate southard, and he hath measured its posts and its arches according to these measures;
and indos [are] to it and to its arches all round about, like these indos, fifty cubits the length, and the breadth five and tenty cubits;
and seven steps [are] its ascent, and its arches [are] before them, and palm-trees [are] to it, one on this side, and one on that side, at its posts;
and the gate of the inner court [is] southard, and he measureth from gate unto gate southard, a hundred cubits.
And he bringeth me in unto the inner court by the south gate, and he measureth the south gate according to these measures;

and its little chambers, and its posts, and its arches [are] according to these measures, and indos [are] to it and to its arches all round about; fifty cubits the length, and the breadth tenty and five cubits.
As to the arches all round about, the length [is] five and tenty cubits, and the breadth five cubits;
and its arches [are] unto the outer court, and palm-trees [are] unto its posts, and eight steps [are] its ascent.
And he bringeth me in unto the inner court eastard, and he measureth the gate according to these measures;

and its little chambers, and its posts, and its arches [are] according to these measures: and indos [are] to it and to its arches all round about, the length fifty cubits, and the breadth five and tenty cubits;
and its arches [are] toard the outer court, and palm-trees [are] toard its posts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps [are] its ascent.
And he bringeth me in unto the north gate, and hath measured according to these measures;
its little chambers, its posts, and its arches; and indos [are] to it all round about: the length fifty cubits, and the breadth five and tenty cubits;
and its posts [are] to the outer court, and palm-trees [are] unto its posts, on this side and on that side, and eight steps [are] its ascent.
And the chamber and its opening [is] by the posts of the gates, there they purge the burnt-offering.
And in the porch of the gate [are] to tables on this side, and to tables on that side, to slaughter on them the burnt-offering, and the sin-offering, and the guilt-offering;
and at the side ithout, at the going up to the opening of the north gate, [are] to tables; and at the other side that [is] at the porch of the gate, [are] to tables;
four tables [are] on this side, and four tables on that side, at the side of the gate, eight tables on hich they slaughter.

And the four tables for burnt-offering [are] of hen stone: the length one cubit and a half, and the breadth one cubit and a half, and the height one cubit: on them they place the instruments ith hich they slaughter the burnt-offering and the sacrifice.
And the boundaries [are] one handbreadth, prepared ithin all round about: and on the tables [is] the flesh of the offering.

And on the outside of the inner gate [are] chambers of the singers, in the inner court, that [are] at the side of the north gate, and their fronts [are] southard, one at the side of the east gate [hath] the front northard.
And he speaketh unto me: ’This chamber, hose front [is] southard, [is] for priests keeping charge of the house;
and the chamber, hose front [is] northard, [is] for priests keeping charge of the altar: they [are] sons of Zadok, ho are draing near of the sons of Levi unto Jehovah, to serve Him.’
And he measureth the court: the length a hundred cubits, and the breadth a hundred cubits, square, and the altar [is] before the house.

And he bringeth me in unto the porch of the house, and he measureth the post of the porch, five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side, and the breadth of the gate, three cubits on this side, and three cubits on that side;
the length of the porch tenty cubits, and the breadth eleven cubits; and by the steps hereby they go up unto it: and pillars [are] at the posts, one on this side, and one on that side.
And he bringeth me in unto the temple, and he measureth the posts, six cubits the breadth on this side, and six cubits the breadth on that side — the breadth of the tent.

And the breadth of the opening [is] ten cubits; and the sides of the opening [are] five cubits on this side, and five cubits on that side; and he measureth its length forty cubits, and the breadth tenty cubits.
And he hath gone inard, and measureth the post of the opening to cubits, and the opening six cubits, and the breadth of the opening seven cubits.
And he measureth its length tenty cubits, and the breadth tenty cubits, unto the front of the temple, and he saith unto me, ’This [is] the holy of holies.’
And he measureth the all of the house six cubits, and the breadth of the side-chamber four cubits, all round the house round about.
